articleTitle: A queue buffer management algorithm based on traffic prediction in DiffServ architecture
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: In the DiffServ architecture, a queue buffer management algorithm-PARIO-C algorithm based on traffic prediction was proposed. The algorithm used Recursive Least Squares (RLS) method to predict the change of average queue length in the network, and combined Adaptive Random Early Detection (ARED) algorithm to adjust the parameter adaptively, thus achieved better control of network congestion. Experimental comparison with Random Early Detection with In/Out and Couple queue (RIO-C) algorithm on latency, jitter, packet loss rate, the results show that PARIO-C algorithm lower the scope of network jitter, and reduce the network latency and packet loss rate, so improve network QoS to a certain extent.

articleTitle: The coordinate control of ship steering and main propulsion in constrict waters for collision avoidance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: In order to facilitate a precise collision avoidance scheme capability for ships under low speed in constrict water, a novel intelligent coordinate control approach of ship steering and main propulsion is proposed. In the research an innovative self-training optimizing search method is presented. The optimizing process is based on particle swarm optimization algorithm and off-line training data. The training data is obtained from trial manoeuvres based on computer simulation. This support system has been developed to help ship operators make a precise collision avoidance decision, whilst simultaneously reducing the burden of bridge data processing. The application results show that the designed intelligent coordinate controller performed well to implement the optimizing control of ship collision avoidance.

articleTitle: Study on third-party logistics service provider selection evaluation indices system based on analytic network process with BOCR
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The third-party logistics service provider (3PLs) business is developing rapidly as a result of the growing globalization and competition. In this study, 3PLs selection indices system with dependence and feedback was evaluated by using analytic network process (ANP). 3PLs selection indices system was evaluated according to 12 criteria that are involved in four control criteria benefits (B), opportunities (O), costs (C) and risks (R) and the final synthesis of alternatives was obtained by using rated BOCR. A numerical example has demonstrated that the proposed ANP approach with BOCR is effective.

articleTitle: The design and application of fuzzy PID controller in pulp concentration control
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Conventional PID controller could not adjust its parameters online, a fuzzy PID control algorithm was introduced. It can automatically change PID controller's parameters according to object's characteristic and it integrates the advantages of fuzzy control with PID control, so it can improve the control speed and accuracy greatly. We applied this control algorithm in pulp concentration control system successfully. The results shows that fuzzy PID controller has good dynamic quality, fast response, no overshoot, no steady state deviation, and has practical significance.

articleTitle: Analysis of the momentum for construction enterprises to improve safety producing behavior
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Safety producing behavior of construction enterprises is the main step and measure to prevent and control the accidents, and has been in a continuous improvement process. This paper, proposes three stages for the improvement of the safety producing behavior of construction enterprises, systematic studies the external environment and internal economic momentum to improve the safety producing behavior, and makes analysis of the relationship, changing laws of the improving momentum and the safety producing behavior, at the same time, it analyzes the disadvantage and solutions of the safety producing behavior in the standardized stage, which provide a theoretical basis for the optimization of construction enterprises, improvement of safety producing behavior, and the risk reducing of safety incidents.

articleTitle: Review of trip-chain-based travel activity study of residents
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The study of traveling behavior of local residents concentrates on illustrating travelling regularities and traffic mode choice, which is significantly important for traffic planning and management policies. Based on travelling chain, this paper systematically combines four parameters, including time dimension, space dimension, and mode dimension and activity types of traffic system together, thus making traffic system into an organism. Compared with traditional research methods, travelling chain method maintains system and wholeness successfully, which catches the attention both domestically and abroad.

articleTitle: Path selection evaluation for emergency transport vehicles
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The goal of emergency rescue is to reduce casualties and property losses caused by unexpected events. How to improve emergency response speed is one of the most difficult problems in the area of emergency logistics. Therefore, the study of the optimal path selection problem for transport vehicles to improve emergency response speed is full of practical significance. In this paper, a multi-objective optimization evaluation model is introduced. The evaluation model aims at choosing the route with the shortest travel time, the least cost, and the smallest probability of risk on traveling. Finally this model is applied to a road network to prove its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Container real_time positioning on the terminal
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: To fix the container position in severe weather, a real-time positioning system has been applicated in container terminal. The navigating system should run simultaneously with container terminal operation system. After reformed, the pre-existing container terminal operation system and the navigating system become into a new system. The new system includes: RTK Data broadcasting, dispatcher modual, interference suppression between both systems, GIS activeX control application (digital map), and 3D Virtual reality for container yard.

articleTitle: Identification of critical control points of the food cold chain logistic process
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Based on the analysis of cold-chain process, it suggests using the theory of process control to analysis the critical control points in the cold-chain process, which influences the food safety. To identify the critical processes, this paper proposes a new and general decision making method for evaluating logistics systems using AHP and entropy weight method. Based on the integrated weight of criteria for critical control points, apply the process prioritization matrix to rank cold-chain processes. The top of the ranking list is considered as the critical processes which referred to food safety.

articleTitle: The analysis of logistics outsourcing risk: A system dynamics approach
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Logistics outsourcing risk is emerging as a key challenge to logistics management in supply chain. The risk analysis is a critical first step in managing logistics outsourcing risk. The main purpose of this paper is to study the risk associated with logistics outsourcing using system dynamics theory. Firstly, we analyze the logistics outsourcing risk from the system thinking perspective. Secondly, based on the analysis of logistics outsourcing risk system's structure, inner mechanisms and relationships, a system dynamic model including input subsystem, risk subsystem, performance subsystem and benefit subsystem is built. Finally a detailed description of the model is presented from the viewpoint of system theory.

articleTitle: Optimization of timber procurement and logistics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Timber product supply chain management is quite different from others. The production, storage and delivery of timber product is affected not only by cost, but also by weather because most of timber product procurement is done outdoor. This paper concentrates on the study of one of the most complex systems, multistage timber production, which is very popular in vast forest regions of China and Russia. Based on case studies from the Heilongjiang Forest Region, in the northeast part of China, optimal operation planning for timber product supply chain management, and the impact of harvesting on the forest environment, economic benefit and working safety, is carried using a multi-objective optimization model. The results of the case studies, optimizing operation time schedules, show that the models are quite applicable and helpful to practical operations.

articleTitle: A novel fast algorithm for image median filtering based on improved sign test method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: This paper studies the median filtering algorithm of digital image and several other related fast algorithms for it, as well as sign test method, then gives an improved algorithm for sign test method, and a new fast median filtering algorithm based on improved sign test method. The new median filtering algorithm based on improved sign test method does not need to sort any of the pixel values in filtering neighbourhood so as to greatly speed up the process of median filtering. At the same time, this algorithm introduced a relative value as the statistic to solve the shortcomings of original sign test method, especially when samples of the two collectivities are almost the same. Algorithm analysis and a lot of experiment results show that the new algorithm can not only speed up the process of image median filtering, but also can maintain much more information of image, especially the edge and texture, compared to several other fast algorithm of image median filtering.

articleTitle: Application of fuzzy fault tree analysis on burning and blasting of LPG tank
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: It shows probabilities of each basic event for burning and blasting of LPG tanks applying triangle fuzzy numerals. The distribution of probability for top event is calculated on the base of fault tree and fuzzy operators. Median method is applied to analyze fuzzy significance. Combined with sequence of each fuzzy significance, the major sequence of hidden danger and harmful factors for burning and blasting of LPG tanks is concluded. The relevant management means and guarding measures are put forward in order to eliminate danger or control serious extent of the accident.

articleTitle: Logistics system performance evaluation of the fresh and live agricultural products with an application of analytic network process
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: In the first place, this thesis, based on an analysis of the features of the logistics system of the fresh and live agriculture products, the affecting factors of its performance and influencing mechanism, considering the specificity of the whole fresh and live agriculture products logistics system, constructs an indicating system on the evaluation of logistics system performance of the fresh and live agriculture products. Secondly, based on an analysis of the applicability of the analytic network process, this paper, analyses the dependent network process relationship between different indicators in the evaluation system of performance of the fresh and live agriculture products logistics system establishes a network construction of the fresh and live agriculture products and confirms partial weight and overall weight. Practically, through a survey of the relative departments and professors in Chang Tai in Fujian province, this paper, with an empirical analysis of the software Super Decision, raised some managerial suggestions which can the improve the performance.

articleTitle: A hybrid heuristics for vehicle routing problem with simultaneous pickup and delivery service
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The vehicle routing problem with simultaneous delivery and pick-up service (VRPSPD) was considered in this paper. A hybrid heurictics was proposed to determine the optimal set of routes to totally satisfy both the delivery and pick-up demand of the customer population. An extensive numerical experiment was performed on benchmark problem instances available in literature. It is found that the proposed approach gives good results compared to the existing algorithms.

articleTitle: Optimization for PID control parameters on hydraulic servo control system based on Evolutionary Cellular Automata Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: PID control is used widely in hydraulic servo control system. The PID control parameters are very important to performance of hydraulic servo control system and how to find rapidly the optimum values of PID control parameters is very difficult problem. Based on Matlab/simulink software and taking the IATE standards of the optimization design as objective function, a global search optimization method, called Evolutionary Cellular Automata Algorithm which has a digging operator and two learning operators (dual arithmetic crossover operator and chaos-peak-jumping operator) was applied for the optimization of the three parameters of PID controller of electric-hydraulic servo system of 6-DOF parallel platform. Simulation results show that the proposed parameter optimum method is an effective tuning strategy and has good performance.

articleTitle: A study on the model and characteristics of product-based service supply chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Product-based service is a bridge to lead the traditional industrial economy to service economy, and will play a critical role to dematerialize China's economy. As an innovative business model, product-service system shifts the focus from ownership transfer to service provision, and provides an ideal solution to product-based service supply chain. This paper clarifies the concepts of product-based service and product-service system, and discusses the model and characteristics of product-based service supply chain in alignment with the requirements of product-service system.

articleTitle: Research on pricing mechanism of agent construction for government investment projects based on risk allocation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The Agent Construction System (ACS) for government investment project is a primary solution for investment system reformation in China. However, the implementation of ACS has encountered some incentive problems, and the agent construction service pricing mechanism is one of the most important incentive problems. By formulating a primary pricing model be comprised of basic price and incentive price, the article discussed the influence of risk allocation on the incentive ratio and parameters in the project residual. It shows that the incentive ratio in the pricing model and the project residual are both determinate by the risk allocation between the principal and the agency. Based on the analysis above, the article has presented a series of pricing model for the government principal in accordance with different risk allocation arrangements.

articleTitle: Trajectory planning based on variable structure GA of a three-limbed robot
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: A novel progressive genetic algorithm is developed for motion planning of a three-limbed robot. The proposed motion planning method can be used to find a optimal joints trajectory from the initial to the final position and orientation. On the basis of the genetic algorithm a kind of variable structure genetic algorithm is proposed to solve the problem of motion planning of the three-limbed in dynamic environments. The variable structure genetic algorithm changes the original structure by abandoning Elitist Model, expectation selection, reproducing population and changing the probability of crossover and mutation. Experiments results show that the former algorithm is effective in static environments and the latter algorithm is good at dynamic environments.

articleTitle: Supplier performance management based on benchmarking methodology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Supplier performance can directly affect the quality of manufactures' supply chain. An efficient management mechanism should be established to enhance and improve supplier performance. Benchmarking management can clearly lead suppliers to find their weakness and the approach to develop their performance, therefore it can serves as the basement of the supplier performance mechanism. Based on benchmarking methodology, this paper establishes a conceptual model for supplier performance management. By setting benchmark for suppliers in different level and encourage suppliers to compare with the benchmark, enterprise can control and optimize the performance of suppliers. This model also emphasizes the dynamic evaluation of continuous improvement of suppliers' performance and highlights the necessary of enterprise's incentive actions.

articleTitle: An improved service scheme combinated SWAN with QoS-MSR in Ad-hoc networks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: We proposed a new scheme, aiming to meet the needs of the real-time traffic, which needs higher bandwidth and bounded end-to-end delay. Because routing protocol plays an important role in the supports of QoS in the SWAN model for Ad-hoc networks, we assumed that the multi-path routing QoS-MSR introduced to the SWAN model. The advantage is that it can not only attach the information of QoS by using muti-path tables in the routing search process, but also adopt the algorithm of MBSR(Multiple Bandwidth Splitting Reservation). Simulation results indicate that the performance parameters of the network(end-to-end delay, throughput and so on) were remarkably improved in the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Study on the long-term reward incentive of the agent enterprise based on the reputation effect
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: For the government investment project, there is a long-term cooperation between the government principal and the agent enterprise. The incentive model of reputation effect of the agent enterprise was built to solve the long-term reward incentive of the agent enterprise under long-term game. The effort degree of the agent enterprise was analyzed with the influence of the reputation effect, and incentive methods of government principal were discussed based on the reputation effect under the cases of symmetry and asymmetric information. The results show that the reputation effect is conducive to encourage the agent enterprise to work harder and the government principal could achieve the long-term incentive effect by adjusting the incentive structure and increasing the reputation incentive.

articleTitle: The empirical research on the jumps in Shanghai stock market
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: We use high-frequency data-based jump detection procedure based on realized volatility measure theory to investigate the price jumps in Shanghai stock market. Using BN-S approach, we find that the price jumps are universal not only in stock index but also in individual stocks. However, the co-jumps detected in stock index are not significant in most of single component stocks. This shows that the jumps in individual stocks can be more generated by stock-specific news while the co-jumps in a well-diversified index should only be generated by market-level news which induces the co-jumps in many stocks. We find that the co-jumps can only be seen in individual stocks when eliminated the idiosyncratic jumps in them.

articleTitle: Knowledge transfer mechanism in R&D team of university
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Through introducing the entropy theory of thermodynamics, knowledge entropy is proposed, and the mathematic model of it is constructed to calculate uncertainty in organization knowledge content. The mechanism of knowledge transfer is analyzed, the mathematic model of knowledge transfer entropy is constructed which is used to evaluate the credible degree that organization knowledge acquires results. The knowledge transfer model in university and between university and university are respectively constructed, and the super circular model of knowledge transfer in R&D team of universities is designed as well.

articleTitle: Optimal multi-modal transport model for full loads with time windows
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Multi-modal transport of full loads with time limit is a complex problem. Its organization mode, which is link-up multimodal transport, and business process were probed into. Then, the virtual transport network is constructed for multimodal transport selection. Finally, a combination optimal model for multimodal transport of full loads with time windows is presented. Multi-objective genetic algorithm of random weighting is adopted as the optimization method, combined with MATLAB7.0 programming for calculation. A case study shows it can decrease the transport cost by 44.72% to 84.45%, and duration by 25% to 50%.

articleTitle: Research on costs sharing of the recycling economy system based on Cooperative Game
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Recycling economy, serving as one of the scientific theory and development model, is gradually accepted by countries all over the world as the new model for economy development which emphasizes the harmonious relationships between human and nature. The smooth implementing of recycling economy relies on the participations of consumers, enterprises and governmental authorities, whose ratio of costs sharing is different because of the difference in statue and objective of each participator. Based on Cooperative Game Theory, this paper configures the costs sharing model for recycling economy system and demonstrates the model operation by the case study which quantifies the costs that each participator in the system should undertake. Three styles of compensations are brought forward that includes governmental authority to enterprise, enterprise to consumer, and governmental authority to consumer so as to guarantee a long-lasting and stable development for recycling economy system.

articleTitle: Prediction model of molten iron endpoint temperature in AOD furnace based on RBF neural network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: According to Jilin Ferroalloy Factory 10-ton AOD furnace actual smelting condition, analyzes the impact factor of AOD furnace molten iron endpoint temperature, by optimizing the neural network connection weights and structure, design prediction model of molten iron endpoint temperature based on RBF neural network, using LM algorithm and 50 furnaces actual production data to train the model, and predicts another 50 furnaces molten iron temperature, Result shows that prediction model of molten iron endpoint temperature based on RBF neural network has a high accuracy, when the error of endpoint temperature is ± 12 °C, hit rate of temperature is 82.4%.

Index Terms: Activation Function Of The Hidden Layer

articleTitle: The study on evaluation model for choosing supplier based on knowledge management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The competition of the modern enterprises has focused on choosing appropriate supplier to form an alliance. In cooperation between enterprise and supplier, knowledge interactively shifts. While knowledge is the key competitive element, knowledge management becomes criterion of supplier choice compared with the quality, price and so on. Core enterprise and supplier's knowledge shift model was constructed and core enterprise's knowledge management mechanism was analyzed. Based on this, evaluating indices system is constructed to select supplier based on knowledge management from knowledge cooperation and knowledge adaption, and D-S evidence method is choosen to appraise and select supplier and an empirical analysis is done to provide new thought and evaluation system for enterprise selecting supplier reasonably.

articleTitle: Location selection of recycle center by combining AHP and DEA methodologies
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The importance of recycle center to reverse logistics is just like that of distribution to forward logistics. And the location selection of recycle center directly impacts on the performance of the reverse logistics management. A hybrid model combining AHP and DEA methodologies is given here. AHP is used to determine the comprehensive benefit of each alternative location of recycle center. And then DEA is applied for evaluating the relative efficiency. At last the approach is demonstrated with a simulation case.

articleTitle: Executive compensation gaps, promotion probability and corporate performance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: In the past few years, especially since the outbreak of the sub-prime crisis, the issue of Executive compensation has become not only a public, but also an academic focus of controversy. This paper conducts an empirical study on the determinants of compensation gaps with 791 Chinese listed companies from 2000 to 2007. The result shows that there is a significantly negative relation between compensation gaps and promotion probability. After that, this paper turns to another empirical study on the relation between compensation gaps and corporate performance with 878 Chinese listed companies from 2003 to 2007. The result of our research is in favor of the tournament incentive theory, which demonstrates a significantly positive relation between compensation gaps and corporate performance.

articleTitle: Research on the third-party integrated information-sharing model in supply chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Based on the previous study of information-sharing models, this paper gave a research into the construction, functions, advantages and challenges of the third-party Integrated information-sharing model. The analysis shows that this model, with a higher degree of specialization, can adapt better to the rapidly changing market.

articleTitle: The research of a special mechanism for MAC layer in wireless telecommunication network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: A solution for supporting low-delay services for the MAC layer is proposed. And it can realize the dividing of the realtime and non-real-time services, and then we build a new MAC mechanism serving for different service class by amending the source code of NS2. In accordance with the thought of dividing serving class, we optimize the mechanism of the 802.11 MAC layer, make simulation on NS2, analyze the function compared with the one before optimization in view of the real-time service, and finally testify the result of the optimization.

articleTitle: A dynamic multipoint detecting PSO
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The chief aim of the present work is to propose a particle swarm optimization(PSO) by using a dynamic multipoint exploring approach. The main technique of this algorithm is that in the preceding phase of the algorithm, every particle can choose its searching direction and its moving velocity independently not being restricted or attracted by the optimal position of which have found by the parcle swarm and makes use of a dynamic multipoint random detecting method. It indicatess, from the empirical results of four typical benchmark functions' optimization, that the optimization algorithm has the performance of rapid convergence rate, high accurate numerical solution, good stability and powerful robust. This proves that the algorithm is a promising means in solving the complex function optimization problems.

articleTitle: Guaranteed cost robust Hinf reliable control for a class of uncertain time-varying delay systems
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The problem of guaranteed cost robust Hinf reliable control is investigated for time-varying delay uncertain systems against actuator failures. In the considered system, the time-varying delay and its derivative are bounded. Actuators are classified into two sets (One set is susceptible to failure and the other set is not susceptible to failure). All the outputs of the failure actuators are assumed to be zero. Based on Lyapunov stability theory, a sufficient condition of the existence of guaranteed cost robust Hinf reliable controller is derived and furthermore transformed to a linear matrix inequality (LMI). At the same time, the designing approach of state feedback controller is presented and the upper bound of guaranteed cost function is given. The resultant control systems not only could retain asymptotic stability and disturbance attenuation with Hinf-norm bounds but also possess the performance index of guaranteed cost irrespective of any outages within a prespecified subset of actuators.

articleTitle: Two dimensional image reconstruction of log cross-section defect based on stress wave technique
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Wood is a material that is produced biologically in the growing tree, making it vulnerable to the attack of fungi. This will reduce the quality of wood, especially for log. The 2D image reconstruction contributed greatly for log cross-section defect testing in order to promote the utilization rate of wood resources. At first, this paper studied the stress wave computerized tomography technique, and introduced the straight-line tracing technique and the Algebraic Reconstruction Technique (ART) algorithm. Then, the medium model was constructed for numerical simulation analysis. The reconstruction of the medium model was conducted using straight line tracing - ART algorithm, and the impact of the number of iterations for image reconstruction accuracy was analyzed. At last, this paper validated the feasibility for two-dimensional image reconstruction of log internal defects using this method by physical model testing. Empirical and medium model results showed that the convergence of straight line tracing - ART algorithm was fast and reconstruction image was good. The two-dimensional image reconstruction of log internal defects could basically be realized using the straight line tracing-algebraic reconstruction algorithm method. And the feasibility and practicality of theory and technique that proposed in this paper were validated by practical testing.

articleTitle: Pricing competition and order coordination of supply chain with duopolistic retailers
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: This paper considers the pricing and order coordination decisions in a two- echelon supply chain with one manufacture who supplies a single product to duopolistic retailers, whose demands interact with the assumption of being price-sensitive. The problem is analyzed under the Stackelberg structure, in which the manufacture acting as a leader declares her wholesale price and a common-replenishment-epochs (CRE) schedule to competitive retailers, and the duopolistic retailers acting as followers respond with their sales prices and associated order policies. Both of the effect of CRE strategy on competitors' decisions including retail price and order policy and the effect of CRE strategy on market spit between retailers are analyzed. And the numerical example is presented to confirm all the results.

articleTitle: Study on promoting Liaoning county economic development by industrial cluster
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Through the theoretical analysis of internal relationship between industrial cluster and county economy, combining with the present developing status of Liaoning county economy, the thesis finds out the main problems and puts forward the strategies to further improve Liaoning county economic development relying on industrial cluster, in order to realize the rapid increase of Liaoning county economy and the upgrading of industrial structure. Furthermore, it gives some suggestions for the development of the backward counties to some extent.

articleTitle: Design on logistics processes of wood logistics base
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: In order to promote the development of Hailin International Wood Logistics Base, this paper firstly defines the concept of wood logistics base, secondly analyzes three key problems on the design of logistical processes: the service objects, the functions of wood logistics base and the characteristics of wood industry. Finally, three major logistical processes of wood logistics base are designed including not only the logistical process of purchasing log and quadrate timber into wood logistics base, but also the logistical process of wood products' selling in the wood-city and the logistical process of purchasing other products outside of the wood-city.

articleTitle: A study on highway network emergent resource scheduling in regional heavy snow and server rime disasters
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The natural disaster of heavy snow and server rime in winter affect people's life order by disturbing traffic. A two-stage emergency resource scheduling model was constructed to optimize the emergent resource dispatching plan, so that the limited supplies, which may ensure health and safety of the blocked staff, could reach all parts of the highway net as soon as possible. An ant colony optimization (ACO) based approach was applied to solve the first stage of the model, and a heuristic algorithm was designed to solve the second stage. At last, numerical examples were given, and in order to enhance the ACO's searching ability, zoning Fibonacci method was adopted to optimize the main parameters of the algorism. The results show that the proposed method can find the approximate optimal solution effectively.

articleTitle: A meta-model for developing business-model driven management information systems
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Aiming at solving the problem that existing model driven architecture (MDA) cannot provide effective guidance in business modeling and requirement modeling stages of developing management information system (MIS) software, this paper presented a business-model driven architecture for developing MIS software by introducing a business model component into current MDA framework. In the presented architecture, the business model consists of four types of sub-models: organization model, business process model, activity model and business document model. The relations among these sub-models were discussed and a roadmap from business model to platform specific model (PSM) was given. Then, an integrative, business-oriented meta-model for developing business-model driven MIS software was defined.

articleTitle: A new robust filter design for robust fault detection in an aerocraft's system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: A new LMI (linear matrix inequality)-based filter design methodology which can solve the multi-objective optimation problem for fault detection in LTI(linear time invariant) plants is presented. The main contributions consist of the formulation of the FD problem as a multi-objective optimization problem and the successful application in the aerocraft's closed-loop control system. The fault detection approaches proposed before mainly aim at the open-loop system. The H- index is transformed to H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">¿</sub> norm by using the residual error instead of residual in this paper, then the multi-objective problem is solved using a new LMI-based filter design methodology. Eventually, the design scheme is applied in an aerocraft's longitudinal model and the advantages of this approach are highlighted by this computational example.

articleTitle: Cost controlling for project: Drum, buffer and their quantifying
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: To quantify the bottleneck and the spatial buffer and temporal buffer, a Multi-Nominal Logistic model and a power-law model are constructed respectively after identifying the bottlenecks in the project. It is conclude that the parameters ß<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sub> in the Multi-Nominal Logistic effect the investment sizes on bottlenecks and spatial buffer, the parameter m in the scale-free model decide the sizes of temporal buffer, which makes the project synchronize in world-scale.

articleTitle: Research on quality management system for supply chain based-customer satisfaction
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: To cope with the challenges of traditional quality management system applied in supply chain, which consists of internal practices that are contained within a firm, external practices that cross organizational boundaries integrating a firm with its customers and suppliers, a quality management system for into supply chain based-customer satisfaction, and corresponding functional modules and framework were all put forward. Furthermore, some of key enabling technologies were studied in detail, including collaborative quality design based on collaborative-supported -computer-work (CSCW), dynamic process quality control, quality evaluation oriented to product lifecycle. The prototype system of the quality Management system for supply chain based-customer satisfaction was developed, which was introduced to demonstrate the rationality and validity of the method as an example of some Heavy Machinery Ltd. It provided an effective method with enterprise implementing supply chain management.

articleTitle: Input-output analysis on socio-economic benefits of highway projects case study on Jinji highway
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: This paper analyzes the main socio-economic benefits of highway projects, then based on input-output model, respectively establishes the evaluation models of direct economic benefits and indirect economic benefits. In the last of the paper, an empirical research was conducted, taking Jinji highway in Tianjin as an example. The results show that the direct economic benefit has a positive relation with the investment each year and indirect economic benefit has a significant increasing trend from the second operational year. Input-output is verified to be a simple and valid method for quantitative study of socio-economic benefits of highway projects, and it could provide theoretical basis for relevant policy making of governments.

articleTitle: Supply chain coordination model based on jointly losses bearing in tench (tinca tinca) sales
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: In the supply chain composed of tench production association and the third-party logistics provider, the third-party logistics' efforts can reduce the rate of tench going stale. Based on jointly losses bearing in tench Sales, the benefits derived from the reduction of tench going stale are primarily occupied by the tench production association, so there is not enough incentive for the third-party logistics provider. By adopting the game theory and under the conditions of either information symmetry or asymmetry, the optimal contracts can realize the supply chain coordination.

articleTitle: Study on evaluation of regional logistics system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Regional Logistics, which is the basic industry of regional economy, is the mirror of the level of regional economy development. Scientific evaluation method is of great significance. Based on the demand/supply of regional logistics which are the original driving forces and internal factors of regional logistics, and the DEA method, this paper starts a new direction, which is different from the majority studies at present. This will not only give a more scientific evaluation to the level of regional logistics, but will also contribute to the analysis of the growth mechanism of regional logistics and its relationship with regional economy.

articleTitle: Value engineering cost control of sewage treatment engineering based on LCC in the cities of north China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: With Chinese rapid economic and social development, cities are facing with water scarcity and deteriorating water environment, the sewage treatment engineering has become an increasing concern. Facing the large investment and construction of sewage treatment, operation and management difficulties, the incomplete cost system and the status of backward technology in northern cities of China, using the LCC as our guide in north China city to establish a suitable sewage treatment project construction and operation cost function perfects sewage treatment project cost system of the northern cities, and using the value engineering techniques analysises the functional consumption of the people, materials and machine in the construction and operation repeated continuously, from which the highest coefficient of option value as a basis for decision-making to control the sewage treatment engineering cost.

articleTitle: Game analysis on quality and price competition under profit funtion
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Under socialist market economy, market is taking a leading role in private higher education. As one of the most important elements in China's private higher education system, independent colleges should grasp higher education mechanism and market economy law to make education quality and corresponding charge price satisfy the demands of special consumption group and comply with the demands of competition among the colleges of the same kind. Meanwhile, independent colleges need to develop the equilibrium competition mechanism of education quality and charge price under the charge price restriction imposed by the government, therefore to achieve the maximization of social and economic benefits.

articleTitle: Studies on the winner-determination model in e-procurement based on combinatorial multi-attribute bidding and bid
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Following the tendency of economy globalization and the internationalization of market, bidding and bid is becoming the major transaction method in e-procurement market. In the multi-item procurement, the single attribute of price was the only considered evaluation standard in winner determination model of combinatorial auctions in most literatures, but it could not solve the problem of multi-attribute procurement. In this paper, we provided a winner-determination model and optimization method based on combinatorial multi-attribute bidding and bid in multi-item procurement. The winner determination problem could be described as 0-1 integer programming model and solved with tabu search algorithm. And the reliability & superiority of the model is demonstrated by means of an example and the analysis of the results.

articleTitle: Research on the five-stage method for Chinese enterprises to implement lean production
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Since 1980s, more and more enterprises in Chinese Mainland have deployed lean production in consideration of its great success in other countries, but only a few of them became successful examples of lean production in Chinese Mainland. Although there are many reasons for the failure, the paper finds that the wrong doings of Chinese enterprises in implementing lean production is one of the main reasons; typically many of them want to build a Rome in a day. The paper proposes a five-stage method for Chinese enterprises to carry out lean production step by step including the tools configured for each stage. We hope the method will assist enterprises in Chinese mainland in deploying lean production successfully.

articleTitle: Design of the input-output model toolbox in Matlab
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Matlab is a high-performance language for scientific and technical computing. It integrates computation, visualization, and programming in an environment which provides many specific toolboxes. Different toolboxes can be used in corresponding areas, such as math, control theory, economics. We described the design of the Leontief input-output model toolbox which can simulate the trajectories of input and output of economic systems and automatically control the run of economic systems. By means of mathematic methods, the Leontief input-output systems were directly treated without converted to general systems. A sufficient condition under which the Leontief input-output models are stable is investigated. Based on this, the control algorithm is derived. Finally, the code of the input-output toolbox is provided.

articleTitle: Application of computer simulation in logistics packaging material
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The relation between logistics and packaging was elaborated. As an important packaging material, the conformation property of polymer material attracts more and more widespread attention. The conformation property of polymer material in logistics packaging was simulated with computer simulation technology. The application of computer simulation in logistics packaging material was realized with the simulation on the size and shape of the packaging polymer material.

articleTitle: Scheduling with fixed delivery dates and temporary storage
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: We considered the single machine scheduling with fixed delivery dates and temporary storage. The objective is to minimize the sum of the makespan and the total inventory costs. We showed that the problem is strongly NP-hard and polynomial-time approximation algorithm with a fixed performance ratio does not exist for the problem unless P=NP. A polynomial 3/2-approximation algorithm for the case with period delivery times was presented and the performance ratio of 3/2 can not be improved unless P=NP.

articleTitle: Evaluation on Collector-Distributor Service Network of Comprehensive Passenger Transportation Hub
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The pedestrian behaviors in Comprehensive Passenger Transportation Hub (CPTH) were taken as the research object, and Beijing South Railway Station was taken as the study background. The Collector-Distributor processes were classified hierarchically into three levels, and then the several processes were simulated. The Collector-Distributor Service Network (CDSN)'s service ability of CPTH was evaluated dynamically during the rush hours. The bottlenecks of CDSN were found after the simulations, the improvement measures to relieve bottlenecks were proposed, and then the simulations were done again to prove the improvement measures are very efficient by analyzing and comparing.

articleTitle: Construction mechanism of flexible distribution center
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: This paper based on flexible thinking to devise new operating model for distribution center construction, posed the concept of flexible distribution center, and analyzed the main operational features from multiple aspects, proposed the primary principles for building flexible distribution center that need to meet constraint and DBR theory in complicate environment, where customer demand became diversified and different, and market demand growing uncertainty. These new changes hardly adapt by the single-function distribution center, since rigidified operating process and poor adjustability. Flexible distribution center model is a new concept to solve these problems and meet various demands agilely.

articleTitle: Research on TPL business select based on conjoint analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: This paper, through analyzing the current situation of TPL enterprises, proposes to compare a variety of business about logistics enterprises with conjoint analysis. And it finds that different logistics enterprises should focus on different business. Then, according to empirical research, it draws relevant conclusions and makes theoretical guidance for the enterprises to achieve a more reasonable business choice.

articleTitle: Economic benefits of enterprise resources planning (ERP)- based on empirical evidence from Chinese listed companies
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Can ERP software bring users economic benefits during a company's operational management? This paper adopts revised value chain method to construct a set of indicators. Using listed companies that implement ERP as samples and the implementation year as the starting point, it compares the value of companies three years before the implementation of ERP and two years after implementation of ERP and testifies it. In order to guarantee the reliability of the conclusion, it uses statistical analysis on the single variable and the multi-variance to test the results. The results show that if the effect of the industry and size factors is left out of account, the IT(Inventory Turnover), FAT(Fixed Asset Turnover), SC (Sales Changes) of companies that implement ERP system are obviously higher than those have not implemented it; the economic benefits of ERP users are better than the non-users; all the economic indicators of ERP users do not show obvious performance change in the implementation year. In the first year of implementing ERP, SC (Sales Changes) and RRE (return on equity ratio) change obviously, showing that ERP brings some economic benefits to users; in the second year of implementing ERP, besides higher SC and FAT than non-users, only ART(Accounts Receivable Turnover) and APT(Accounts Payable Turnover) change obviously, showing ERP brings in changes in users' market and sales segment, but other indicators do not change obviously.

articleTitle: Design and realization of route control system in railway system based on simulation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The simulation research for the route control system in an industrial railway system is presented in this paper. The method of schedule indications analysis with integration of locomotive-position-task is proposed. In this method, the proper schedule instructions received are divided into three layers, which solve the problem of incomplete analysis for schedule indications effectively. An improved Dijkstra algorithm is applied, which improves the efficiency of route search remarkably. Finally, the simulation platform of the route control system in a railway system is researched and developed. The system has a good stability, in which average opening time of routes is less than 100 ms, which lays the foundation for building the real route control system.

articleTitle: Energy consumption assessment by AIA based time series scatter degree method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: To enlarge the difference of assessment values for energy consumption in equipment manufacturing industry among varied time, AIA based time series scatter degree method (AIA/TSSDM) is proposed so as to improve the energy consumption assessment performance. The comprehensive solution for energy consumption assessment by AIA/TSSDM is presented. AIA is introduced to adapt the conventional scatter degree method, and overcome the disadvantage of generating negative weights. In AIA, the scatter degree method oriented encoding system for antigens and antibodies is designed, the antibody density calculation is described. Several typical operators such as selecting, crossover and mutation are discussed, and the detail implement steps of AIA/TSSDM are designed. The energy consumption for equipment manufacturing industry in Shenyang city is take as research background, the above presented algorithm is applied. Comparing with conventional AHP, the difference of energy consumption assessment values for equipment manufacturing industry on varied years is enlarged. And solution diversity can be kept by introducing AIA in this algorithm so as to provide multi typical weight vectors.

articleTitle: Creation of customer value innovation with refined service: Taking ABC life logistics company in Taiwan as an example
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: This study aimed to discuss how to incorporate the concept of customer value and value innovation in life logistics services by case study, and redefined and developed an innovative service business strategy model in life logistic companies. The results provide a business model with three stages (preparation, construct model, and construct strategy). The value innovation of life logistics companies is based on customer-oriented concepts, including three operational directions, which are business operational beliefs, integrated information systems, high-quality service teams and mechanisms. With regard to the promotion of value innovation, a market gap must be recognized first, and after defining its position, a value innovation service model and executive strategy are further constructed. In the innovative process, three key success factors (conceptual innovation, 3C technology, and precise position) should be the bases to fully support and fulfill innovative service, and achieve value innovation.

articleTitle: Research on the construction of innovative province, cities and reginal innovations system-a case of Heilongjiang Province
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Regional innovation system is the key to maintain competitive advantage and the basis of national innovation system. Especially in the transition of economic conditions, regional innovation environment, innovation subject, innovation input, innovation system all need to be improved to adapt to the demands of the new situation. The literature, quantitative and comparative analysis methods are applied in this paper to discuss the innovation evaluation system of innovation provinces and cities deeply, and evaluate the innovation ability of Heilongjiang Province. The conclusion can be drawn that: innovation policy and environment are very important, and the consciousness and behavior of innovation subject is the key factor, the provincial capital cities should play a leading role to increase the investment of innovation in order to promote the construction and development of the regional innovation system.

articleTitle: Study on the price mechanism and the policies of government for integration a rice supply chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The price mechanism among the nodes of a rice 3-stage supply chain is studied based on the threshold co-integration model. Firstly, the mechanism shows that there is a central market of rice origin. So there are long-term cointegration and short-term cointegration between the price in the central market and the other price origin and the price of processor respectively. There is a central market of polished rice in the place of processor. So there are long-term cointegration and short-term cointegration between the price in the central market and the price in the place of partly origin and the price in the place of wholesalers respectively. There is long-term cointegration, but short-term un-cointegration, between the price of rice and the price of polished rice in the place of processor. So the prices in the place of partly origin, processor and wholesalers can be forecasted in short-term by the threshold cointegration model. The mechanism presents the pricing basis for the nodes of the supply chain. Secondly, based on the mechanism, government regulation should be put on the price of rice in the place of origin and the price of polished rice in the place of processor highlight. The government intervene the unusual fluctuations of prices between the different markets which are not short-term cointegration. The intervention has threshold features. The government's policies should regulate the system of the supply chain to promote the integration of the supply chain.

Author Keywords: The Integration of the Supply Chain

articleTitle: CCERW: A new prediction rule to identify treatment failure patients with community-acquired pneumonia for middle aged and elderly
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: To develop and validate a clinical prediction rule to identify treatment failure patients with community-acquired pneumonia(CAP) for middle aged and elderly in China, data from the patients aged ¿ 45 yrs with CAP in derivation cohort, internal validation cohort and external validation cohort were analysed by the methods of univariate analysis, multivariate analysis and receiver operating curve. The results showed a prediction rule CCERW based on five independent factors (i.e., confusion; creatinine <60 ¿mol/L; electrolyte disturbances; respiratory failure; WBC > 7.5 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">9</sup>/L) which correlated with treatment failure had better predictive capability than PSI, CURB65 and CRB65, and can be used in middle aged and elderly patients with CAP of Han people in China.

articleTitle: Hybrid flowshop scheduling with setup times for cold treating process in Baoshan Iron & Steel Complex
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Seamless steel tube, including multi-variety and multi-specification products, requires variously complicated operations in the whole production process, especially in the cold treating process (CTP). This paper takes the seamless tube plant of Baoshan Iron and Steel Complex as the research background. Considering the practical production constraints, CTP scheduling problem can be viewed as a hybrid flowshop scheduling problem with sequence-dependent setup time. We formulate it as a non-linear mixed integer programming model(NMIP) with multi-objectives. Then a two-stage heuristic algorithm based on modified GA and local search method is proposed to get near-optimal solution of large-scale NMIP problem. Finally, computation experiments with real production instance are carried out to test the efficiency and performance of algorithm. The simulation results show that proposed model and algorithm can be implemented as an effective method to generate optimized scheduling scheme in the CTP scheduling system.

articleTitle: Internal traffic organization analysis of Multi-storey logistics warehouse
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: YIWU Inland Port Logistics Center is planned as a Multi-storey storage warehouse of commodity use winding path to solve three-dimensional traffic organization. This article used the analogy analysis and forecasted sub-types of vehicles traffic and peak hour traffic volume, analyzed the impact the characteristics of truck traffic flow and parking access to the channel capacity, compared the two kinds of series-type and fishbone-type traffic organization models, and put forward that the fishbone-style layout was more suitable for such commodity logistics center at last.

articleTitle: Balance problem research of the mixed model assembly line
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Aiming at balancing the load of assembly line and the consumption rate of parts, establishing a multi-objective model of mixed assembly line. Using simulated annealing algorithm which can effectively solve NP-hard combinatorial optimization problems to solve production sequencing problem and to balance the assembly line. By analyzing the example results in different scaled from NEH and simulated annealing algorithm, verifying the effectiveness that simulated annealing algorithm can get better solution than NEH.

articleTitle: Research on location methods of RDC in high-density logistics network points
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Many large enterprises are establishing high-density logistics network points to improve customer satisfaction. From the point of logistics efficiency increases, it is an effective method. But it also results in repeated construction. To avoid increasing logistics cost and wasting social resources, a method based on Self-Organizing Feature Map and Baumol-Wolfe model is used. Compared to general location methods, its innovative point is the combined use of cluster analysis, and its result can be easily got by using Matlab and successive-approximation algorithm. In the end, a practical calculation example is used to analyze the feasibility and superiority of this method.

articleTitle: Research of energy flow in net social ecology system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Network society is a new social form driven by the information technology as a representative of the computer and Internet technology. Network society is similar to the ecological system. Not only is its internal structure a hierarchical structure, according to the whole, but also the energy flow is the important motive mechanism. Based on the ecology theory, with interdisciplinary research and analysis, this paper expounds the energy flow process of the formation and development of the network social ecology system. It puts forward the main three kinds of energy flow in network social ecology system-information, capital and value. At the same time, based on the dynamic equation, the paper establishes the energy flow compartment model to analyze the change trends of energy flow in the instantaneous and regular rate in network social ecology system. Finally, this paper studies the online game ecosystem which is a representative subsystem in the network social ecology system as an example.

articleTitle: Performance optimizing for high education resources: A statistical model applied in Heilongjiang province
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: To identify the fittest quantity for every higher education resources in Heilongjiang province, a surface model is constructed based on collected data in 20 years, 15 vectors and the corresponding multinomial equation. Firstly, the vectors are integrated to human capital, material capital, intellectual capital and intangible capital, which have been reconstructed from the original data. Considering the performance of teaching and studying respectively, an integrated one is get to make the dependence variable, and the corresponding parameters are get by least square method. At last, joint analyzing the factual situation of Heilongjiang Province's high education resource, the fittest resources are adjusted from the quantity get by the model.

articleTitle: Collusion-proof under yardstick competition: A discriminatory scheme
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: An important limitation of yardstick competition is due to its susceptibility to collusive manipulation. The degree which the regulated firms manage to conspire is affected by the particulars of the scheme. The incentives for collusion among firms when an industry is regulated by means of yardstick competition are analysed in a Principal-Agent framework, and we propose the optimal collusion-proof contract is to introduce a ¿discriminatory scheme¿ in the sense that it can improve the efficiency of yardstick competition by developing interest conflict among the regulated firms.

articleTitle: The evaluation of logistics development level in Daqing based on DEA
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: As the resource-based cities, Daqing will develop logistics industry in the transition. This paper hereby proposed the evaluation model of logistics development level by DEA, and pointed out the development direction and improvement methods for Daqing logistics industry based on the contrastive analysis among three typical cities in domestic.

articleTitle: Analysis on distribution efficiency influencing factors of supermarket bases on interpretive structural model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Distribution, in the rational economy regions, refers to the activities for goods, such as selection, processing, packaging, separation, assembling, according to customer's requirements, and delivering goods to the designated places on time. Through the management of distribution, it can improve distribution efficiency and inventory turns, speed up the circulation of commodities and lower costs. There are so many influencing factors of efficiency in the process of distribution that we need to analyze these influencing factors scenically. In this paper, for the reality prevailing problems in distribution efficiency. We established a model based on the ISM to analysis influencing factors of distribution efficiency. Through the establishment of ISM model, making a conclusion based on the results of experts advices and market survey, then we have the relationship between each factors. Through we analysis adjacency matrix, reachability matrix, reduced matrix, backbone matrix and hierarchical directed graph between the various influencing factors step by step, then we get the surface influencing factors, middle influencing factors and deep-seated influencing factors. Finally, based on factors we derived from the analysis conclusion, we provide some comments and suggestions to distribution companies.

Author Keywords: Analysis Influencing Factors of Distribution Efficiency

articleTitle: Research on building Harbin into logistics center from Northeast- Asian perspective
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: By seizing the opportunity of the country to speed up border opening and expansion of domestic demand to keep an important growth, with the increasingly close cooperation in Northeast Asia, it is necessary to develop modern logistics industry vigorously, and to strengthen the center city's service function and international competitiveness. Based on the study of markets in Harbin, the freight volume of Harbin was forecasted through the methods such as the average growth rate, elastic coefficient, output value and freight volume estimation, and regression analysis, etc. A strategy was put forward, that is to set up an important logistics centre, based in Harbin, served Heilongjiang Province, highlighted Russian, and opened to Northeast Asia as well.

articleTitle: Short-term traffic flow prediction based on grid computing pool model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Traffic flow prediction is one of the important research areas in intelligent transportation system. The key point of dynamic route guidance system is the accurate and prompt information about transportation prediction. The article analyses the characteristics of short-term traffic flow prediction, proposes an optimal resource service method that based on grid computing pool model, builds a traffic flow prediction model based on this method, and predicts the traffic by using genetic algorithm based on higher-order generalized neural networks. In the traffic flow prediction process, the optimal resource service method on the basis of grid computing pool model is utilized to automatically request the best CPU under the current status in traffic information platform to perform the prediction, in order to enhance the service quality and efficiency.

articleTitle: Logistics network design based on Value Constellation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: With the development of information technology and the complexity of intertwined interests, traditional logistics management based on value chain has been unable to meet the needs of modern logistics management. In this paper, firstly, the traditional logistics network and its problems were depicted; Then considering all benefit counterparts, the idea of the logistics network was developed and a modern logistics management network was built based on the Value Constellation, which was helpful in improving the management of modern logistics.

articleTitle: Research on DO control based on Fuzzy Smith-PID controller for sewage disposal
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Considering the characteristics of the time-delay, inertia and time-varying of the dissolved oxygen (DO) control in the sewage disposal process, a Fuzzy Smith-PID control model is proposed based on the analysis of the regular PID and Fuzzy control in this paper, which integrates the advantages of the high robustness of the Fuzzy controller, the compensation of the time delay problem of Smith Estimation Machine and the high accuracy of PID controller. Simulation results show that this complex strategy has good robustness and stability in both of the model matching and mismatching situation, and provides an effective way to solve the problem of the time-delay, inertia and time-varying for sewage disposal system.

articleTitle: Stability analysis of series repairable system with two components
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The series repairable system with two components is studied in the paper. By the method of strong continuous semi-group, the paper analyzed the restriction of essential spectral growth bound of the system operator. The essential spectral radius of the system operator is also discussed before and after perturbation. The results show that the dynamic solution of the system is exponential stability and tends to the steady solution of the system.

articleTitle: Research on the optimal distribution choosing problem of military logistics in disaster rescue based on indefinite information
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The emergency disaster event occur suddenly and need support urgently, the time request of the military logistics is urgent. As the transportation system is influenced by uncertain factors, its military logistics system has obvious grey characteristic. This article has built one new grey critical path model using the grey system theory by uniting the standard grey number and the operational rule with the classic critical path-method. Through the research, we see this model can differentiate the heterogeneity critical path and efficiently, increase the precision of confirming critical path, it is benefit to optimize the resources disposition. Through the case study, the paper verified the effectiveness of this model, and enhanced the validity of critical path-method choosing base on indefinite information.

articleTitle: Empirical study of operational performance for public transport in Hebei Province based on DEA
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Objective and impartial evaluation of operational performance for urban public transport has a great influence on transportation development in city. Based on the analysis of the influencing factors of operational performance for public transport, an empirical study of operational performance for public transport in Hebei Province is brought out by DEA. And the analysis finds out that there are only 20% cities which are scale efficiency. Based on the projection analysis, the main reason of scale inefficiency is the lack of the total amount passenger transport, therefore, this paper puts forward some specific recommendations to solve this problem. Thus it could be useful for the government to make relevant policies to improve the operational performance for public transport.

articleTitle: Identifying the key competitive factors in Chinese manufacturing enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Firstly, it investigated manufacturing enterprises how to identify the key factors of their competitive priority according to the environments both inside and outside. And then, taking company A as an example, it made an empirical study to identify the key factors of manufacturers' competitive priority. Finally, by constructing a quantitative model, indexes of key competitiveness are quantified to be arranged in a priority order.

articleTitle: Research on SMEs' transformation and upgrading strategies
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: This paper firstly introduces the status, role and current development of SMEs in China's economy and then further studies the reasons for SMEs' transformation and upgrading. Based on this, the paper suggests countermeasures to be adopted by SMEs, such as strategy selection, technological innovation, talent development, management operation and brand building, to realize transformation and upgrading, and also proposes countermeasures to be adopted by the government and the society.

articleTitle: Research on self-directed innovation path from OEM to ODM, OBM in enterprise
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The process from OEM to ODM and then to OBM is a kind of process from importation, digestion, copy to self-directed innovation in fact, as well as a kind of process of technology accumulation and technology learning. The innovation in most enterprises with emerging economy started from OEM, then gradually turned into ODM and OBM after accumulating certain capital and technology. Companies should accumulate their own R&D abilities gradually during the period of producing, form their property rights based, then on this basis do self-directed innovation and crate their own brand, accomplish the process development from OEM to ODM and OBM.

articleTitle: Production line improvement based on machining process
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The machining process of the second gear in gearbox was taken as an object of study. First, by means of work study technology, the machining process of the second gear was analyzed, and from the view of the production line balance, the bottleneck processes were selected through measurement of standard time.
