Then, the existing processes were adjusted, and the idea of operational design improvement and eliminating waste in operation was proposed to optimize the production process, the following effects are obtained: the rate of production line balance is raised 67.5%; the output is raised from 205 to 370 per day; the average output per person is raised from 25 to 41. The bottlenecks in process are eliminated and the production order is improved.

articleTitle: The BOT mode in transportation investment and its control strategy
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: There is a disagreement on profits among the related parties of BOT mode transportation infrastructure construction. By analyzing the goals, beneficial points and resource conditions of both government and chief contractors, this paper proposed a Game-Equilibrium Model on BOT-mode transportation infrastructure construction concerned investing and financing economy, social benefits analysis and price-decision policy. As the conclusion, it puts forward a best corresponding programmed between the government and the contractors under a particular condition. It also gives us some theoretical support on policy-making among the related parties on transportation infrastructure construction.

articleTitle: A new experimental method for behavioral finance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: This article introduces a new instrument for financial experiment called Investor Behavior Test and Analysis Platform (IBTAF), trying to establish a more scientific system for experimental studies in behavioral finance. This method creates a new way to do researches in trading behavioral characteristics of individuals and groups, particularly some extreme cases in real market can be simulated once and once again. Our platform is an independent trading matching and executing system with flexible and multi-functional controlling conditions. Here, we describe how to design the experiment under controlled conditions. Finally, we share an empirical experiment focusing on how the investor's behavior influenced by the changes of prices; also the experimental results are reported.

articleTitle: The applied research of ERP in logistics management of petroleum company
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Oil material supplies in the oil fields' production and construction plays an important role. It is significant to manage the materials using the theory and method of ERP. In this paper, with the use of computer and network information technology, we research and developed the ERP system based on WEB in logistics management of a petroleum company. It is actualized to plan, organize and control the purchase, repertory and use of all materials. And the enterprise acquired a huge profitability by using ERP.

articleTitle: Mechanism research on logistics industry impacting on Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei urban economic circle economy
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: With the development of China's economy as well as the improvement of the reform and opening-up's level, the status of logistics industry in our economy also has been strengthened continuously. As an integrated industry which combined service with device fabrication, logistics industry has an obvious influence on the regional economies. Adapting to system dynamics, the elements of the logistics industry impacting on regional economy development based on Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei urban economy circle, a typical economy circle in China is studied; the causality between supply capacity of the regional logistics based on the factors effect and regional economic system is crystallizes, and the mechanism of the effect that regional logistics of Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei Urban Economic Circle acts on the regional GDP is analyzed. The research results have a realistic significance on understanding the effect mechanism of various factors and factors adjustment grounded on the development of regional logistics industry's impact on Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei Urban Economic Circle to improve economic growth in policy-making.

articleTitle: A study on inventory cost reduction based on economic order quantity model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: This paper conducts an in-depth analysis of three models derived from economic order quantity (EOQ) model in an effort to reduce high inventory cost associated with the IT commodities sold in one of the Carrefour supermarket outlets. These three models are: 1. model of lots ordered and delivered independently, 2. model of lots ordered and delivered jointly, and 3. model of lots ordered and delivered for a selective subset. Mathematically, these three models are carefully discussed and compared in this paper. The third EOQ-based model contains more selective procedures combining the commodities to be ordered jointly in an order schedule and with that may lead to an optimal solution for its lowest cost.

articleTitle: Research on the revelation mechanism of status of partners' infrastructure in logistics enterprise alliance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Partners in logistics enterprise alliance show the true state of its infrastructure, which is the premise to achieve efficient operation of the alliance. In the practice, the partners maybe don't show their real status of infrastructure in pursuit of maximizing their own interests. Based on theory of mechanism design and revelation mechanism in game theory, this paper establishes principal-agent model in order to maximize the central logistics enterprises' interests. The model spurs partners to be honest by punishing partners who can not show their true state of infrastructure, and makes them unprofitable. The empirical analysis of this model has been verified.

articleTitle: The efficiency of outsourcing analysis in JIT production model with on-line problems
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: On-line problems research work has becoming a hot work direction to the Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management. It can also used on efficiency analysis in JIT working activities. The cost calculating and saving in Just-in-time product model is not very clearly before, Long-term studies on the JIT costing in enterprises were built on static financial indicators, it lacks of dynamic thinking and processing. For enterprises, according to the analysis of outsourcing cost on the JIT run model, through the introduction of Spatial Economics and the "Iceberg Theory¿, With the parties competitive ratio ¿C¿ which affected by a comprehensive analysis of the cost involved in JIT activities, it has a more comprehensive grasp which led to improved technical methods on business efficiency and competitiveness of cost accounting. This can play some reference for business outsourcing decision-making. Allow enterprises to know how much difference in their cost saving on the complete outsourcing or not.

articleTitle: The system optimization rationing of instantaneous equilibrium resources
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: To realize the system optimization planning for instantaneous equilibrium resources, a mathematical model for programming them, according to some popular resource views generally used in modern macroeconomics, especially in generating system long-term programming, was introduced. The breakeven points of suppliers, with different economic features are described in an programming problem, where objectivity and constraints are constructed according to the analysis on the actual situation, furthermore, the couple variables of Kuhn-Tucker conditions of the model are obtained. Through the demonstration of a loading equivalence theorem combining the demand curves and demand mass curves, the time-point information is acquired in the sequence which the traditional technique lost. This method can be applied to microcosmic sphere effectively and it is worth spreading after practice in several years.

articleTitle: Research on Bertrand dual-oligopoly dynamic game model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: By difference equation, we study the equilibrium solution and the dynamic change process of the Bertrand price competition model under the same condition of duopolistic market cost, give the model of dynamic change, come to the conclusion that whatever manufactures choose about price the equilibrium solution only exists, and prove that the manufacture's price change process must be the monotonic process, and develop relative conclusions of the Bertrand model.

articleTitle: The development of the fixture of the float brake caliper based on 3D design
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: According to the technological requirements of float disc brake caliper during processing, special fixture of the caliper is researched based on 3D design in this paper. Through the design and kinematics simulation for special fixture 3D model, it is convenient to forecast assembly interference of lathe fixture and add the mass of lead brick accurately before prototype is made. Therefore, it solves the vibration problem of special fixture due to the unbalance mass and improves the run-out tolerance precision of cylinder hole of the workpiece compared with machine tool spindle. These means ensure the processing quality of the cylinder hole in brake caliper.

articleTitle: Research and design of incentive mechanism for managers
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Mathematical analysis method is utilized to design incentive mechanism for managers under the asymmetric information as well as monitoring system analysis method, as a result of expanding the framework of incentive mechanism. The result shows that, there is a relationship between monitoring mechanism and incentive mechanism. They can motivate or direct managers to work hard and interchangeable by the other one. As a result, it is necessary to consider both monitoring mechanism and incentive mechanism when organization makes the reward system. With the development of monitoring mechanism, it not only has an innovative theory, but also has a great worth in practice.

articleTitle: A self-adjusting PID control and its application in paper-making enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Most of PID controllers could not work well due to its parameters, so a PID parameters' self-adjusting method, modified A-H arithmetic, was introduced. This method can adjust the PID parameters very well. It adjusts PID controller's parameters by cross point of object's Nyquist curve and negative imaginary axis. It has good identification result to time-delay process. We used it in evaporation procedure's control successfully and effectively. The result shows that this parameters' adjusting method of control system can work in an optimal state and has practical significance.

articleTitle: The workshop management system design to enterprise information
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Through analyzing the enterprise information problems and taking one enterprise as the example, the article introduced the function and characteristic of the workshop management system to the enterprise information. On basis of the analysis, the author designed and developed the workshop management controller, realized some kinds of features, such as production plan, artwork, working hours, the acceptance of materials, preparation and management, production orders issued, the production of feedback information, statistics production, and so on.

articleTitle: Research and realization of access control methods for class-oriented and object-oriented
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Through building PDM managerial classes' model, authorization management is organized based on PDM system's function modules. Inheritance methods of PDM managerial classes and the operations assign modes of PDM managerial classes are discussed. Access control model is organized. Through discussing the relationship of mutually tables in database, rules of access authorization control is analyzed. Class-oriented access control and object-oriented access control are realized, and mult-authorization setting for a class data and a instance are completed. The flow chart of roles assignment, the flow chart of the user's activities in PDM system and the flow chart of authorization validation are given. The methods of authorization setting are simple and criterion, and the operational efficiency of PDM system is improved.

articleTitle: Henan post logistics service innovation and market expansion
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: This paper points out advantages and weaknesses of the postal logistics network in Henan. The former covering business credit intermediary, intangible assets; the latter including management, market mechanism, operating mechanism, external competitiveness, and so on. And on the basis of these analyses we have explored ways in advantages using and disadvantage overcoming which cover the service innovation, market expansion, etc. Continuously improving the delivery network is playing a great role to use network distribution advantages, as well as working with information industry to achieve vertical integration, with other enterprises to make relevant regional joints, to integrate logistics businesses within the postal operations; speeding up the household mailbox construction, establishing the postal household services company, mainly aiming at the rural post market; developing e-commerce- based services for innovation and market expansion.

articleTitle: An expert system for security diagnosing of construction producing by CBR
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: For improving systematization degree and efficiency of security diagnosing for construction producing, the flow of security diagnosing for construction producing system by CBR is designed. By analyzing the security influence factors for construction production systemically, the case presentation technology for security diagnosing for construction producing is designed, and the case retrieval, case adaptation and case maintenance technologies are respectively studied. To test performance, random selection and case maintenance experiment modes are respectively designed, the system running result shows that under the second mode, average case retrieval ratio increases more and average case adaptation ratio decreases more with the increasing of case base scale. The obvious advantage of CBR is validated, the more the system is employed, the better performance it will appear.

articleTitle: On cooperation and competition between upstream and downstream companies in supply chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: This article explores the competition relationship between three subjects: suppliers, manufacturers and retailers in light of perceptions of competition and cooperation in game theory. It is structured in two parts. First part is an analysis on a two-tier competition mode between suppliers and retailers; in the second part, suppliers are added therein and three-tier competition mode is established, next the analysis is conducted by categorizing retailers' activities into two kinds: cooperation and competion; As for targeted retailers, which are the main subject for discussion, due to the fact that optional upstream manufacturers are unsame and prices and quantities of products they provide are different, retailers have to determine quantity of goods to purchase according to actual costs. The major intent of this article is to, from the perspective of retailers, via formulating a game mode, through testing of reference data, examine a variety of forms of retailers' copetition under game theory.

articleTitle: Research on the relation between GUANXI culture and the stability of entrepreneurial supply chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Partnership management has become a hot issue of corporation management in recent years. This paper analyzes the structure of partnership of entrepreneurial supply chain (ESC) and the influential factors of its stability combining the principles of relation management and the characteristic of GUANXI culture. Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) is used to examine how various types of factors of GUANXI can be beneficial to the stability of partnership of ESC. Theoretical and managerial implications are discussed in the conclusion.

articleTitle: Logistics mode reengineering of hospital materials based on JIT theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The logistics management of hospital materials is very important to ensure the normal operation and reduce operating costs. After analyzing the shortcomings of the traditional management mode of hospital materials, which is based on inventory-driven, a systematic and integrated logistics management mode of hospital materials based on the theory of JIT and SCM is established to reduce the total cost of materials management and improve work efficiency. The steps and success factors of logistics mode reengineering are discussed in detail. At last, a real implemented case is provided to validate the effect of the mode.

articleTitle: Study on the optimization model of logistics industry alliance based of the game theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Logistics industry dynamic alliance is the special products or services delivery process which a number of enterprises within the demand network system cooperate and collaborate under specific conditions and certain relationship. The reasonable profit distribution among the members of logistics dynamic alliance should be the foundation of successful steady collaboration network and it is essential to set up rational profit-sharing regulation among the members of logistics dynamic alliance. In this paper, according to Nash equilibrium theory, the optimum profit-sharing coefficient among the members of logistics industry dynamic alliance is derived under the cooperation and collaboration basis and reasonable quantitative strategy for profit distribution could be implemented.

articleTitle: Research for logistics outsourcing based on value chain promotion
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Many enterprises considered logistics outsourcing as an important strategy. The logistics outsourcing should cut the cost, reduce the investment and make the enterprise concern on the core business. The demand for logistics outsourcing was scarce, and this became the obstacle for Chinese logistics industry. The theory of global value chain was the instrument for researching on manufacture outsourcing. In view of the difference between logistics outsourcing and manufacture outsourcing, the theory can not be put into the study of logistics outsourcing. In order to extend the logistics outsourcing, the paper presents the proposition of logistics outsourcing value chain, building the control method, driving mechanism. The logistics enterprise can achieve the promotion by improving service function, cooperate relationship in carrying on the logistics business.

articleTitle: An empirical study on the ownership choice of Chinese MNEs
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: On the international expanding model choice, little attention had been paid to the MNEs from developing countries. Drawing on a sample of 279 overseas subsidiaries invested by Chinese MNEs, the paper examines the factors of influencing the choice between wholly owned subsidiary and joint venture. The binomial logistic regression results show that the host countries' risk, the resource-based industry and the model of establishment have significant positive impact on the preference of joint venture. As a special consideration, the Central Stated-owned Enterprises prefer to choose joint ventures also. Moreover, unlike the MNEs from developed countries, the Chinese MNEs with high R&D intensity are more likely to set up international joint ventures.

articleTitle: Robust design based on model of product design quality
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Nowadays, enterprises continually realize that perfect quality of products is not achieved by manufacturing, but by designing. Therefore, it is necessary to start from the headwaters of quality. That is to say, product quality must be controlled from design phase. Taguchi Method is just the most powerful weapon in improving design quality. In this paper, mainly started from the fluctuation theory, the design model of product quality is put forward. To reduce tolerance and to reach zero defects with great efforts, it is the necessary by implementing robust design. Therefore, the thrice design (system design, parameter design and tolerance design) is just the most way for reaching the above targets. In this paper, the basic concept and principle connected with implementing Thrice Design are profoundly discussed.

articleTitle: Study on forecasting method of highway port cargo volume
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: According to the problem of predicting highway port freight volume, the BP neural network combination forecasting model is proposed based on the study of commonly used forecasting methods including time series forecast, gray system forecast and combination forecast method. Combined with the freight traffic condition of Suifenhe highway port, the combination forecasting model is verified. The experimental results indicate that this method is very effective to forecast the highway freight.

articleTitle: The study of extensible intelligent reasoning sufficient conditions
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Incomplete information intelligent processing extensible algorithm, is a new algorithm that can simulate the thinking process of the human brain. Through the analysis of the characteristics and objective object, puts forward the information full degree, Related domain, the common features of object, the individual features of object, characteristic vector concepts etc., and discussed the sufficient condition to distinct objects in the data class under the incomplete condition, and puts forward the method of constructing diagnosis experience database which could simplify condition. The sufficient conditions of Extensible intelligent reasoning could make it possible that intelligent reasoning is in progress successfully under the condition of incomplete data and the reasoning results are correct. This research is verified by intelligent diagnostic tests of TCM.

articleTitle: The comparison of animation industries of US, Japan, South Korea And China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: China's animation market is very large, but compared to the animation-advanced countries like US, Japan and South Korea, China still has problems in our animation industry chain, of which the most important is ineffective industry chain. First the concept of animation industry chain was introduced, then the traits of US, Japanese and South Korean animation industry chain were shown and compared with each other. Based on the comparision of these animation-advanced countries' animation industry chains, three Chinese future animation industry chains were proposed.

articleTitle: A multi-location inventory model for service parts with lateral transshipment and waiting time constraints
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The trade-off between service cost and service level had become a core problem in the field of inventory management. A multi-item multi-location inventory model was formed for service parts with waiting time constraints. In the inventory system, the continuous-review policy was used. The goal of the paper was to look for an optimal stock for each local warehouse under the target service which was presented by an aggregate mean waiting time constraints per local warehouse. Steps of the efficient heuristics were given at the end of this paper. The model is of great meaning to improve the service as well as to decrease the cost for service parts.

articleTitle: A study on coordinate relationship between economic and logistics demand based on improved elastic coefficient
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Now the rapid development of modern logistics industry is causing more and more concerns. The relationship of coordinated development between logistics and economy also becomes one of the focuses gradually. In this paper, system dynamics has been adopted to study the theory of economic pulling logistics demand, and the relationship of coordinated development between logistics and economy has been discussed according to the method of elastic coefficient, which is based on the predecessor's qualitative analysis and quantitative regression analysis.

articleTitle: Applying grey relation clustering and PCA to performance evaluation of vendors in fresh milk supply chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The complexity and limited data samples in performance evaluation of vendors in fresh milk supply chain are an obstacle for traditional evaluation method. This paper studied the performance evaluation methods for vendors in fresh milk supply chain by grey relation clustering and principal components analysis. Three major fresh milk supply vendor and typical evaluation indexes of fresh milk supply chain were selected to illustrate this evaluation. The result shows that principal components analysis is suitable for complex indexes in fresh milk supply chain and grey relation clustering can be a valuable method to determine the best vendor under limited data samples conditions.

articleTitle: The game playing of port co-opetition Between Hong Kongand Shenzhen based on AHP
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Hong Kong and Shenzhen, the two world-class ports, are widely considered as two drive engines in the Pearl River Delta of China, which push forward the economic development of the region as well. However, the two ports are presently faced with fierce competition from each other due to being located in a same region. A new game playing model based on AHP is put forward in this paper to solve port co-opetition Between Hong Kong and Shenzhen. By setting up an index system about port co-opetition ability of Hong Kong and Shenzhen, a game playing result, which can maximize the benefits of both parties, is obtained after analyzing strategic game playing process.

articleTitle: Potential for regional economic development of China based on weighted principal components TOPSIS valuation function model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: China has made remarkable achievements since the reform and opening up for 30 years, simultaneously development gaps between regions are widening gradually. In order to narrow the development gap between regions and promote coordinated development of region economy, China should analyze the potential for regional economic development. This paper has established an index system of potential for regional economic development, and implemented an evaluation among four regions of China by using weighted principal components TOPSIS valuation function model. Results show that: (i) spatial distribution of potential for regional economic development appears that Eastern region is the relatively best, the Northeast takes the second place and Central and Western regions are weaker, and (ii) economic development potential within each region has differences, the research results will be a certain reference for the direction to sustainable development of regional economy.

Author Keywords: Weighted Principal Components TOPSIS Valuation Function Model

articleTitle: Competitiveness analysis of urban public transport based on SVM
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The comprehensive analysis of urban public transport has an important role in promoting the development of urban public transport. Based on the characteristics of urban public transport, following the principles of scientific, integrity, independence and operational, this paper built a comprehensive analysis index system for urban public transport, then the comprehensive evaluation method based on the support vector machine (SVM) is brought out trying to analyze the urban public transport of comprehensive after the index system is established. And then, a case study is executed by taking 20 cities in Hebei province in China as an example. The research results reveal that the method can efficiently evaluate comprehensively to the urban public transport of comprehensive. Thus it could be useful for the government to make relevant policies to improve the operational performance for public transport. In the end, some policy advices are given.

articleTitle: The study on organizational maturity of supply chain enterprises oriented towards knowledge management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The competition of the modern enterprises has focused on counterweight of their supply chain. Supply chain theory has not met the need for competitive advantage in the dynamic environment, but knowledge management has become the important means for supply chain enterprises to enhance performance. By analyzing knowledge learning, sharing, transferring, and absorbing of knowledge management, organizational maturity was divided into structure maturity, process maturity, and function maturity. Based on above, evaluation index system was established, which systematically expressed the elements, completely reflected several important aspects of organizational development. Taking 8 samples as subjects, through projection pursuit, empirical analysis of the maturity evaluation is carried out and more attention should be paid to the combination of organizational development and knowledge management process.

articleTitle: Embedded service concept and its model for logistics outsourcing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The case study approach is adopted to analyze the information service platforms of 3PLs. The characteristics of over-emphasis on function integrity of the supply chain and logistics services but disadvantage to information service outsourcing of the current information service platforms of the 3PLs are pointed out. The concept of detachable information service component for information services is put forward by analysis of the current status of information service of 3PLs, which can not only enhance the flexibility of 3PLs' services, but also eliminate trust barriers between the 3PLs and customers. Namely, business data, resources required and business controls of the customer enterprise are detached to ensure the customer enterprise to retain and control its core business data and business security as much as possible. In the mean time, the customer enterprise can share the resources and capacity of decision-making on information with the 3PLs. Customer enterprise can try, rent or purchase the detachable information service components of 3PLs, and make full use of the service control and resource capacity provided by 3PLs to improve the efficiency of enterprise. While the 3PLs might improve their own information integration and reusability by the detachable information service components, and gain more business opportunities and benefits by providing customers with more flexible and efficient services, achieving a win-win in the benefit of all parties.

articleTitle: The research on the planning method about the land appreciation tax
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: When the real estate enterprises adopt higher rate of the land appreciation tax, relevant profit margin will increase either. The growth speed of the relevant profit margin is slower and slower with the elevation of the appreciation rate. The efficiency of investment comes down gradually. When the housing price ≥ 1.2875x the deduction, it can make sure that the profit margin of the real estate enterprises is higher than the profit level when the rate of the appreciation of the land is just 20%.

articleTitle: Piecewise interpolation Lyapunov functional approach to stability of uncertain neutral systems with time-delays
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: This paper investigates the robust stability of uncertain linear neutral systems with time-varying discrete delay. A delay-dependent stability criterion is obtained and formulated in the form of a linear matrix inequality. Two numerical examples are given to indicate significant improvements over some existing results.

articleTitle: Case study of management innovation process of G bank's Disaster Recovery Center
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: This is a case study focusing on innovation management process of G bank's Disaster Recovery Center, three typical phases including idea generation, plan improvement and decision, and plan implementation are divided to analyze their key steps and main factors, and role of the leadership in promoting the whole innovation management process is also analyzed. From these analyses, noteworthy results were obtained for how to manage successful innovation for those organizations with weak innovation capability.

articleTitle: Study on the bi-level programming model for closed loop supply chain under competitive environment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: A bi-level programming model is proposed by using the methods of equilibrium theory and variational inequality. The upper level model accounts for that the environmental protection agency can promote environmental benefit at possibly lower incentive and supervision costs. The lower level model describes the competitive behavior of the decision-makers under different incentive and supervision strategies, and a closed loop supply chain network equilibrium model in competitive environments is formulated. Finally, a numerical example tested on the proposed algorithm illustrates the validity of the model along with the discussion. The result provides a theoretic support for the environmental protection agency to make effective policies.

articleTitle: Coordinating ordering and production polices for JIT: Bargain power analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: In decentralized-decision making process, the buyer's EOQ solution was often unacceptable to the supplier, while the supplier ELS solution was undesirable to the buyer. Based on an integrated JIT inventory model, bargain power structures of buyer and supplier were analyzed to yield the JIT policy accepted by both parties. Two typical cases, supplier's dominance and buyer's dominance were included into more general quantitative bargain power analysis. Traditional single-order-single-delivery model was extended into JIT single-order-multiple-delivery (SSMD) model. A numerical example was given to show how optimal policies and system costs changed with two parties' bargain power factor, and made a comparison with the results joint optimal policy.

articleTitle: The analysis on mutual credit guarantee principal-agent mechanism
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: By using the allocation of guarantee rate savings as incentive mechanism and introducing the influence coefficient of the other SME's relative guarantee rate savings, the principal-agent relationship of mutual credit guarantee institutions and small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) was investigated in this paper. It was proved that the larger relativity of guarantee rate savings among the guaranteed SMEs could bring much higher incentive intensity of mutual credit guarantee institutions to SMEs; compared with non-mutual credit guarantee, mutual credit guarantee was more helpful to improve the incentive intensity of credit guarantee and raise the effort level of SMEs under asymmetric information, besides, the mutual credit guarantee was beneficial to save agent cost; the operational mode of credit guarantee cannot affect the optimal expected profit for credit guarantee under symmetric information.

articleTitle: The retailer's ordering strategy under buy-back rate risk fluctuating
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Based on the analysis of classical buy-back contract's price, quantity and the maximum buy-back rates, this paper further discusses the retailers' order strategies when the supplier are able to promise the maximum buy-back rates during the risk fluctuations. In this paper, a mathematical model is established to maximize the profit when buy-back rates risk fluctuates. The paper also discusses different profits variations of retailers and of the entire supply chains whether or not considering the risk fluctuations under three different situations. After knowing the parameters of the risk fluctuations, the best order strategies of retailers will make significant sense. The fluctuations of the risk of buy-back rates would bring down the expected profits of the members of the supply chain, as well as the overall profits of the supply chain. If the retailer does not adjust his order strategies when the risks fluctuate, the expected profits of the entire supply chain will remain the same as the classic buy-back case, while parts of the profits of the retailer will be shifted to the supplier, causing the retailer's profit losses.

articleTitle: Analyzing the dynamic behavior of a two-echelon supply chain system under restricted inventory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The dynamic behavior of a two-echelon linear supply chain, consisting one distributor and one retailer was analyzed. Firstly, a dynamic model was proposed by analyzing four kinds of supply and demand in supply chain. Through studying the stability of four switched subsystems, the inherent principle of complexity in a supply chain system was identified that the switch between subsystems under restricted inventory produces complex behaviors. Then, a sufficient condition, which is that a inventory only in one supply chain node can not provide liberally for its downstream node, to control bullwhip effect was proved using Transfer Function. Finally, this paper indicated that improving the sensitivity of supply chain system can optimize its stability.

articleTitle: Evaluation model and its application for city distribution capability of Beijing based on entropy method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The rapid economic development of Beijing has brought itself a huge demand for logistics, while city distribution has became an important method to support the normal operation and economic development of the city and a chief functional distinction of the logistics system. Evaluating city distribution capability and finding the bottleneck restricting its development are basic to optimize the logistics system and improve the logistics level of Beijing. In view of three aspects including infrastructure, external environment and service capability, this paper establishes an evaluation indicator system of city distribution capability, builds a comprehensive evaluation model using the entropy method, and then empirically analyzes the city distribution capability based on the actual data of Beijing for several years. As a result, this paper finds the main factors influencing city distribution capability, analyzes the reason why the growth rate of capability fluctuates in recent years, and puts forward the relevant conclusions and corresponding countermeasures finally.

articleTitle: Dynamical extension decision model of agricultural product logistics channels under variable conditions
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Agricultural product transporting and manufacturing enterprises must synthetically consider the biologic attributes of agricultural products and the parameters of logistics channels to select the optimized logistics scheme. According to the attributes of agricultural products, the main influence factors of agricultural product logistics channel selection are analyzed. Moreover, an extension decision model of agricultural product logistics channel selection is built, which is based on the theory of extension decision and variable weights theory. The extension model can dynamically reflect the importance degrees of influence factors and special demands of decision makers during the whole agricultural product logistics operation process, and it can educe the optimized logistics scheme.

articleTitle: Perspective based on comprehensive research on the management of project quality
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: In this paper, the quality of the project space and the massive space is firstly described, and then the author dealt with the project quality management. The key is to solve the various links on the quality management, and the project quality management in the study is based on the analysis of dynamic models of the developed countries and our owner project quality management in the important role that the project planning stage is to determine the quality of the most critical phase. He is committed to setting quality goals and to providing the necessary operational processes and related resources has achieved its objectives The thesis analyzes and describes the quality of government oversight of the construction engineering quality supervision system in place, pointing out that government oversight body to monitor project quality management functions in five. Finally the article describes the project guarantees and insurance in engineering quality management role.

articleTitle: Research on classification of emergency materials
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Proper classification of emergency materials is essential to build an emergency reserve. According to two new dimensions, which are both the importance of emergency materials and the difficulty degree of market access, emergency materials are divided into nine categories. This paper evaluates the emergency materials using the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method so as to determine the classification of emergency materials. The appropriate reserves strategies are formulated when the type of emergency materials is identified. An example is provided to apply this model and method.

articleTitle: Cascade service selection model based on ant colony algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Users can have access to resources and obtain services at anytime and anywhere in ubiquitous computing environment. By virtue of behavior experience in human society, according to dynamic evolution discipline of the contradiction between the lag of trust and the anteriority of service, and the self-organization, distributed computing and regenerative feedback characteristics of ant colony algorithm, cascade service selection model based on ant colony algorithm is put forward. It examines ubiquitous equipment' trust degree before ants choose the next hop, the best server satisfied with the ubiquitous entities' request was selected out by means of cascade servers to improve the service of quality and efficiency, which conquers the disadvantage that a singular equipment can't satisfy the request property and blindfold choice of service. Experimental results show ubiquitous entities can correctly select optimum network services in short time via this model.

articleTitle: Shelf space allocation based on supplier competition
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: In some retail contexts, displaying large quantities of inventory may stimulate demand. Suppliers are therefore continuously battling for the retailer's limited shelf space. This paper models the impact of inventory subsidy contracts on the competition between suppliers. Consider a supply chain with two competing suppliers and their common retailer. We investigate how the suppliers react on the inventory subsidy charged by the retailer, and how the retailer sets the inventory subsidy rate. We also provide the condition under which a supplier stays in competition.

articleTitle: A game of reverse logistics chain models with product remanufacturing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: With the rapid development of e-business, more and more attention is paid on reverse logistics which is brought on by products returns. The main topic of this article is, when repairing and remanufacturing returns goods, how to choose the reverse logistics service pattern. We propose three kinds of closed-loop supply chain models and analyze the profit of B2C firm among these models. We find that the choice of reverse logistics service pattern is determined by the technology of product.

articleTitle: Do mergers improve the shareholders' wealth of acquirers? Evidence from the CTAR method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: We investigate the long-run M&A performance of the listed firms in China based on a sample with a comprehensive 67 transactions. Using the Calendar-Time Abnormal Return method (CTAR), this paper finds that the performance of acquirers generally underperforms after the mergers. More over, the performance of acquirers marked by related party transactions, strong management ability or small size underperforms significantly compared with the performance of those marked by non-related party transactions, weak management ability or big size. In general, M&A activities in China actually destroy the shareholders' wealth of acquirers. It is indicated from our results that the traditional synergy theory can not explain M&A activities in China well. In contrast, tunneling theory, agency theory and hubris theory can better account for the long-run performance and motives of M&A within Chinese listed firms.

articleTitle: Research on the electronic commerce logistics of large and medium-sized household appliances and fuzzy control mode
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Based on the present situation of the large and medium-sized household electrical appliance's e-commerce in China, constructs an e-commerce logistics system platform and a distribution logical structure mode of the large and medium-sized household appliances as well as the logistics distribution fuzzy control mode of the cooperation units in China. For the logistics system platform, studies and analyzes the current e-commerce enterprises, the distributors and household manufacturers' corporation mechanism; for the logistics distribution fuzzy control mode, applies the fuzzy control theory to study the fuzzy control mode of each cooperation units. At last, puts forward some suggestions on enhancing the e-commerce logistics of the domestic household electrical appliance.

Author Keywords: Large and Medium-sized Family Electrical Equipment

articleTitle: Supply chain network optimization of deadlock: A model based on petri net
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Supply chain network is a complex and dynamic net, which is important to companies' competitive power. But the supply chain would be blocked when the resource is occupied, or the stock and production capacity is not enough,. In order to find the cause of the deadlock condition, and to prevent it, a supply chain model based on petri net is created, which can find out the bottleneck place and the key transition through Markov chain, and solve the deadlock problem by changing the transition trigger and optimize the places' parameter. The effect of the model is proved by the calculation of a sample.

articleTitle: Exponential stability for NCS with time-varying delay and dynamical state feedback
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: This paper concerns the problem of the model, stability and controller design for networked control system (NCS) with time-varying delay and dropped out packet. For the NCS with time-varying delay and data packet dropout, four new control methods of dynamical state feedback control, dynamical state feedback proportional-integral (PI) control, state feedback proportional-derivative (PD) control and dynamical state feedback PD control are presented. The NCS with time-varying delay and data packet dropout based on the four control methods is modeled as an asynchronous dynamical system (ADS) constrained by event rates. Furthermore, based on the ADS theory, principle of Lyapunov stability and method of linear matrix inequality, both the semi-negative definite matrix conditions of exponential stability and the controller design for NCS are given. Finally, numerical example illustrates the feasibility of the results.

articleTitle: Reverse channel evolutionary analysis for closed-loop supply chain with competing manufacturers and exclusive dominant retailers
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Reverse channel decision has great influence in the operation efficiency of closed-loop supply chain. To deal this problem, the reverse channel decision was studied based on evolutionary game in the closed-loop supply chain with competing manufactures and exclusive dominant retailers. Results indicate that the competition degree among manufacturers, the collection difficulty and remanufacturing cost saving affect the evolution result of reverse channel together; using subsidy policy government can encourage manufacturers to choose direct reverse channel, which is more benefit to customers and society. Finally, the paper proves the correctness of the research findings by numerical analysis.

articleTitle: Empirical analysis of operation efficiency of listed construction enterprise based on super-efficiency DEA
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The super-efficiency DEA (data envelopment analysis) was adopted to establish the efficiency appraisal model of listed construction enterprises, which solved the problem that the traditional DEA model couldn't differentiate the enterprises' ranking when their efficiency value was 1. With the historic data of ten China listed construction enterprises between 2007 and 2008 and building of the operation efficiency indicators system, the construction enterprises efficiency value was calculated by super-efficiency DEA model, and finally the operation efficiency ranking of the listed construction enterprises was obtained.

articleTitle: Research on decision method of optimal number of main materials suppliers in large hydropower project considering supply risk
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: In the construction of large hydropower project, how to reduce supply risk and the integrated management cost of main materials supply is an important problem which the owner always faces with. Considering the supplier's supply capacity, supply risk and the management cost, an optimization mathematical model to minimize the sum of the risk loss of supply and management cost of the owner is established in this paper. Numerical example analysis shows that the model can determine the optimal number of suppliers according to the available data and achieves the integrated optimal of main materials management of the owner.

articleTitle: Application of Pearson type III distribution to prediction of Port's volume of freight
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Based on the observed data, which are the historical throughputs of Shantou Port of China, this paper attains the required curve for prediction using the calculation process of Pearson type III distribution. According to the estimated economic conditions of the year for which the throughput will be predicted, the predicted throughput of that year can be determined on the curve. Also, the results from this method are compared with those from the simple moving average method and the single exponential smoothing method in order to prove that the Pearson type III distribution is a valuable alternative method for the prediction of volume of freight, having the features of high accuracy, wider applicability and one-type data requirements.

articleTitle: Particle Swarm Optimization with Subpopulations Shuffled Dynamic and its application in soft-sensor of acrylonitrile yield
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: This paper presents a variant of Particle Swarm Optimization, called Subpopulations Shuffled Dynamic of Particle Swarm Optimization (SSDPSO). In SSDPSO, particles are partitioned into different subpopulations by fitness to maintain diversity of population efficiency. The subpopulations will be shuffled together to be a new population after they evolved for certain iterations. Furthermore, the iterations which subpopulations evolve will be dynamic changing. Some of particles will be re-randomized when subpopulations stagnate for certain iterations. A portion of shuffled population with poor position will be substituted by other one with better position. The performance of SSDPSO is investigated by some benchmark functions and compared with other version PSO. The results show that SSDPSO can achieve better solutions and get faster convergence. SSDPSO is then applied to train artificial neural networks to construct a soft-sensor of acrylonitrile yield. The results show that the soft-sensing model constructed by SSDPSONN is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: New algorithm for Economic Lot Scheduling Problem
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: This paper uses time-varying lot size approach to solve Economic Lot Scheduling Problem (ELSP) and offers an efficient algorithm. The new algorithm, by defining and finding out obstacle items (the item with longer average production time is taken as obstacle item), and loading items to bins (obstacle items are loaded preferencially), can offer high quality solutions. Tested by Bomberger's example, the solution shows that the new algorithm is better than previous algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on restrictive buy-back contract of supply chain based on the strategy of adding price
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The paper points out the supply chain with one manufacturer and two markets. The strategies of adding price and discriminate price are adopted for manufacturer in order to make the profit maximize. Compared to the normal price strategy, the maximum profit is obtained for manufacturer which the two price strategies are adopted for the two markets at the same time. Finally, a numerical example is given to illustrate the effectiveness of price strategy for promoting and profit of supply chain.

articleTitle: Risk assessment of supply chain system based on information entropy
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: In this paper an information entropy assessment measure of supply chain system risk and a decision-making method based on combined fuzzy weight and entropy weight in which the input of score matrix are triangular fuzzy numbers are proposed. The individual's intuitive attitude toward risk is just reflected by the fuzzy weight measure of risk. An index system under supply chain risks is established. Using this assessment method, supply chain system risk assessment problems, which cannot only be dealt with subject weight or object weight reasonably, can be solved. The method not only provides an estimate of risk impact on the supply chain system, but also makes it easier for the risk analysts to investigate the accident scenarios and find system vulnerabilities.

articleTitle: The developing strategy for information system based on CPFR
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: During the development, companies need more and more help from the information systems, and some of the needs cannot be met due to the limited functions of the systems. And CPFR is a model that can be used in the development of information system in order to strength the functions of them. This passage analyzed the development of information system and the past studies on CPFR, and then studied the developing strategy of the information system based on CPFR in order to provide technique support for the use of CPFR. It provides the separated model for the nine steps in CPFR procedure and analyses how the key factors, such as data mining, data mart, and data warehouse, work in the systems.

articleTitle: A new expert fuzzy controller design for high accuracy measurement system of packaging machine
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: A new expert-fuzzy controller is proposed in this paper, which is based on fuzzy control and expert control for a class of time varying non-linear systems of milk packaging machine. The new controller adopts fuzzy control and expert control to adjust system errors, which can improve the intelligence of fuzzy controller, speed up the convergence rate and insure measurement accuracy. The controller had been applied successfully in the measurement system of BZA600 continuous packaging machine, and it can adopt the changing of materials better. The experimental result shows its performance of high tracking precision and high accuracy.

articleTitle: An empirical study of choosing the core industries of Free Trade Zones
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Facing a competitive environment, FTZs around the world are no longer limiting themselves to trasitional port activities. Instead, such FTZs are reconsidering value-chain process to enhance FTZ competitiveness. The purpose of this study is to determine the selection of appropriate industries to move into the FTZs for promoting the competitiveness of FTZs. Through analyzing the added values for transshipment operations and the forward and backward linkage with domestic industries, the empirical study shows that ¿products of the chemicals¿ and ¿machinery and electronic components¿ are selected as the core industries in Taiwan's FTZs.

articleTitle: Extreme Learning Machine for financial distress prediction for listed company
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: To overcome the shortages of the existing financial prediction models such as strict hypothesis, poor generalization ability, low prediction accuracy and low learning rate etc., a new early warning model of financial crisis have established for listed company using Extreme Learning Machine. From five dimensions of solvency, operating-ability, profitability, cash-ability and grow-ability, fifteen financial indexes were selected as the input variables; and the output variable was defined as whether the listed company had been special treated or not. The empirical analysis results show the training and validation accuracy of the model are 100% and 92% respectively, which concludes that learning and generalization abilities of this model are excellent, and which can meet the requirements of financial distress prediction for listed company.

articleTitle: Single product, multi-supplier order quantity decision considering materials demand features of different production methods
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: This paper studies the replenishment problem in a single item, multi-supplier environment. A cost optimal model is presented. A comparative analysis with singe supplier model showed the difference in two conditions. An extended model based on model in MTP is proposed when considering the time and production capability constraints in MTO and shows the management issues in organizing MTO supply chain.

articleTitle: A study on spread effect of logistics industry in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Intermediate use ratio and intermediate input ratio were used to analyze the status of logistics industry in china. With the Prolong of 2005 Input-Output Table in China, input-output coefficients were used to study on the relationship among industrial sectors, including the direct input coefficient, the total input coefficient, the improved response coefficient and the improved influence coefficient. The results show that logistics industry mainly depends on machinery and equipment industry and coking, gas and petroleum refining industry, and it's pulling extent and radiation effect to national economics is large, second only to the secondary industry, higher than other industries of the tertiary-industry. In brief, the results show that logistics industry is deserved to be called a new national economic growth point.

articleTitle: Research on small and medium-sized logistics enterprises alliance member selection based on matter-element analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Based on the cooperation model of small and medium-sized logistics enterprises' alliance, this paper designs the indexes for SMLEA member selection to test optional enterprises in the association. And the matter-element model and relevant correlation functions are built by applying the extension theory. By calculating and comparing integrated correlation of the optional companies' content members, the best decision to choose partners is made. This paper gives the thought and method to evaluate and select the members of logistics alliance.

articleTitle: Integrated evaluation of Heilongjiang logistics service system base on non-linear PCA
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Using the established evaluation indicator system of province-territory logistics development, we adopted the non-linear principal component analysis method to carry on the appraisal of the present situation of logistics service system in Heilongjiang Province, analyzed the level of logistics service system in different areas quantitatively. Then we proposed the Heilongjiang Province-territory logistics development can be divided into Ha-Da-Qi, Ha-Mu-Sui and Jiamusi urban cluster as the three main logistics regions. At last, we formulated corresponding development strategy according to their different characteristics.

articleTitle: Research on the third part logistics company's financing pricing under conditions of permissible delay in payments for exponentially deteriorating products
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: This paper set up a 3PL Company's financing pricing model for the exponentially deteriorating products. Based on the supplier's permission of delayed payment and the 3PL Company's provision of inventory impawn financing service, it studied retailer's decision-making of its optimal order quantity and 3PL Company's optimal decision-making problem of providing the finance service. At last, a numerical example was given to analyze the effectiveness of the proposed model. It is shown that both retailer and the 3PL company can achieve their optimal goals by using the proposed model.

articleTitle: Procurement model for supermarket based on category management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: We study procurement model for supermarket based on category management. First, we establish the two-dimension model of commodity classification taking importance and procurement risk as two criteria. Corresponding index system is constructed in which the separate index weight is calculated through analytical hierarchy process. Secondly, procurement model for supermarket is proposed based on category management according to characters of different commodities. Finally, we verify the study of commodity classification method and procurement model by taking A supermarket as an application. We suggest that supermarket can enhance efficiency and cut procurement cost by using this procurement model.

articleTitle: Research on the success promotion path of agent construction project in China: A perspective of economic paradigm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The researches on project success have proved that there are various factors could affect the project success, how to identify achievement methods for agent construction project (ACP) with more strict constraints than common project is a common problem. The article analysis the governance structure of ACP and generalizes critical success factors (CSFs) from theoretical analysis based on the project governance. In addition, it has established the achievement methods based on management and economics paradigm. It shows that project management tools and technique based on management paradigm mainly focus on the operational level of ACP and project governance mechanism based on economics paradigm makes it possible to reflect the arrangement of responsibilities and rights at the institutional design level. It can be concluded that the achievement methods based on management and economics paradigm could complement each other at different levels.

articleTitle: Supplier-retailer chain with asymmetric demand information and pessimistic supplier
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: This paper considers a supplier-retailer chain problem, in which the retailer knows the distribution of the demand, while the supplier only knows the distribution interval of the demand. The supplier's objective is to optimize his competitive ratio. We find that the retailer orders more if he faces stronger market, and bears less overage risk than in the classical newsvendor problem.

articleTitle: The win-win analysis of pricing on the supply chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Supply Chain Management (SCM) is a key issue, a trend and a need in the current business environment. Its essence is that when firms in a supply chain collaborate, it leads to a win-win situation or multiple wins, where all firms will benefit. By setting up a simple quantitative model, it can be shown how and to what extent win-win situation can occur in a supply chain partnership environment. Take a producer and retailer as an example, if they cooperate in pricing, the total profits will be greatly improved and split fairly between the manufacturer and the retailer.

articleTitle: Bi-level programming model for inventory control of deteriorating items based on VMI
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: In this paper we established an inventory control model for deteriorating items under the circumstances of vendor-managed inventory. With the assumption that vendor integrates the small amount of order quantities from downstream enterprises into a large quantity so as to minimize relevant costs, we studied a quantity-based integrated dispatching and inventory policy for the vendor. Then, a Bi-level programming model is proposed and a Genetic Algorithm is designed to solve the model. At last, a numerical example is used to verify the effectiveness and feasibility of the model.

articleTitle: Evaluation on the structure of the road network in a container terminal yard
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: This paper presents a study to easily and effectively evaluate the rationality of a road network structure in a container terminal yard. The fuzzy systematic evaluation method, which is found in the planning and evaluation theory on city traffic network, is used and a set of quantitative parameters is derived. A simple criterion based on the calculated value of the above parameters is proposed to directly make evaluation decisions. The effectiveness of the approach is verified through a case study to apply the approach to design and planning of a new container terminal.

articleTitle: Customer value & construction of financial industries HR Management Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Market competition among financial enterprises is becoming fierce day by day. The crux of the matte is to create more customer value. The traditional model of HR's value chain ignores the costumer value. There are the enormous defects. Customer value is the core link of service and management, the Keys for the sustainable development of financial industries. The HR Management Model of Financial Industries Based on Customer Value is structured. The specific link of HRM can be divided into the following: Customer value analysis, creation, assessment, distribution. It will provide ideas for Financial Industries to create competitive customer value.

articleTitle: Optimal adjustment for high speed passenger train operations
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The optimal adjustment problem for high speed passenger train operations is considered in this paper. The problem is formulated as 0-1 integer programming model to get the optimal organization of train operations. In addition, a high computation speed heuristic algorithm is proposed in order to get a near optimal solution for the problem.

articleTitle: Evaluate the potential vitality of enterprises based on fuzzy comprehensive evaluation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Small and medium enterprises occupy an important position in today's economic development, but many of their short-lived life are bothering entrepreneurs and researchers. According to Arie de Geus's “life-oriented enterprises” theory, some factors which impact on the life of this kind of enterprises were summed up and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation can be used to evaluate those factors. Then entrepreneurs can recognize the potential vitality of their enterprises and find those unfavorable factors that influence their enterprise's life expectancy as soon as possible, and make up for the shortage to extend its life.

articleTitle: Effect of temperature on the tangential shrinkage coefficient of small-diameter polygonal cutting of Larix gmelinii Rupr
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: By using IF dryer, this paper studied the tangential shrinkage coefficient of small-diameter polygonal cutting of Larix gmelinii Rupr. The results showed that: there were two kinds of trend of shrinkage coefficient under same drying temperature. One is first decreased and then increased from pith to surface; another is increased gradually from pith to face. These trends were decided by the frequency of tensile stress in wood drying process. Moreover, drying temperature could affect the response of wood shrinkage coefficient. The shrinkage coefficient of wood was large at low temperature, and decreased firstly and then increased as drying temperature increased. Similarly, the average of shrinkage coefficient showed same variance trend with the increase of wood drying temperature. Additionally, it founded a better quadratic correlation between drying temperature and shrinkage coefficient of different part in wood.

articleTitle: Application research of hypercycle theory in reverse logistics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The academic community has found the cycle characteristics of reverse logistics while a small number of scholars studied reverse logistics from the perspective of circular economy. But few of them studied it from the perspective of hypercycle theory. In view of this, this paper, based on the hypercycle theory, analyzed the hypercycle characteristics of reverse logistics system. Then, it indicated the conditions for existence and effective operation of the hypercycle system of reverse logistics. Last, it discussed and established a hypercycle model of the reverse logistics.

articleTitle: Evaluation model of supply chain risk based on principle component analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: To evaluate the risk is the important link for supply chain management. Here, the evaluation model of supply chain risk has been founded by using principle component analysis, based on identifying the risk factors. Using this model, the impact of each special risk factor to total risk would be measured, by which to evade the risk for the core enterprise.

articleTitle: A research of knowledge flow of supply chain based on the theory of knowledge field
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Firstly, knowledge flow owns the nature of fields is argued, the knowledge flow in the knowledge filed is studied by using the theoretical model in the electric field. On this basis, the knowledge model of supply chain based on the theory of knowledge field is built, and the calculations of knowledge flow and power of knowledge flow are proposed. Furthermore, the feasibility of the calculations is proved at the end of the article.

articleTitle: Research on the morphological structure of network social-ecological system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Network society is a new social formation promoted by information technologies which mainly refer to computer and Internet technologies. It could be suitable to apply the fundamental principle of ecology to the research of network society as an ecosystem, named network social-ecological system. Network social-ecological system has intricate formation and structure and is in a constant change. This paper analyzes the process of network social-ecological system structure formation by Maximum Flow Principle (MFP). A model based on MFP and Self Organization Map (SOM) neural networks is proposed to simulate the changes in the number of global network users and Websites. This paper also tries to find the underlying dynamics of network social-ecological system formation.

articleTitle: Model and algorithm of returned logistics network planning for renewable resources
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Returned logistics network planning is the central part of renewable resources recycling system and circular economy. Taking returned logistics network planning for renewable resources as research object and combining with the demand and supply fluctuations of renewable resources, a multi-category and single-period model of returned logistics network planning for renewable resources was constructed, which has four levels such as collection points, recycling centers, distribution markets and further processing centers or clients. Also, two local improvement strategies such as selected-to-be strategy and mapping strategy were put forward and a heuristic optimal algorithm was designed. The model and algorithm can be used for solving other returned logistics network planning problems of renewable resources with single-category and single-period, single-category and multi-period and multi-category and multi-period styles.

articleTitle: Virtual Trade Platform research based on customers' requirements
