publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Coal is an important fundamental resource. Coal logistics occupies an important position in the circulation domain of China. The construction of Virtual Trade Platform (VTP) for coal enterprises can share resources, accelerate the circulation speed of resources, reduce business costs, and improve business efficiency. By analyzing the characteristics of the coal logistics enterprises and traditional models, the authors in this paper proposed a model of VTP based on Design Pattern. In VTP, E-cert technologies were introduced to solve the problem of user authentication. In addition, a multiple attribute matching algorithm based on similology and real-time video conference technologies were also investigated to support VTP. The results indicate that the use of VTP in Shanxi Coal Transportation and Sales Group Co., Ltd. is at a satisfactory level.

articleTitle: Research on organization process and operation model of collaborative transportation system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The theory of collaboration is used for supply chain management to constitute the collaborative transportation management (CTM), it can meet the requirements of lean transportation. Each transportation entity participating in collaborative transportation shall constitute the self organization and operation mechanism of competition-cooperation-coordination. Collaborative transportation system centers on core enterprise, captures market opportunity, finds out cooperation enterprise, and works out collaborative plan. The detailed analysis is carried out for the collaborative transportation system organization form, organization procedure and execution procedure, and the distribution for transportation task and vehicle dispatch via mathematical model, and the shortest routine transportation optimized via the utilization of GIS technology, finally further points out the issue on how to develop CTM in China.

articleTitle: The progress influencing factors analysis of thermal power project based on ISM method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The relationship among the progress influencing factors is absolutely complicated, which decreases the feasibility of progress program. The paper introduces interpretative structure modeling (ISM) method with the purpose of understanding such relationship. By selecting influencing factors, setting reachability matrix, dividing interval and differentiating grades, the interpretative structure model is established to interpret the progress influencing factors of thermal power plant. Furthermore, the corresponding countermeasures are proposed to provide experiences for the progress management in the future.

articleTitle: The credibility-based cores in games with fuzzy coalitions
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: In an uncertain game environment, it is usually difficult to solve the least core because the rates of players' participation must hold for some real number which belong to [0,1]. In addition, available characteristic function sometimes cannot be accurately given either when the rates are allowed to be fuzzy variables. In this paper, fuzzy coalitions, fuzzy characteristic function and fuzzy cores are studied based on the Choquet integral and the credibility measure. A new fuzzy chance-constrained programming model is proposed for solving the least core under a predetermined confidence level, which is also a game decision procedure for generating cores converging to elements of the fuzzy core to meet different confidence level. It is shown that the least core gained by the presented model coincides with Aubin's core for a specific class of games with fuzzy coalition and reflect the influence rooted in players' preference. A numerical example is presented to show the model idea and its rational property.

articleTitle: A nonlinear programming algorithm for location problem on forest fire emergency system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: In order to obtain the best location of forest fire emergency system, the function between damage cost and reaction time of the fire station is firstly made. Then to make the expectation of the fire damage least, a multi-spot locating mathematic model based on the relationship function is built. Finally, as the matrix equations in the model are 2 orders, a nonlinear programming algorithm, which is developed from the Lagrange method, is introduced to solve the problem.

articleTitle: Study on cost control of railway construction project based on Hall Three-Dimensional Structure
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The phenomena of exceeding budgetary estimate often occur during the process of railway construction, which requires cost control strengthened. The purpose of this paper is to explore the way of cost control systematically. A model of cost control based on Hall Three-Dimensional Structure is proposed, which include stage divided, the problems and solutions of cost control at every stage, the knowledge required from the viewpoint of system.

articleTitle: A framework for insurance regulation of China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: On the base of comparative analysis for a main part of current western insurance regulation theories, a framework of our national insurance regulation theories is provided. The framework encompasses the public interest theory of regulation at the prior place, supplemented with the capture theory of regulation and the economic theory of regulation.

Author Keywords: The Public Interest Theory of Regulation

articleTitle: Application of real options to investment on power construction
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The traditional net present value methods didn't do well in the evaluation of power construction projects, which are characterized by large scale of investment, long construction period, and many complex uncertainties, as it is difficult for those methods to calculate the relevant cash flow, internal rate of return and other key indicators. In this paper, we make use of real options to deal with uncertainty in power construction project investment analysis and decision-making, regard risk factors rationally and excavate its option value, thus reflecting the true value of the investment project. Moreover, the paper examined the option value of a power plant with the B-S model. The result reflects that, compared to NPV method, more value would be excavated when considering its flexibility value due to the uncertainty.

articleTitle: Multifractal analysis of realized range-based volatility in Shanghai Stock Exchange Composite Index
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: We investigate the multifractal character of the realized range-based volatility (RRV) in Shanghai Stock Exchange Composite Index. Through the partition function approach, we estimate the Renyi exponent and the singular spectrum, it has been found that the RRV series have significant multifractal properities. By introducing the shuffled and the surrogate series, we find that the long range temporal correlations and the fat-taile variations of volatility series are two sources of multifractality.

articleTitle: Strategy and simulation of extend-based order processing of distribution center workflow
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Using order processing system simulation can help the analysis and realization of workflow management, scheduling and decision of distribution center and the optimization of system configuration; it can also judge whether the system can meet its quick-response design requirements and examine the practicability of system indicators. By using Extend module, this paper established a dynamic model of distribution center workflow order processing system and probe into the processes and strategies of order processing, then find out the optimal order processing solution to meet the quick-response requirements of distribution center workflow.

articleTitle: A study on the distribution of nonparametric volatilities based on Chinese stock market
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: In this article, we examine the distributions of four different nonparametric volatility measurements- Realized volatility, Realized Range-based Volatility, Realized Bipower Variation and Realized Absolute volatility using the high frequency data of Chinese Shanghai Securities Composite Index. Our empirical results show that the distributions of return series standardized by nonparametric volatility are nearly Gaussian distribution. By comparing these four nonparametric volatilities, we find that the Realized Range-based Volatility is a more efficient way to measure the volatility. The results also confirm that the nonparametric volatility can describe the dynamic behaviors of Chinese stock market well, which indicate that the Chinese stock market is weakly efficient.

articleTitle: A process model of collaborative product design based on design chain and knowledge management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Based on the literature review of design chain, the framework of collaborative product design towards design chain was established. This framework included two phases of knowledge acquisition and product design which subjected to operation process, also included three aspects of customer and design team of manufacturing enterprise and supplier which subjected to organization structure. According to this framework this paper putted forward the process model of collaborative product design based on knowledge management. This process model firstly could realize the information communication and sharing among the design group's activities under the environment of distributed design. Next, it could support the collaborative work of design staff and team with different knowledge background. At last, it could effectively acquire and store the large number of knowledge and experience which the design staff has produced in the working process, and could realize the description and retrieval standardization of knowledge resource.

articleTitle: Resource load balancing technology in collaborative execution process of multiple projects
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: To ensure full use of resources, so as to complete multiple projects on schedule, the resource load balancing technology was analyzed. Firstly, three evaluation approaches were presented, including TLRSR (total loading ratio for single resource), TLRRS (total loading ratio for resources set) and TLRRSP total loading ratio for resources set during some periods. Then, according to different types of resource load imbalance, some strategies and methods for balancing resources load were put forward. Finally, the case studies proved these approaches and methods were practical and effective.

articleTitle: Studies on Microhabitat ACO for application to JSSP
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Through parallel and diversified optimizing activities in ant colony, Microhabitat Ant Colony Optimization Stratagem (MACOS) was advanced to improve the basic ACO from diversity of pheromones distribution, ant pheromone update strategy and diversity of information exchange. Basic Scheduling Rules of Ants (BSRA)was built up based on the characteristics of JSSP. Ant Colony Optimization Scheduling Rules (MACO SR) were built up based on MACOS to solve JSSP and improve BSRA. And waiting time was integrated into the heuristic function and path updating of MACO SR. It proves that MACO SR can achieve more satisfactory results than basic ACO and BSRA for JSSP with the objects function of minimizes the makespan.

articleTitle: Study on the strategies of supply chain risk management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: An emergent event has a great influence on the supply chain and results in a large change in market demand. The supply chain consisting of one retailer and one risk aversion supplier is researched. In this supply chain, this paper gives the optimal strategy to deal with emergencies, compares the optimal benefit after adjusting the supply chain with the benefit not adjusting the supply chain and come to a conclusion that ¿adjustment¿ is the optimal strategy.

articleTitle: Forecast method and application of an Inland Port Logistics Park
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: As a new field of study, Inland Port Logistics Park research work is in the initial stage in China. Holding the inadequate and imperfect history data, the forecasting of logistics quantity will be confronted with many difficulties. On the practical conditions of Inland Port Logistics Park in China, how to find out a predicting approach of high accuracy has the vital part in the research of Inland Port Logistics Park. In this paper, forecast methods of logistics quantity and its application were discussed through a specific example of an Inland Port Logistics Park. Linear regression model, Elastic method of correlates, Conic section model, Logarithm model and gray model were used, seeking to improve the accuracy of prediction and provide the reference of the logistics capacity prediction in practice.

articleTitle: Research on the supply chain revenue-sharing contract under different revenue-sharing ratios
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: In this paper, it is studied that the profits of the retailer, the manufacturer and the supply chain under twice ordering policy with two different revenue-sharing contract ratios separately. Under such contract, the manufacturer decides two different revenue-sharing contract ratios and two different retailer's unit purchase prices. The retailer can only accept or refuse the contract. Once the retailer accepts the contract, the retailer will decides the first ordering quantity, and decides whether gives a re-ordering quantity and the number of the re-ordering quantity before the end of the sales period. The numerical calculation is done and the results show that the profits of the retailer, the manufacturer and the supply chain in the Revenue-sharing contract under two ordering policy are more than that of the retailer, the manufacturer and the supply chain under once ordering policy.

articleTitle: Management capability and evaluation of contractors relationship in BPO enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The capability of relationship management is given more and more considerations with the development of BPO. The ability can be described from three fields: the will of relationship management, management capability for life cycle of service contractor relationship and the performance of relationship management, from which 10 indexes for evaluation can be drawn, for example, attention of high-layer decision makers, establishment of relationship management system, etc., and which can be measured by the aid of Analytic Hierarchy Process Method. It is found that there are three key factors influence the BPO enterprise's relationship management capability. The first one is the establishment of relationship management system and its state. The second one is the attention of high-layer decision makers. The third one is the ability to identity and negotiate with service contractors. It is confirmed that process management is more important than result management, too.

articleTitle: Research on management of supply chain based on System Dynamic
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: This paper describes the application of System Dynamic in supply chain management's area. Analyzing the systematization and dynamics' character on Supply Chain, it shows feasibility of applying System Dynamic and research method of Supply Chain System based on System Dynamic. Through analyzing SD model it showed that human resources and fixed costs perturbed lowly for performance, but fluctuation of demand effects superiorly to finance performance. This Dynamic location method melts SD model, therefore, which can deal with some soft variables, at the same time overcome limitation of traditional statistical method. The paper summarizes system dynamic conclusion for supply chain management issue and bonding point of the two, and sums up the existing study based on SD model application.

articleTitle: A Lagrangian heuristic for the urgency vehicle routing problem
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: For solving the vehicle routing disruption problem which is caused by vehicles breakdown or traffic accidents in the logistic distribution system, an urgency vehicle scheduling scheme is established based on the theory of disruption management. According to the characteristics of the problem, Lagrangian relaxation approach is applied to simplify and divide the problem into two parts. The column generation and saving approach method are used respectively to obtain the solution, and then the subgradient optimization method is used to iterate to get the Lagrangian multiplier, therefore the initial solution for the original problem is obtained. In Order to solve the infeasibility problem caused by Lagrangian relaxation operation, an insertation algorithm is adopted. In the end of the paper, the feasibility and effectivity of the algorithm giving by the paper are verified by compared with an example.

articleTitle: Systemic innovation of logistics finance operation model based on TRIZ theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Recently, the demand of synthesis services for the logistics finance has become stronger constantly. Derived from that, higher demand was raised for its operation model. Even though the academia has made large amount of researches with its operation models and brought forward different kinds of methods to classify it, the changeable operation needs of modern logistic finances can still not be well satisfied. So the method of TRIZ has been creatively used to analyze the defects of current patterns and find the conflicts. Then new classification method of logistics finance operation models was raised from the aspect of market demand and financing enterprises. On the premise that the new method does not raise the risks of financial department, it strengthened the universality and the practicality of logistics finance, which makes the systemic innovation to the operation model of logistics finance.

articleTitle: MDE based Memetic Algorithm using OpenMP and its application in engineering project scheduling problems with dynamic due dates
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: A multi-population DE based Memetic Algorithm using OpenMP is proposed, and applied to a kind of engineering project problems which can be modeled by single machine total weighted tardiness problems with dynamic due dates. The multi-population scheme and a best-survival individual synchronous updating strategy are introduced to simultaneously refresh the sub-populations in the same thread. The searching ability of the algorithm is improved by the differential evolutionary Memetic algorithm which is formulated by incorporating a local search method for the best individual in each sub-population into DE. The effectiveness of the algorithm is proved by a series of engineering project scheduling based simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Research on Synergetic Evolution between the Enterprises in Network Society Community
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Recently, the Enterprises in Network Society Community developed rapidly and competed intensely. In order to prevent emergence reverse evolution of the network society communities, this study give some advices on the Synergetic Evolution between the Enterprises in Network Society Community. Through the comparison with the Traditional enterprise, the enterprises in Network Society Community have their own characteristics on traditional organization, formation and can competitive edge. Then this paper analyzed the way of synergetic evolution were mainly symbiotic, competitive, predation and parasitic. With the Model of Lotka-Volterra, it researched the competition and predation relationship on the Virtual Enterprise Clusters and used an example to authenticate that the number of corporate population was shocked around a central point and could only form a group of mutually disjoint closed curves. Lastly, some measures were taken to improve the Synergetic Evolution between the Enterprises in Network Society Community.

articleTitle: The extent of management contribution in economic growth
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The disharmony between rapid development of science and technology and lower lag of management has been highlighted. The Chinese Government has officially announced that management should be considered as an important factor into distribution system. This paper concentrates on that the extent of management contributes in economic growth through the quantitative measuring method. Management has been regarded as organizational behavior which could increase economic benefits. This paper represents what the concept of equal efficiency curved surface production function is; and to establish an equation for speed of growth. Based on the above and according to the dynamic changes of efficiency, the quantitative measuring method in management that affecting economic growth is presented and empirical tests are carried out. The quantitative measuring of extent of management element contributes in economic growth has provided theoretical basis for participation of management factor in distribution system.

Author Keywords: Equal Efficiency Curved Surface Production Function

articleTitle: Arrears: A Hawk-Dove game theory between public service enterprises and users
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The arrears issue in public service enterprises becomes the current focus of attention of our society. This paper proposed unreasonable regulatory mechanism is one of the most important causes of arrears. A Hawk-Dove game theory is applied here in order to produce a comprehensive analytic framework for solving such problem. Based on this theory, the paper analyzes the ESS for public service enterprises and users will be live and let-live. Several commendations for incentive compatibility are given accordingly: on one hand, call attention to the users frequently; on the other hand, install new anti-arrears equipments to make a record of the users and punish intentional arrears.

articleTitle: A column generation method for quay crane scheduling problem
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Quay Crane Scheduling Problem (QCSP) is very important for operation scheduling on a container terminal. This problem can be seen as a parallel machines job-shop scheduling problem with dynamic setup time. The objective is to minimize the turnaround time of the container vessel. This paper used a column generation method to attack the problem. Since the objective function of minimizing the makespan is not a linear function, linear transformation is introduced. Randomly generated route set is used as the initial columns. With the help of label setting algorithm good quality elementary shortest path is obtained as new column. Branch and pricing method is used to close the integer gap and get final solution. Numerical experiments demonstrated that this method has a satisfying performance.

Author Keywords: Elementary Resource Constrained Shortest Path Problem

articleTitle: Research on the measurement of regional central cities distance of information-state transition-A case of Poyang Lake Eco-economic Zone
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: It is great significant to research on the measurement of central cities distance of information-state transition for the study of urban system. This paper puts forward the concept of the Urban Distance of Information-state Transition(UDIT) based on Distance of Information-state Transition (DIT), and builds the measurement model of UDIT. On this basis, this paper conducts empirical analysis of six cities at prefecture level of Poyang Lake Eco-economic Zone in Jiangxi Province, carries out horizontal (among towns) and vertical (adjust the urban district before and after) comparative analysis, and points out its development strategies for reducing UDIT. This paper provides a new method and idea for the study of urban system.

articleTitle: Supply chain analysis model based on system dynamics approach: A case of Iranian bicycle manufacturer
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Increasing competition in international marketplaces is motivating companies to creating value to their customers. The main objective for the case company is to lucrative attendance in the markets of Asia and South America but at the same time there are many challenges to face. One of these challenges that the case company faces is to balance the variable demand with an inflexible supply. This paper present several factors that affect the design of supply chain under study and then proposes a modeling framework that is used to simulate the operation of this supply chain. The modeling framework presented in this paper is based on System Dynamics approach and its effort has focused on describing the different options for an appropriate supply chain. The modeling and simulations are done with the System dynamics software Vensim that provides a graphical interface to present the causal relationships between variables.

articleTitle: The research on factors in different phases of Export Processing Zones in China based system dynamics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: In order to discern the objective environment that the Export Processing Zones in China depend on and recongnize the main elements that affect the upgrading of the zones' industrial structure. Building a development framework of the zones, and choosing interior condition, exterior condition, government policy and international environment as the four factors that act on the development of the zones. And then analysis of how these factors influence the zones on different phases is given based on casual relationship diagram. The diagram shows dynamic characteristic of each phase and explain how they affect on zones. At last it provides some basic suggestions for the government to formulate policies according to the influence factors and achieve the goal of the update of China's export.

articleTitle: Construction on logistics service quality system of chain convenience stores
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Logistics service quality of chain convenience requests small batch quality, multi-batch, high frequency, high-efficiency and low cost. Under this request building logistics service quality system. Using three-dimensional objectives system of logistics quality to define the method of logistics service quality position. Choosing logistics service quality factor, elaborating process factor in accordance with the requirements of ISO9000. Identifying the key elements of logistics service quality control by logistics ABC. Not only pointing out the problem of logistics service quality, but also giving the solution to increase the overall level of logistics services.

articleTitle: Robust output feedback control for time-delay fuzzy systems with persistent bounded disturbances
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The robust static output feedback control problem for a class of T-S fuzzy systems with time-varying state delay and disturbances both in the inputs and outputs is discussed. By defining a delay-dependent Lyapunov function, the robust control technique is extended to the time-delay systems, the synthetical design procedures of the static output feedback controllers are derived in terms of the linear matrix inequalities, and the robust performance is optimized by the iteration algorithms. This method can efficiently attenuate the peak of the persistent bounded disturbances, and will be more appealing in some practical applications.

articleTitle: Research on hub-and-spoke logistics network construction: An empirical analysis from Zhejiang Province in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Aiming to construct a hub-and-spoke logistics network for Zhejiang Province in China, a framework of hub-and-spoke logistics network construction was presented. In this framework, an evaluation index system was established according to the urban logistics development level, and based on principal component analysis, 33 cities in Zhejiang Province were classified, taking Hangzhou, Ningbo, Wenzhou as the hubs and the cities connecting with them by transportation network as spokes. Based on the hub-and-spoke logistics network covering and the effect analysis, a modified hub-and-spoke logistics network was proposed with Jinhua-Yiwu area as an additional hub, and other two proposals were suggested. This network construction framework provides a new and realistic method to improve the logistics development level in Zhejiang Province.

articleTitle: A data processing model for improving RFID application reliability in logistics tracking system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The characteristics of natural radio communications and the disturbances of application environment inevitably lead to the unreliable phenomena of duplicated readings, false positive reading and false negative reading when RFID is applied to logistics tracking system, and numerous unreliable data are generated. To solve this problem, a series of evaluation indexes for evaluating RFID application reliability were put forward, and a layered data processing model was established to improve RFID application reliability, including primitive event processing layer and complex event processing layer. The former receives primitive reading events from the reader-network, cleans redundant events, and thus tidy logic reading events are obtained. And the complex event processing layer detects and corrects false positive reading and false negative reading through setting up application integrity constraint. The results of application show that the model can guarantee the correctness and integrality of the data, and improve RFID application reliability.

articleTitle: An evaluation of the provincial area logistics development based on principal component analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Within the provincial logistics planning, several very important issues are usually deled subjective and arbitrary. In view of this, this paper presents an objective method for the comprehensive evaluation and classification of provincial area logistics by principal component analysis (PCA). The first step is to establish evaluation index of the regional logistics development and then to calculate the data of selected samples by PCA. Secondly, these results from the calculation are used to explain and classify the entire provincial logistics. Finally, the comprehensive index system of Heilongjiang province is calculated according to the five factor scores. These results show that PCA can simplify the complicated problem in provincial area logistics and lead to an objective, reliable and convincing conclusion.

articleTitle: Oil-depot geographical configuration optimization with uncertain multi-attribute group decision-making
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: For the oil-depot undertakes specific tasks with the timeliness and economy requirements, the oil-depot geographical configuration optimum is discussed and the evaluation indicators system of the configuration area has been put forward. Meanwhile, the oil-depot geographical configuration model has been established by using uncertain linguistic information and multi-attribute group decision-making method. The model can deal with the problem with the uncertainty weight of property. An example illustrated it was a very good combination method for the type of decision-making problem, which enhanced the effectiveness of the language information and improved decision-making accuracy and practicality.

articleTitle: Factors analysis influencing knowledge transfer in knowledge association among Harbin enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Dynamic changing competing circumstances require Harbin enterprises pay close attention to acquiring the external knowledge. One of the effective approaches to gain the knowledge is to construct knowledge association with the universities and research institutes. Effective knowledge transfer is the base realizing Harbin enterprises to promote core competence. Based on the study on knowledge transfer processes of Harbin enterprises, this thesis analyzes the influencing factors of knowledge transfer and the model of influencing factors was constructed. Relatively suggestions on knowledge sources, context, knowledge properties were put forward.

articleTitle: The running model and the optimized method of the clothing agile supply chain under the mass customization
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The clothing mass customization is an advanced production and management of clothing mode, which sets garment manufacturers, customers, surface and accessories suppliers, the environment in one, and makes full use of the latest research results of existing technology. Under the mode of mass customization, in order to meet the different customer's individuality need with quickness, low cost, and high quality, each pitch point enterprise of the supply chain needs close coordinated cooperation, fully displays respective superiority, and sets up an agile supply chain to realize it. This article set up the running model and the optimized method of the clothing agile supply chain under the mass customization.

articleTitle: Multi-objective programming approach to double-level supply chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Under the pressure of global financial crisis, enterprises tend to enhance ability of Supply Chain Management (SCM) and their own advantages can be developed in the competition. A decision making model of multi-product multi-stage supply chain consisted of single manufacturer and single supplier is proposed in this article. The model is proved to be superior and efficient through application example. Reasonable decisions are suggested by analyzing the solution of dual problem. The decisions could help members of supply chain get more profits.

articleTitle: Research on diagnosis of TCM syndromes of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease in a stable state based on neuro-fuzzy theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: To make a summary of methods to establish diagnostic models of the syndromes in traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) by studying the results of data mining of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) in a stable state. First, we carried out data management. In accordance with the selection criteria, we collected more than one thousand copies of clinical data from the patients with COPD in a stable state by way of clinical epidemiology. Secondly, we worked out the plan for modeling: building up fuzzy neural net models on the basis of dynamic Kohonen network and testing their reliability with the Fisher-iris data. Finally, with the help of the models, we studied the clinical data and obtained the diagnostic criteria for common syndromes of COPD in a stable state according to TCM basic theories. The model can be applied to the studies of diagnostic criteria for syndromes of COPD in a stable state by data check-up.

articleTitle: Research on the function of on-demand logistics mechanism in the optimization of logistics system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: On-demand logistics means to respond each time customer's individual request one by one. On-demand logistics mechanism is established on the theory of on-demand logistics. It can optimize the logistics system through E TO E (End to End, the supply chain of upstream and downstream). Through the supply, production and sales of all the links, on-demand logistics mechanism can also militate the entire contents of the value chain. Thus the conflicts of logistics system may be eliminated and the logistics system can run more smoothly.

articleTitle: A multi-category emergency goods distribution model and its algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: When large scale emergency incident happens, the multi-category emergency goods distribution is a complex problem. To improve structure and efficiency of emergency goods distribution, a multi-objective non-linear optimization programming model for emergency goods distribution is established. Modeling precondition is analyzed in detail, some objectives such as minimizing the waiting time, the transportation cost, the preference of selecting emergency commodity distribution center (ECDC) and so on are taken into account. The constraints of the model including total demand quantity and structure of disaster area, the transportation quantity and time from each ECDC are considered. The penalty factor method is employed to transform above model into an easy one, then GA is employed. The encoding system for multi-category emergency goods distribution is introduced, and the basic implement steps of GA are given in detail. The typical instance abstracted from practice is adopted to validate the validity of above model and algorithm, the experiment result shows that above model can describe the practical demand of multi-category emergency goods distribution, and GA is suitable for solving some complex non-linear programming problems such as multi-category emergency goods distribution. Above model and algorithm will benefit for the emergency goods distribution practice.

articleTitle: Research on location model of risk pooling with compensation policy
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: We summarized recent research aimed at expanding the context of facility location decisions to incorporate additional features of a supply chain including variable construction cost, inventory management, transportation cost, etc. Authors expended location model of risk pooling with variable construction cost (LMRPVCC) to construct location model of risking pool with variable construction cost with compensation policy. In a buyer market, logistics corporations may apply compensation policy in order to hold more customers by giving a discount transportation charge. Authors build a square nonlinear 0-1 integer-programming model and use particle swarm optimization algorithm to find suboptimum solutions. The numerical examples are given separately along with the models to evaluate the effectiveness of the model. According to the computational results, we can draw these conclusions: transport costs factor ß is positively related with the objective function value. Compensation cost factor W is positively related with the objective function value. Distribution radius D<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</sub> is negatively related with the objective function value.

articleTitle: Research on services innovation of third-party logistics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: For the third-party logistics company, services are the base of its operation, and keeping competitive logistics services is fundamental to the sustainable development of enterprises. This paper establishes a game mechanism to research on the conditions of service innovation provided by third-party logistics enterprise, and then discusses the management incentive mechanism which promotes the services innovation.

articleTitle: Human-intervention-based dynamic optimization methods of retail goods distribution route
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The optimization of retail goods distribution route is the typical arithmetic of modern logistics but the artificial intelligence algorithms provided by traditional methods are very difficult to meet the demands of practical application. This paper extends the discussion basic on the dynamic optimization of human-intervention-based retail goods distribution route. Several suggested solutions created by the system are selected and then modification and compromise are adopted to improve the bad effect of this algorithm in the application.

articleTitle: An optimization model and its complexity on liner scheduling problem with customer choice
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: In this paper, we study the liner scheduling problem with consideration of the customer choice which depends on the transportation time of a route. We provide a mixed integer model for the problem and show that it is NP-complete. We then provide two ideas on solving this model.

articleTitle: An exploration of service system operation architecture reconfiguration modeling
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: On the foundation of analyzing and comparing the literature of service system, service product, service innovation and mass customization thought, we explored the service system architecture modeling based on the reconfiguration technique. Through object-oriented definition, proposed the architecture model frame combining the state representation structure with dynamic operation structure of service system, researched the plug and play manner of the domain modules and the bus module. The lower stair of the model is the basic stair of the combination of the state representation structure and dynamic operation structure which package the service system core information and domain relevant information into the core model. While the dynamic operation module records the establishing process of domain models. The upper stair is the docking stair describing the relevant domain model through extracting and complementing the information from the core model for quickly building to enhance the reusability and the reconfiguration speed of the model.

articleTitle: Establish the intelligent city system and realize its level analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The intelligent city system was presented in this paper to cover the requirement of urban development. Currently, most cities fell into a troubled state with the urban problems, such as traffic, parking, garbage-treatment etc. However, most cities in the world still concentrated on the building of the elementary stage of city informatization. The intelligent city system was centering on knowledge, with advanced information platform and intelligent social service by all latest technology means. In detail, Intelligent City realizes the information collection and management, dynamic inspection and decision-making etc. The paper constructed its concrete building frame, which was composed of Intelligent Basis Level, Intelligent Application Level and Intelligent Decision Support Level. There were also some sub-systems in each level and they interacted with each other. All these levels and sub-systems formed a bigger comprehensive scheme, which had the abilities of self-study, self-balance and self-regulation.

articleTitle: Research on the anticompetitive effect of vertical restraints led by retailers in the supply chain management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: With the concentration of their market share, retailers enhanced their market positions and the vertical restraints led by them formed in China which damaged the efficiency of the whole supply chains seriously. The vertical restraints led by retailers could bring about the anticompetitive effect. Both the practice and the related research showed it. The model built in this paper which was based on the slotting allowances and fees, the most typical and popular form of vertical restraints also demonstrated it. So, it must be very necessary to build perfect competition policies and code systems in order to promote the fair competition and improve the efficiency of the whole supply chains.

articleTitle: The study of ANP-Based strategic decision model for green supply chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Chinese organizations have paid much more attention to the green supply chain (GSC) than ever before, and much of them have put it into practice. Certain decision-making problems in GSC's strategic plan stage were discussed, key factors and their relationship during GSC's operation were analyzed, and an ANP-Based strategic decision model was put forward. An illustrative case was given to explain the entire process of working out the model by the analytic network process (ANP). Finally, simple sensitivity analysis with pairwise comparison evaluations was illustrated. The conclusion is helpful to guide the construction and implementation of GSC.

articleTitle: How to strengthen food safety in circulation field by HACCP
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: In recent years, the situation of food safety has been better than before in our country, but we are still facing severe challenge as there are often food safety issues in circulation field, so strengthening food safety management in circulation is the keystone in food safety work in China. 2008 Olympic Games in Beijing and 2010 World Expo in Shanghai will further promote economic development, in which food safety is very important. There is much food safety experience and measures to ensure food circulation safety abroad well worthy of our learning. HACCP Certification System is generally applied in the world and is helpful to strengthen food safety in the circulation of our country. Through analysis of factors causing food safety hazards, this thesis puts forward the existing food safety issues in the circulation field of our nation and focuses on research how HACCP enhances the safety of food circulation.

articleTitle: Leasing service supply chain model with trust activity
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: This paper develops a framework for the modeling and analysis of leasing service supply chain with trust activity, which includes multi-commodity flow, lessors and random leasing demand market involved. Through the whole leasing service supply chain, the decision-making behaviors of manufacturers, lessors and random leasing demand market are modeled, which pursuit only the maximization of profit, meanwhile, under suitable assumptions, the level of trust activity on the supply chain is investigated until an equilibrium pattern is achieved, and several numerical examples are presented to illustrate the model and conclusion.

articleTitle: Emergency goods scheduling model and algorithm during initial stage of disaster relief
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: During initial stage of disaster relief, real time requirement and limited relief source quantity are the main features of relief work. To improve the efficiency and precision of emergency goods scheduling, a model is established for the multi-depot and multi disaster places, single category material requirement emergency scheduling problem. The objective of the model includes minimizing task complete time and relief participated vehicles. The model is under the constraints of the relief vehicle number and the specified time by disaster places. Genetic algorithm is adopted to optimize the routes, to determine the number of participated vehicles and routes of varied emergency relief centers, thus the minimum emergency time and vehicles can be obtained. Finally an example is employed to validate the validity of the model and algorithm.

articleTitle: SEM-based knowledge workers' loyalty in large-scale manufacturing enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Structural equation model analysis is introduced into the quantitative evaluation for knowledge workers' loyalty degree in large-scale manufacturing enterprises. Based on 536 valid questionnaire data, the 2-order factor model and the mathematical model were built to calculate and compare the theoretical value and the actual value of knowledge workers' loyalty degree, if the actual value is higher than the theoretical one, then the conclusion is that the KWLD is relatively high and to be maintained; Otherwise, if the conclusion is that the KWLD is relatively low and to be enhanced. At last, the results indicate SEM based evaluation method is proper to assess knowledge workers' loyalty.

articleTitle: An approach to service set mining for improving SWS based supply chains coordination
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Supply chains coordination plays an important role in supply chains system. This paper mainly studied the problem of mining service set to efficiently select and integrate Semantic Web Services (SWS) in supply chain for improving supply chains coordination. First, the method of generating SWS based service supply chain were introduced. Second, hypergraph-based matrix representation for service supply chain was presented, and based on this. Finally, a service set mining algorithm for improving supply chains coordination was put forward and an experiment was given to show the effectiveness of the mining algorithm.

articleTitle: RBF-ARX embedded fault tolerant control system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Many techniques to handle fault tolerant control system still to be not general to every complex system, those motivate us to suggest a technique that combine an RBF_ARX model to identify the system and its estimation parameters, with discrete time sliding mode control (DTSMC), in way that its control law must run through the exact state vector and defining the sliding surface with respect to the tracking error, this paper show that the design of sliding surface could be independently of control law, an illustrating example with co-simulation platform: Amesim & Matlab.

articleTitle: Emergency resources dynamic assignment using a repast symphony-based simulation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: This paper addresses stochastic dynamic assignment of perishable goods in a scale-free network. We develop an agent-based simulation model in which the supplies and demands for a single perishable commodity are generated at each node (agent) in the network. We match supplies and demands with several pre-specified assignment rules and given various commodity decay durations. A utility is associated with each assignment based on the spatial proximity between the supplier and the recipient. We assess various rules in terms of overall network utility. Our computational results show that 1) it is beneficial to use hybrid assignment rules that integrate the spirit of system-wide assignment and that of local preferred assignment; 2) it may be beneficial to allow agent behavior changes with certain degree of autonomy.

articleTitle: SVR-based assessment of customer value for local commercial bank in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Quantitative assessment of customer value is critical for the local commercial bank to implement Customer Relationship Management in China. In this paper, based on analysis of customers' contribution to a local commercial bank, an intelligent appraisal model based on support vector machine regression was proposed to assess customer value. The initial experimental results show that the application of the new model is effective and feasible.

articleTitle: The study on measuring and comparison with regional logistics development level: As an example of Jilin Province and correlative provinces
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: This paper comprehensive analyzed the key factors of regional logistics development. On the basis of these, the evaluation index system of regional logistics development was established. Then the measuring model was proposed based on the AHP, and the six typical regions were chosen as the evaluation objects. Finally, according to the evaluation results, a brief analysis was given and suggestions were presented.

articleTitle: Influences of trust in subordinate, perceived risk and power distance on leader empowering behavior: Empirical study from China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Empowerment can improve effectively the flexibility and efficiency of organizations. And leader empowering behavior is an important part of successful empowerment. However, few empirical researches explored the antecedents of leader empowering behavior. This present study was conducted to explore the effects of trust in subordinate, perceived risk and leader's power distance on different dimensions of leader empowering behaviors via scenario experiment. One hundred and fifty six managers participated in the study. The results indicated that trust in subordinate had positive effects on leader empowering behavior, involving participative decision, informing and coaching, and trust in subordinate had stronger effect on participative decision than on informing and coaching. Perceived risk only had negative direct influences and interactive effect with trust in subordinate on participative decision and informing. In addition, power distance had negative direct effects and interaction with trust in subordinate on three dimension of leader empowering behavior. Our study could offer valuable theoretical and practical insights for empowerment which is becoming more and more significant in Chinese organizations in transitional economy.

Index Terms: Root Mean Square Error Of Approximation

articleTitle: Analysis of quality game behavior for cold-chain logistics outsourcing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Whether there is an optimal cooperation pattern of quality investment strategy between the third party logistics provider and its subcontractor in cold-chain logistics industry was discussed. Based on game theory, Nash Equilibrium, Stackelberg Equilibrium, and the cooperative equilibrium pattern with the quality policies and credibility factors of both sides were analyzed. The provider and subcontractor would reach state of equilibrium in quality investment strategies when the provider subcontracted the logistics business or part of the business to the subcontractor. The results show that they will not be likely to choose the state of equilibrium maximizing total benefits of both sides, due to the chasing of their own interests. These mathematical models provide an important foundation for monitoring and optimizing the quality investment strategy of the provider and subcontractor in cold-chain logistics outsourcing.

articleTitle: Analysis of the path for life-cycle information sharing in urban rail transit project
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: This paper gives an analysis of participants' decision-making process about information-sharing in rail transit projects by mathematical model and the measures should be taken into information-sharing strategy from the perspective of the entire life cycle. On this basis, the path for information sharing in project is put forward.

articleTitle: System clustering-based analysis of the competition network pattern and the comparison of service bidding between ports
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: A port has to consider others in the port group when making its strategy under complicated environment. This paper introduces a scientific method for ports on how to make the best bidding decision. First, the multivariate statistics clustering analysis is utilized to analyze the port group's competition hierarchy. And the level of the port is determined. Then Tianjin Port is analyzed as an empirical study. Secondly, the Bertrand price game model is adopted to analyze the competitive and cooperative situation of two ports from the same level. At last, a conclusion is reached that the revenue under cooperation is higher than that of competition, and the higher the two ports' substitute degree is, the more revenue will cooperation bring.

articleTitle: Gaussian Process meta-modeling and comparison of GP training methods
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The ability of Gaussian Process to flexibly and accurately fit arbitrary, even highly nonlinear data sets has lead to considerable interest in their application to many areas. Firstly, the usefulness of Gaussian Process models for application to complex systems metamodeling is proposed. Secondly, several approaches for training Gaussian Process models are examined, which include local optimization algorithm, Genetic Algorithms and Estimation of Distribution Algorithms. The results of these training methods are compared for several example problems, and guidance is provided in GP training methods.

articleTitle: An auto-recommending technology for 3G services
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: To improve the quality of 3G service recommending technology, a new 3G service recommendation algorithm was prompted based on clustering analysis and collaborative filtering. The algorithm can cluster the users with their behavior similarity to the commodities, and finds the nearest neighbor of an active user according to the clusters. Then the recommendation to the active user is produced by collaborative filtering. Experimental results show that the algorithm improves the performance of recommendation system and decreases the mean absolute error of 3G services system.

articleTitle: Research on the reverse logistics model based on e-commerce
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Reverse logistics is becoming more important in over all industry area because of the environmental and business factors. Planning and implementing a suitable reverse logistics network could bring more economic profits, customers' satisfaction, and a nice social picture for companies. In the e-commerce environment, reverse logistics indicated some new characteristics, such as intensive, collaborative and flexible. And a good reverse logistics model will greatly improve the development of e-business. However, the existed four reverse logistics, such as self-type model, third party model, strategic alliance model and integrated solution provider (ISP) model could not adapt to the change of e-commerce. Therefore, based on the analysis of four reverse logistics models, some recommendations about reverse logistics process design and application are provided in the paper.

articleTitle: The research on supplier selection in supply chain management under incomplete information market
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: It is a strategic decision-making process to select suppliers in supply chain management. Under the circumstance of incomplete market information separating equilibrium and pooling equilibrium are worked out and analyzed, which proves independent third-party certification (TPC) agency play an important role in supplier selection. Due to TPC the efficient supplier certified shall be selected by the buyer and the speculative supplier has to give up for the prohibitive costs.

articleTitle: Market development strategy and its evaluation model in information technology services industry
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The new development trend of information technology was described in this paper, which can be seen as the information integration between different industries. Then detailed description for the information services industry was made from two levels: the main strategy and the sub-strategy; The three major strategies include: self-strategic businesses, outsourcing service providers and the professional cooperation among the powerful; from each of the main strategies proposed the development of sub-strategies for further proceeding. Through the description of strategic development conditions from the levels of ¿hard power¿ and ¿soft power¿, based on expert Method a strategic risk factor evaluation model was presented.

articleTitle: Dynamic production game with fuzzy demand in a supply chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Dynamical game between multiple production firms in a supply chain wad studied in this paper. Considering the uncertainty of market demand, it was characterized as a fuzzy variable. And then the game between two firms and more than two ones was analyzed in the fuzzy environments. This paper defined expected Nash equilibrium of the game in the two cases. The existence of the Nash equilibrium was also proven. Due to the ability to solve production game in fuzzy environments, the proposed model had advantages over the existing ones in solving game of production fields. To illustrate the rationality and practicality of the proposed game model, a numerical example was given in the end.

articleTitle: The empirical analysis of automobile logistics based on multivariate statistical analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: With the logistics outsourcing gradually increases, automobile logistics can be an important tache to assess and select the automobile logistics vendors justly and equitably in the outsourcing process of enterprises. And the proper evaluation of automobile logistics would enhance auto enterprise core competence, improve added-value service, reduce cost and optimize enterprise resources etc. But a new quantitative approach is adopted to assess the automobile logistics through the principal component, the fisher method and K-Nearest Neighbor method, it could grade them. And then identify the Misclassified automobile logistics by K-NN on the base of above analysis. Moreover, this method contributes to the classification and selection of the automobile logistics vendors on the basis of some objective information provided by this method and then the analysis result might be taken as one of main reference for outsourcing decision making.

articleTitle: Research on customer value oriented supply chain management strategies
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Customer value is the primary characteristic of an enterprise's core competitiveness. A customer value oriented supply chain management is able to produce competitive cost and time advantages, as well as solving problems in convergence, coordination and information sharing during the creation and transfer of value, by implementing resource sharing and collaboration between members in the supply chain. This paper starts by defining the connotation of customer value, and then utilizes models to analyze the mechanism of customer value creation via supply chain management. It is proposed that a customer value oriented supply chain management should aim to enhance customer perceived benefits and reduce customer perceived sacrifices, in order to maximize customer value through ways of supply chain designing, product selection and business process reengineering etc.

articleTitle: Research and application of adjacent matrix of trees
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Through studying the adjacency matrix of trees and analyzing the correspondence between the tree and adjacency matrix, the characteristics and storage structure of binary trees' adjacency matrix is summed up in the paper, and the binary trees' A- sequences and B- sequences is solved in parallel by applying adjacent matrix.

articleTitle: Analysis of channel of sales promotion under consignment contract with revenue sharing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The manufacturer sells the product through a retailer with the consignment sales scheme in international trade, meanwhile many demand enhancing promotion, eg, after sales services, advertisement etc. can be provided either by the manufacturer or by the retailer. We study the preferences of the supply chain members to invest on the sales promotion when the trade scheme is the consignment sales. We find (1) the manufacturer always prefer providing the sales promotion, (2) but, there exists a threshold level of the percentage allocation of revenue in model IC, the retailer wishes the manufacturer' sales promotion if the level of the percentage allocation of revenue is more than the threshold, otherwise wishes to invest on the sales promotion by herself.

articleTitle: A new newsvendor problem with time-based parameters under normally distributed demands
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The classic newsvendor model normally deals with single factor and single period, where the purchase timing, the time-variant variance of the demand and guaranteed delivery time are neglected. This paper simultaneously considered the above three factors and presented a newsvendor model embedded with time-factors, in the background of two stage supply chain whose products were of time-effectiveness. Normal distribution for the demand was adopted and the mechanism of wholesale price game theory was applied. The results showed that that the optimal decision group for the partners is existent. The whole supply chain performance could be greatly enhanced in the new model. It also showed that the optimal due time guaranteed by the Manufacturer is shorter when the Retailer is the leader in Supply chain.

articleTitle: Multi contract mechanism based services in the mobile services supply chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: 3G Era, it is the great strategic significance for operators and service providers to establish a solid cooperation to improve the competitiveness of the mobile service chain. To explore the contract mechanism between the operators and service providers, this paper studied the operation model of the major operators and providers in the Zhejiang Province, analyzed the existing models of cooperation, based on the supply chain contract mechanism, proposed the multi-contract mechanism, tried to coordinate the supply chain system, builded a supply chain model based on the service, analysed the profit function, combined actual case analysis, and drawn the conclusion that the multi-contract based business can enhance the competitiveness of the mobile services supply chain.

articleTitle: Complex conditions modeling for the performance assessment of logistics service organization
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The performance assessment of logistics service organization has been a problem for the difficulties to find the proper method compare to a general business company in terms of outcome index. The adoption of modeling method based on Agent can combine micro behavior of complex system with macro ¿come forth¿ phenomenon organically. It is an effective comprehensive modeling method with up down analysis and bottom up integration. The modeling method based on principle that provides complex model with adaptation system, establishes genetic algorithm, and offers credible assessment models for the studies of logistics service organizations.

articleTitle: Pricing decision for remanufactured and refurbished products about WEEE
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: This paper discusses the pricing decision about the remanufacture rate and subsidies rate for remanufacturing and refurbishing to returned WEEE (Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment). We define and analyze a model of an industry comprised of a remanufacturer to remanufacture and refurbish returned products. According to the cost of remanufacturing, refurbishing and the valuation ratio of refurbished product to remanufactured product value, the remanufacturer can choose the optimal remanufacture rate to get the optimal profit. In pricing decision, the price difference of subsidies to remanufactured product is smaller than subsidies to refurbished product. When subsidies rate increases, the pricing competition of subsidies to remanufactured product will be looser, and the pricing competition of subsidies to refurbished product will be tighter.

articleTitle: The feasibility about logistics park being set up in the source of agricultural product industry chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Countryside is the source of agricultural product industry chain, but agricultural product logistics park usually be located in cities. The agricultural product has its own features; its logistics sets higher level and special request for the service processes. After analyzing the advantages and disadvantages of urban and countryside for location of agricultural product logistics park, the result shows that countryside is more suitable for the logistics park construction and management, it could reduce cost, improve agricultural product quality, and raise logistics efficiency. Moreover, the establishment of modern agricultural logistics park in countryside will bring benefits to rural economy, rural condition and the quality of farmers. Based on the result, this article focuses on logistics park contents, investment subject, management method, and co-operation between the countryside government and large retailers to participate in the construction and operation of logistics parks is a reasonable way.

articleTitle: EPC's competitive advantages in enhancing the impact of commercial enterprises and China's strategy to response
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: On the basis of a brief EPC application description and its resent research at home and abroad, after the comparison with barcode technology, this paper analyses the influence to enhancing commercial enterprises' competitive advantages which is caused by the wide use of EPC. And it explores the constraints to promote the use of EPC in China. Combined with the actual situation of China's commercial enterprises, this paper also brings forward the operational strategies.

articleTitle: Realized covariance matrix is good at forecasting volatility
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The analysis and modeling of high-frequency financial data are new research fields in financial econometrics. The realized covariance matrix, gotten by expanding realized volatility based on univariate high-frequency data to multivariate high-frequency data, can describe volatility and correlation of multivariate time series. The paper gains the realized covariance matrix of the high-frequency data of Shanghai Composite Index and Shenzhen Component Index, and uses VAR model to forecast variance. Then the result is compared with the ones which are gotten by using ARMA model on realized volatility and GARCH model on two indexes. By comparing those three forecast variance by mean squared error, the paper shows that the realized covariance matrix is better than realized variance, and the realized variance is better than GARCH model on variance forecasting.

articleTitle: Operating mode of mold city based on supply chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Various types of mold cities emerged one after the other recently in China. These mold cities actively promoted the development of die & mold industry and regional economy. They provided a broader platform for mold enterprises. The paper, on basis of supply chain theory, presents constructing mold supply chain city (MSCC) based on mold cities, and compares mold cities with mold supply chain city in terms of structures and operating modes. Mold supply chain city is an effective management mode to improve the integrity among mold enterprises and an effective way on playing agglomeration effects. It achieves accurately and efficiently producing mold. The mode has important theoretical value and practical significance to accurately lead and plan the development of mold cities, and has lessons for other industries as well.

articleTitle: Study on evaluation of the city gas emergency response capability
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Based on the actual situation in Tianjin, the indicator evaluation system of city gas emergency capability was studied. The indicators which affect the emergency capability were divided into two grades, and then the indicator evaluation system was established. Based on the indicator evaluation system, the gas emergency capability of Tianjin was evaluated with the G1 method. The results show that the indicator evaluation system of city gas emergency capability covers a wide range, which can reflect the real situation, and through verification, the evaluation results which is obtained with the G1 method is in line with the actual situation and reflect the current level of city gas emergency capability.

articleTitle: Research on immunization strategy to risk of virus type in supply chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The prevention from risk of virus type is one of the main contents of the risk management in supply chain. This paper has studied the immune effect of three immunization strategies on risk of virus type in different supply chains. When the supply chain is a homogeneous network, the adopting of the random immunization strategy to prevent risk of virus type is more effective; while when the supply chain is a inhomogeneous network, the random immunization strategy is failure. In this case, the adopting of the target immunization strategy is more effective; however, because some of the preconditions needed when using the target immunization strategy are difficult to get satisfied, practically, it is often to use acquaintance risk prevention instead of the target immunization strategy. This research has provided the theoretical basis for adopting the correct immunization strategy to prevent the risk propagation of the virus type in supply chain.

articleTitle: The two-term multi-task supply chain principal-agent analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: In the supply chain, the supplier offers the retailer products for sales. The retailer affects the sales outcome by his effort. The supplier wants to inspire the retailer's more effort for the long-term sales goal. However, due to the asymmetric information, the supplier can't observe the retailer's effort and the moral hazard will come into being, which leads to system inefficiencies.
