To deal with this problem, based on the principal-agent theory, we construct the dynamic multi-task supply chain principal-agent model, by which we analyze the impact of the information asymmetry to the supply chain contract. Furthermore by comparing the contracts between the single-term multi-task and two-term multi-task, we have analyzed their different effect on the commission rate. It shows that the dynamic principal-agent contract is helpful to for improving supply chain performance.

articleTitle: Research on quality supervision in logistics service supply chain under asymmetric information
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Research on quality supervision in logistics service supply chain under asymmetric information can not only enlarge the theory of logistics service supply chain but also provide guidance for business practice. Considering a supply chain structure including a logistics service supplier and an integrator, a Bayesian Nash equilibrium model under asymmetric information is established based on a basic model of quality supervision in logistics service supply chain under symmetric information and an equilibrium result is obtained, then the influence on quality supervision is considered after a factor that the logistics service integrator will be punished is introduced and a new result of the Bayesian Nash equilibrium is got. Simulation results show that the quality completion level of supplier rises up and the quality supervision level of integrator brings down after the factor is introduced. Therefore, in practice, the level of logistics service can be improved effectively and the overall quality of logistics services supply chain can be enhanced through strengthening the punishment of integrator.

articleTitle: Study on the forming mechanism of the logistics service delivery capability based on customer equity
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Customer equity has impact on long term benefits of any logistics enterprise. Customer equity-oriented logistics service delivery is essentially a process of delivering customer service value. Logistics service delivery capacity has strong influence on the performance of delivery. In customer equity model, value equity, brand equity and relationship equity are three main drivers of customer equity. On the basis of the model, this paper analyzed the forming mechanism of customer-oriented logistics service delivery capability and established a framework of logistics service delivery capability which mainly has three dimensions: core value delivery capability, brand value delivery capability and relationship value delivery capability. This paper also went deep into specific components of each dimension.

articleTitle: Legal supervision of the third party payment-from the perspective of fund accretion
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The vantage point of E-commerce lies in the data-collection, the low cost of dealings and beyond the limit of time and space. However, this type of deals can easily result in the lack of trust between the two parties, and may further bring the deal to a halt. To overcome its drawbacks, a completely new online paying pattern is introduced - the third party payment system, which is independent of the respective dealing parties, it can resolve the problems of indeterminacy and credibility. Nevertheless, due to the fact that legal system in this regard falls short of demand, and the development of third party entails such legal risk as accretion of fund, so if not properly dealt with, it wound surely hamper its healthy development. This essay, based on the quantitative analysis of this payment, attempts to tackle the problem of the rights to the use of accretion of funds and its profits, in addition, it further ventures to make some pointed suggestions toward the legal system in this aspect.

Author Keywords: Analysis of the Rights to the Use and Its Profits

articleTitle: Comparison analysis of vendor managed inventory with consideration of transportation and inventory costs
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: In this paper we built up a one supplier-two retailers supply chain cost-computing model, with parameters of costs in transportation, uploading & loading, ordering cost per time for retailer, demanding rate of retailer and yearly storage costs of supplier and retailer. Through computing and analyzing of a practical example, the results show: 1) In the condition of considering transportation fee and ignoring this fee, the whole cost of supply chain system reduces respectively 32.1% and 27.2% after the implementation of WMI. 2) When supplier and retailer one implement VMI, the cost of system declines 20.7% and 17.2%. 3) When supplier and retailer two implement VWI, the cost of system declines 21.9% and 18.3%.

articleTitle: Exponential stability of singular networked control system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: This paper concerns the problems of the model, exponential stability and controller design for singular networked control system (NCS) with data packet dropout. Considering the existence of time-delay and packet dropout, the model of singular NCS with two cases of dynamical output feedback control and dynamical output feedback proportion-integral (PI) control is obtained, which is an asynchronous dynamical system (ADS) constrained by event rates. Based on the theory of ADS, Lyapunov stability theory and linear matrix inequality method, the semi-negative definite matrix conditions of exponential stability and controller design method for the singular NCS are presented. Furthermore, numerical example is given to illustrate the feasibility of the semi-negative definite matrix conditions of exponential stability and controller design method.

articleTitle: Application of fuzzy clustering iterative model and sorting algorithm in comprehensive evaluation of logistics development
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Based on the fuzzy clustering iterative model (FCIM) established by Chen, a new sorting algorithm (SA) is proposed. The SA gives not only the classification of samples, but also the sample sort. The method is applied to the logistics divisions of 16 states of Yunnan province in China. The FCIM and the SA bring out more advantages and practical value. The division-result corresponds with the regional features of Yunnan. The calculation is simple, and the analysis of results is reasonable and reliable.

articleTitle: A joint decision model of product variety and inventory control under fuzzy substitution rate
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The problem of jointly determining the product variety decision with inventory control decision for the different brand of a certain product under fuzzy substitution rate and fuzzy inventory holding cost is studied in this paper. The fuzzy total profit and possible service level at the retailer are both given. Based on it, a nonlinear integer programming model to maximize total multi-period profits subject to given stocking space, budgetary and service level constraints is established. Finally, numerical results and conclusions are presented. Computation results show that it may be more profitable to adopt narrower assortment policy versus complete assortment policy for the retailer and the net profit criterion is prior to the conventional gross profit criterion in our scenario.

articleTitle: A study on the model of non-instantaneous replenishment inventory decision in consideration of transportation cost
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The objective of the study is to minimize the whole cost of logistic system in view of the long-term planning level. Based on traditional EOQ model, a non-instantaneous replenishment inventory decision model is presented in consideration of transportation cost and the permitted working duration of the vehicles per unit time. The optimal ordering quantity is obtained by the ideas of getting the minimum values in the cost collection with different delivery times. The algorithm is designed by looping comparison and the effectiveness of the model is verified by the representative examples.

articleTitle: Knowledge integration of Supply chain alliance and dynamic game analysis under complete information
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The core competence of Supply chain alliances was manifested by the knowledge integration capabilities in the node enterprises. Basing on the premise of information-sharing between the core enterprises and the node enterprises, the study involve dynamic game process of the innovation value and the cost of knowledge by dynamic game, while the study point out that understanding relationship between the cost of study and the consumption of partners is critical. Understanding the relationship is a key factor of achieving the game equilibrium and knowledge integration.

articleTitle: Identification and control based on neural networks and ant colony optimization algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: It is difficult to have good performance to control large delay time system. A neural network identification method for nonlinear system's delay time was discussed. Using the abrupt mutation resulted from the training error sum square of the real output and the expected output of the network, this method changed the input sample period of the neural network so that it could discriminate the delay time of the nonlinear model. Combining the discrimination of neural network system with long time delay and the control method based on model prediction, searching PID controller parameters based on ant colony optimization algorithm, it was applied to control boiler combustion system. The simulation results show that this scheme has much better advantage of celerity and robustness.

articleTitle: Research on information sharing incentive and supervisory mechanism in supply chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The paper focuses on information sharing of a two-level supply chain composed of a manufacturer and a retailer. Based on the principal-agent theory, under considering risk costs a mechanism is designed to improve effort level of information sharing, and different parameter terms of incentive and supervisory mechanism to ensure the validity of mechanism are discussed. The results show by selecting different parameters that the mechanism can redistribute extra profits brought out by the information sharing, and effectively urge manufacturer and retailer to share information.

articleTitle: Study on facility system control of integrated traffic terminal with public security as priority
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Projects of integrated traffic terminals involve a great number of equipment systems, including ventilation, lighting, communication, power supply and electric supervision, water supply and drainage as well as fire fighting and integral supervision. The safe operation of these equipment and systems is an important control point for integrated terminals at operation phases. Therefore the study on operation and management modes becomes the key to ensure that an integrated traffic terminal runs in a safe and reliable manner. With illustration of the composition of systematic functions of facilities and with introduction of life cycle theory, the paper demonstrates the way for realizing the facility integrated control system.

articleTitle: Incentive mechanism design for employee knowledge sharing based on principal-agent theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Knowledge sharing can make organizational knowledge freely flow in definite range to benefit for knowledge application and innovation. But employees don't share their knowledge actively. The purpose of this paper is designing effective incentive mechanism of employee knowledge sharing on the basic of comprehensive management pattern to implement knowledge sharing. Through applying principal-agent theory and mathematical analysis method, optimal incentive mechanism of employee knowledge sharing was designed, then four conductive significant properties were analyzed. The results show that the important influencial factors on employee knowledge sharing are reward incentive and management incentive of enterprise, sharing cost and psychological sensitive coefficient of employee, investment intensity and operation efficiency of management system. The paper supplies theoretical basis and practical guide to promote staff knowledge sharing for enterprise manager.

articleTitle: Evolution games and the real estate market
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Based on the dynamic evolution of game and the limited rationality, the question that why the policy for the game of central real estate and a real estate developers was no work was explored. Based on this discovery, it finds that the abolition of unreasonable fees and the introduction of a unified property tax cannot adjust to the price. The only key is to contain the transferring to the consumers, which makes housing prices return to normal levels. Finally, the suggestion that using lower price to release more funds for the expansion of domestic demand and restricting the sources of speculators' funding are gave to government to regulate and control real estate effectively.

articleTitle: The Whole Process Cost Management of construction project based on Business Process Reengineering
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Cost management has become one of the critical problems in construction management, for China will become one of the biggest construction markets with a huge number of investments these years, while the actuality of cost management is merely efficient. Therefore, it is of great practical significance to study on a new cost management paradigm. To begin with, drawbacks of current cost management in construction project are analyzed. The current cost management in practical construction management is mostly limited to quantity measurement and valuation, and is implemented by different entities in different phrases separately, which goes against a good transmission and integration of the cost information, and that probably leads to a poor cost control effect. Then, the theoretical mechanism of Whole Process Cost Management is discussed, and the Business Process Reengineering Theory is studied following. The Business Process Reengineering is adopted as the theoretical tool to achieve the efficient cost management during the whole process. Based on these, the business process is reengineered for the Whole Process Cost Management. Finally, the support system for it is established to provide organization, information and technology support for the seek of minimizing the total cost of construction projects.

articleTitle: Study on Internet advertising placement problem
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: This paper describes the application status of Internet advertising, gives models of two Internet advertising placement problem, named MINSPACE problem and MAXSPACE problem. After overview the investigative status, we provide several kinds of heuristic algorithms, propose a hybrid algorithm, and then show its better performance than the other two heuristic algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on rolling scheduling window
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Key issues involved in rolling scheduling, including the determination of the number of work-pieces in the rolling scheduling window and the selection method of rolling scheduling windows, were studied. Based on resource constraints, a method for calculating the number of work-pieces in the rolling scheduling window was presented. To determine the entry of a specific work-piece into a rolling scheduling window, the powerful sorting capacity of neural network was employed and data mining was carried out among the actual scheduling schemes. In the process, the due time and priority of work pieces were considered. A computational test was given. Test results show that the proposed algorithm is effective in solving rolling scheduling problems.

articleTitle: The green supply chain-the case of The Body Shop
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: This article illustrates the global Cosmetic retailer - The Body Shop's successful transformation from its old mission statement (Green its product line) to the new mission statement (Green its entire supply chain). Firstly, it gives a brief introduction about the background of case study. Then it analyses trade-offs of benefits and costs of green supply chain. Following this, The Body Shop's Strategies to Achieve Green Supply Chain are described, they're: Partnership strategy, Information Technology (IT) strategy, Waste Minimize Strategy and Transportation Strategy. Finally, Conclusion is made as an ending.

articleTitle: Realization of strong ports and shipping services in developing countries using multi-criteria selection algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Trade is growing as a proportion of world GDP and this was obvious during the financial crises during the year of 2008. Governments and international organizations gave a higher priority to improving ports and shipping services. This leads to deregulation, which, together with technological advances, increases the incentives for shipping companies to form alliances and to merge. Another cause of the process of developing countries to reevaluate the situation is technological change, which has led to an increase of fixed costs as a proportion of total average costs. This leads to larger optimum unit sizes of vessels, ports, and companies, which in turn reduces the number of participants in the long-term market equilibrium. To analyze the impacts of these trends, the paper examines the use of multi-criteria selection mechanism to achieve economies of scale in ports of developing countries. The criteria are based on declines in liner shipping companies' profits; the danger of overcapacity; fluctuations in freight-rates; the strength of alliances; ports as transshipment centers; options for small liner operators; benefits for importers, exporters and consumers; and the implications for regulatory bodies.

articleTitle: City distribution service quality: A factor impacting on supplier-customer relationship and customer satisfaction
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: This paper seeks to propose a conceptual structural equation model to investigate the relationships among city distribution service quality (SQ), supplier-customer relationship (SCR) and customer satisfaction (CS) and to demonstrate their direct and indirect effects on each other. An empirical study is conducted in Beijing and the collected survey data are used to verify the relationships among the three factors expressed in the proposed structural equation model. The results show that SQ has a direct and significant impact on SCR and CS. In addition, SQ influences CS indirectly through SCR which has direct and significant influences on CS. The most significant dimension of SQ is responsiveness and the least one is tangibles. The results are useful for other large international cities where the circumstances are similar to Beijing since data from Beijing were collected and used in this research.

articleTitle: The analysis on the role of the government in the creative industries cluster development based on the industrial cluster mechanism of the outside source
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: After defining the concept of creative industry cluster and citing the industrial cluster mechanism of the outside source, and drawing on the successful experiences of the domestic and foreign governments in the creative industries cluster development, we focus on the role of the government in the creative industry cluster and put forward of the feasible suggestions.

articleTitle: Ultimatum game analysis for national forest right reform
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: This paper analyzes the national forest right reform process of the problems, and reveals that the uneven distribution of interests of all forest owners involved in the process of reform is the root for preventing the reform process. We try to apply game theory to study the game behaviors of all forest owners in the process of national forest right reform. Based on the game theory, the ultimatum game was introduced in the current study. The aim of the present study is to propose the optimum solutions on the viewpoints of income distribution between nation and forestry enterprises, thus promoting the process of national forest right reform. With the reforming of the forest right more thoroughly, the game basing on consideration mode to balance the interests of all forest owners is through the whole game process, and when the all parties including nation, forestry enterprises and employees gained the relative most interests, respectively, the game equilibrium could be reached. At the same time, the system of forest is the most effective on this equilibrium point. In this reform process, as the proposer and the most important administrator, the nation should fully consider the interest of the forest enterprises.

articleTitle: Percolation's criticality of moral hazards in supply chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: To control the moral hazards in the supply chain under an acceptable critical point, and make the supply chain more robust, according to the inducing and transferring mechanisms about moral hazards in supply chain, the critical point of moral hazards percolation, when the moral hazards are happened randomly and intentionally, are analyzed respectively. The results show that the parameters of system percolation's criticality are decided by m<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>, K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>, m<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, the threshold of average In-degree and average Out-degree, and ß<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sub>, the character of the supply chain.

articleTitle: Stability analysis and stabilization for singular systems with multiple time-varying delay
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: This paper considers the problem associated with the stability analysis and stabilization for singular systems with multiple time-varying delays. The delay-dependent stability criterion and the method of designing state feedback stabilization controller are obtained by using Lyapunov second method and LMI techniques. Numerical examples illustrate the efficiency and feasibility of our method.

articleTitle: Clustering navigation patterns using closed repetitive gapped subsequence
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Categorizing visitors based on their navigation patterns on a website is a key problem in electronic logistics. However, user navigation data and feature vector extracted from it are sparse, and traditional clustering method doesn't solve this problem satisfactorily. As a step forward, a closed repetitive gapped subsequence mining based navigation pattern clustering method is proposed. Feature vector of navigation patterns is constructed with repetitive support of subsequence. A bidirectional projected Euclidean distance based fuzzy dissimilarity is proposed and used as distance measure of feature vectors. Experiment result show that this clustering method is effective and efficient.

articleTitle: Closed loop supply chain network design under competitive environment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: A large-scale enterprise is planning to select right locations to open a number of firms and enter an existed industry. The entering enterprise has to compete with the existed enterprises. Furthermore, original network economic equilibrium must be break and the network will attain new equilibrium state. Hence, one-leader-multiple-followers Stackelberg strategies problem is discussed that the entering one behaves as the leader and the existed ones are followers. Network equilibrium model is used to obtain the economic equilibrium state. A network design model is proposed by using the methods of equilibrium theory and variational inequality. A hybrid solution method is built to solve the problem. Finally, a numerical example is given to show rationality of the model.

articleTitle: Evaluation of R&D projects with uncertainty based on evidence reasoning
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: This paper presents an assessment model for research and development (R&D) projects considering uncertainty in their overall life cycle. Technology maturity and competitive advantages were considered and a Balanced Scorecard (BSC) model was developed to evaluate R&D projects. Based on the multilevel evaluation framework, an evidence reasoning approach has been developed to aggregate the numerical data and qualitative information with uncertainty. The expected utility is applied to describe preferences of decision-makers in the decision process. A case study in the context of automobile R&D projects is given to illustrate the methods.

articleTitle: Research on job-shop scheduling problem based on Self-Adaptation Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The multi-objective optimization problem in flexible job-shop scheduling was discussed. According to the characteristics of flexible job-shop scheduling, a new self-adaptive genetic algorithm was proposed, and the model of Multi-Objective Flexible Job-shop Scheduling (MOFJS) was set up. At last, by programming with Matlab and Visual C++, the algorithm was applied to solve the MOFJS problem in Chinese automobile manufacturing enterprises, and the optimization scheduling solution was obtained. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm is feasible and effective for MOFJS.

articleTitle: Fuzzy sliding mode control for robotic manipulators based on passivity theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Aiming at the model uncertainties and external disturbances of the robotic systems, First regard the exterior disturbances as system input, with skew-symmetric characteristics of the robot, this paper designed a controller based on the theory of passivity, and then used the classic sliding mode control to compensate the uncertainties' influence. In order to eliminate chattering of sliding mode controller, the fuzzy control method was introduced, in which the sliding surface was regarded as the input of fuzzy controller while the output was the weight of compensation controller. Afterwards, proposed controllers were used in trajectory control of a two degrees of freedom robot. The simulation results show that the controllers can achieve tracking effect with high speed, guarantee asymptotic convergence of the tracking error to zero and enhance the robustness of the system.

articleTitle: Study on setting up the credit risk assessment model of logistics finance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Logistics finance can not only solve manufacturing firm bottleneck problem of financing, promoting third party logistics enterprise service development, but also provide the condition for banking industry's financial innovation. While this kind of emerging service gives many benefits to the commercial bank, it brings certain credit risk to them. The article has analyzed the factors that influence credit risk in logistic finance, constructed the assessment index system and formed the risks' appraisal model based on.

articleTitle: Freight volume forecasting method based on Gray Neural Network model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: One of the key preconditions for setting down long-term transport planning and doing reasonable transport investments scientifically is forecasting volume of freight reliably. This paper builds Grey Neural Network model according to characteristics of grey model GM(1,1) and artificial neural networks (ANN) model. Grey Neural model overcomes the shortcoming of singularity forecasting model, thereby it increases the reliability level of forecasting results. The paper verifies Grey Neural Network model though comparing with raw statistics date of calendar year in Jilin province, and it also forecasts volume of freight for future. The results show that forecasting precision of the model is high and it shows much faster convergence rate.

articleTitle: Countermeasures to cope with waste electrical and electronic equipment in Guangxi
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The rapid economic development has promoted the demand for electronic products and consumption, which caused the rapid expansion of the waste electrical and electronic equipment. These made a tremendous impact on the recycle economy development and the environment protection in Guangxi. By means of field research and statistical data analysis methods, analysis of e-waste recycling situation, summed up the electronic waste recycling to the existence of major obstacle in Guangxi: the total distribution of electronic waste is not certain, the E-waste market is complicated, the non-governmental workshops adopt the simple technology to dispose e-waste in Guangxi and so on. To cope with these problems, summarizing the electronic waste recycling practices and experience in developed countries as well as in Taiwan, and some countermeasures and suggestions for e-waste recycling have been highlighted in Guangxi.

articleTitle: A new fault diagnosis system for train BearingsBased on PCA and ACO
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The objective of this paper is to propose a new system for fault diagnosis of train bearings using PCA and ACO. On the base of the analysis of time and frequency domain statistical features extracted from the vibration signals collected from the bearings, twenty features which were the most sensitive to different working states were chosen as the object of follow-on process. After zero-average and unit-variance pretreatment, PCA was carried out to compress the data dimension and eliminate the correlation among different statistical features. Then the eigenvectors consist of the front four principle components extracted by PCA were discretized to twenty domains as the input of the fault diagnosis system, in which the ACO was explored to generate classification rules. Heuristic function and probability function were suggested in this system to optimize the original ACO arithmetic. The experiments show that this new bearing fault diagnosis system can generate classification rules successfully and recognize different working states of bearings exactly.

articleTitle: Emergency resources dynamic assignment problem statement and modelling
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: This paper addresses stochastic dynamic assignment of perishable goods in a scale-free network. We develop an agent-based simulation model in which the supplies and demands for a single perishable commodity are generated at each node (agent) in the network. We match supplies and demands with several pre-specified assignment rules and given various commodity decay durations. A utility is associated with each assignment based on the spatial proximity between the supplier and the recipient. We assess various rules in terms of overall network utility. Our computational results show that 1) it is beneficial to use hybrid assignment rules that integrate the spirit of system-wide assignment and that of local preferred assignment; 2) it may be beneficial to allow agent behaviour changes with certain degree of autonomy.

articleTitle: Forecasting methods and application of regional logistics demand based on wavelet neural network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Wavelet neural network is a neural network combining the wavelet theory with neural network theory, which avoids nonlinear optimization problems such as blindness of the design of BP neural network structure and local optimum, greatly simplifying the training. The use of wavelet neural networks to forecast regional logistics demand provided an important reference for regional logistics systematic planning and the rational allocation of logistic resources. Therefore, the use of regional economic indicators to forecast regional logistics demand had strong feasibility and promotes the coordinated development between regional logistics industry and regional economy. The model reveals nonlinear mapping relationship between the regional economy and regional logistics demand and provides a new idea and method for the regional logistics demand forecasting.

articleTitle: Study on multi-destination emergency scheduling model under dynamic continuous consumption
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: With the purpose to enhance efficiency and accurate of emergency dispatch, realize reasonable distribution material quantity, reduce life and property loss caused by paroxysmal emergency events, a dynamic continuous consumption emergency scheduling model is established. Some features of emergency scheduling goals are analyzed. The objective function includes minimizing earliest emergency start time and the least disaster relief participated places. Simultaneously, satisfactory degree of disaster area is also considered in the objective function. Two main categories of constraints, namely, continuous consumption, supply and demand quantity are considered. GA is employed to solve the model, and the basic implement step of GA is given in detail. To employ GA easily, the constraints are disposed with penalty function idea so that they are introduced to the fitness value. To validate the validity of GA, the multi disaster places emergency scheduling problem for dynamic and continuous consumption is abstracted. The experiment shows that by multi running, GA can get multi efficient typical solutions so as to provide significant support for decision-making of emergency scheduling. The global search capacity of GA is strong, and it is suitable to solve complex optimization problems such as emergency scheduling problem under dynamic and continuous consumption condition.

articleTitle: Research on supply chain coordination strategies under asymmetric information
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The coordination problem of a supply chain with one supplier and one retailer is analyzed under the condition that the cost information of the retailer is asymmetric. A revenue-sharing contract model is established, in the model, the supplier have the decision-making power of wholesale price and revenue sharing ratio, and the retailer have the decision-making power of hiding the information of marginal cost and confirming order quantity and retail price. The coordination mechanism issue of both the centralized supply chain and the decentralized supply chain under symmetric information is analyzed respectively. Meanwhile, based on that the cost information of the retailer is asymmetric, an incentive mechanism is established in order to prevent the retailer from providing false cost information and increase their profit under optimizing the profit of the supply chain.

articleTitle: A novel backstepping adaptive control approach based on fuzzy neural network disturbance observer
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: A fuzzy neural network disturbance observer (FNNDO) is developed and a backstepping adaptive control approach combined with FNNDO is presented for a general class of strict-feedback nonlinear systems with a wide class of uncertainties that are not linearly parameterized and do not have any prior knowledge of the bounding functions. FNNDO is used to approximate the unknown uncertainties online, and the systematic framework for adaptive controller design is given by backstepping control approach. All signals in the closed loop system can be guaranteed uniformly ultimately bounded by Lyapunov approach. We show in our analysis and simulation that FNNDO has strong approximation ability and fuzzy linguistic interpretation. High control precision for the control system can be achieved.

articleTitle: The regulation model of pharmaceutical logistics based on the supervision of flow
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: As an important part of medicine distribution, medicine logistics can effect the operation of medical service system of state. Medicine monitoring, a special motivational techniques, requires a high level of security, stability and operational efficiency. Also, it can promote the management of medicine distribution. This article integrates the input-output thought of economics, the cybernetics and the logistics in a brand-new perspective. It is innovatively proposed that people can detect the fake medicine sneaking into the normal circulation sphere of medicine through monitoring the differential flow in the distribution system of medicine. Then they track the illegal dealer and check the distribution system. Eventually, they detect the channel used to mix the fake medicine into the normal circulation sphere of medicine and carry out measures. So it's no doubt that this model can contribute to the safety construction of medicine circulation in our state.

articleTitle: CRM measurement indicator system of logistics enterprises for data-mining
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The vast majority of CRM implementation is failure to achieve desired results due to lack of successful CRM measurement indicators for it. Hence, a CRM measurement indicator system and a brief corresponding follow-up data-mining model were proposed and presented to guide the development and implementation of CRM tactics in logistics enterprises, especially for large-scale ones. Some principles of using the indicator system into the data-mining model were also discussed briefly. Finally, a quantitative analysis example illustrated that the effectiveness of the indicator system and the data-mining model in the actual logistics enterprise.

articleTitle: Research on knowledge transfer process and performance evaluation model among supply chain members
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: A knowledge transfer process model among supply chain members is proposed. The relationship between factors of influencing knowledge transfer and knowledge transfer performance is discussed with the methods of theoretical and quantitative analysis. The results show that the knowledge transfer among supply chain members can be divided into three levels, including between supply chain and external environment, between members of supply chain, and organization's internal knowledge transfer. Knowledge transfer performance among supply chain members is affected by knowledge characteristics, communication and trust degree among supply chain members, supply chain members' knowledge absorptive capacity, knowledge transfer channels' richness and knowledge transfer cost. An undirected weighted small-world network model can be used to evaluate the knowledge transfer performance among supply chain members.

articleTitle: Analysis for the seasonal goods purchase while the supplier repurchase unsold goods
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Analyzed the effect for the retailer's order quantity caused by the supplier repurchase unsold goods under demand uncertainty, under condition of different demand uncertainty and different repurchase price the result of optimal order quantity of the retailer was simulated by mathematics model. the result shows the order quantity of the retailer increase and the expectation margin reduce with demand uncertainty increase; and also shows the supplier can make the retailer order more quantity by use of optimizing combination of whole sell price and repurchase price under the same demand uncertainty so that could gain more the expectation margin.

articleTitle: The effects of personal value on corporate social responsibility orientation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Although there has been a fair amount of research on factors determining corporate social responsibility orientation (CSRO), few studies have addressed manager's personal values. This study examined the effects of manager's personal values on his CSRO. The regression analysis of a survey data of 167 managers shows that the self-enhancement and openness to change values have positive effects on economic CSRO, negative effects on ethical and legal CSRO, and altruistic values have negative effects on economic CSRO, and positive effects on legal CSRO, and traditional values have positive effects on ethical CSRO.

articleTitle: Consumer logistics tradeoffs in EGS environment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Even with advantages of fastness, convenience, time saving and low price, whether E-Grocery Shopping (EGS) is accepted by consumers is mostly determined by its efficient logistics service provided for customers taking into consideration groceries' characteristics such as perishability, idiosyncrasy and intensive experience. The rigorous definition of Consumer Logistics was given and the motivations of its formation were analyzed. Then, tradeoffs online grocers faced in their consumer logistics strategy were discussed in detail. The results indicate that consumer logistics can be accepted by consumers and there will be a bright development prospect in the future when such issues as freshness tradeoff, consumption habit tradeoff, pickingup tradeoff and unattended delivery tradeoff are addressed.

articleTitle: A case-based reasoning system for enterprise informalization: Development and management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: In order to decrease the hardship of the knowledge transferring and sharing between enterprises. We designed a Case-based reasoning mechanism for enterprise informalization projects. After an intensive survey of enterprise informalization we defined the case hierarchical representation in detail to enable project managers to describe project requirements adequately. Furthermore, we proposed a combination method of subjective and objective weights to the nearest neighbor algorithm for enterprise informalization case retrieval, which can facilitate users to get more comfortable. In addition, a framework of enterprise informalization project system based on CBR was built and the portion functions of the system were designed. Finally, an example was given for describing the CBR system.

articleTitle: Base on Bayesian Network of supply chain enterprises collaborative sensitivity analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: At present, the collaborative relationships between enterprises have a significant impact on operating efficiency for the supply chain. Base on Bayesian Network theory, the paper establishes a model of collaborative sensitive index of enterprises in the supply chain by adopting methods of genetic algorithms, and introduces collaborative programs that can improve the efficiency of the entire supply chain, which make related enterprises timely find various problems that need to be addressed, and make the efficiency of work increased.

articleTitle: Selection of transaction model for supply chain based on transaction cost
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The extent of the transaction cost is an important factor to determine the supply chain trading patterns. Using the Buyer-Seller Model, the dimensions of supply chain transaction cost have been analyzed, and the supply chain trading patterns have been determined through setting variables. A conclusion has been arrived that the co-governance model is superior to the integration mode and the complete logistics outsourcing transaction mode under the condition of the demand-side and supply-side real investment independence.

articleTitle: Re-discussion on purchase and preventing corruption
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Four regulations and rules regarding specification of procurement action and prevention of corruption are proposed to achieve Sunshine-purchase. A set of standard tenders and proposed procurement processes and graphics are designed. But Institutionalized management is not omnipotent, the achievement of Sunshine-purchase still requited to create a anti-corruption cultural atmosphere, establish the concept of service and guarantee, notice the importance of professional training and raise the professional skill standard and so on.

articleTitle: Research on risk assessment of hazardous freight road transportation based on BP neural network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: For enhancing the safety standards of hazardous freight road transportation and reducing accidents, the risk assessment methodology of hazardous freight road transportation system is introduced. By establishing the risk of hazardous freight road transportation comprehensive assessment model based on BP neural network theory, the right degree of safety of hazardous freight road transportation has a more precise quantitative understanding. A numerical example is used to demonstrate that the model is efficacious.

articleTitle: Empirical analysis of influences of fictitious economy on real economy in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Influences of fictitious economy on real economy appeared gradually in China. An empirical analysis about the influences was given by using quarterly data from April 1998 to December 2008. The results show that there is cointegration relationship between China's fictitious economy and real economy in the long term; there is Granger cause of the representative variables of China's fictitious economy to the representative variable of real economy respectively; the influences of the turnover of stock trading, the turnover of foreign exchange transactions, and the turnover of commodity futures trading on the real economy are much remarkable based on the least squares analysis which is consistent to the conclusion of variance decomposition; and the effect from stock market to real economy is strongest in China. Therefore, the results indicate that the influences of stock market, foreign exchange market and commodity futures market on real economy development of China are much remarkable.

articleTitle: Marginal-able correlated equilibria for A 3-person 0–1 game in form(ΔS(0), ΔS(1), ΔS(2))
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The author studies 3-person games in normal form satisfy the conditions. (1) Every player's utility has nothing to do with his number, called symmetry. (2) Every player has exactly two pure actions 0 and 1. (3) There exists exactly one NE (i.e. Nash equilibrium) and none of the three players' actions in NE is pure. (4) Every player's gain is different if he uses 1 or 0 and none, one or two of the two other players use 1. (5) The difference of every player's gains is different if he uses 1 or 0 and none, one or two of the two other players use 1. In order to study the smaller and refiner correlated equilibria, the author confines the set of correlated equilibria (CE) such that marginal distribution of its element is exactly the NE, called set of marginal-able correlated equilibria (MCE). Some formulas to compute CE are given. Not liking general CE, MCE is computable and it and NE are more closely linked. The conclusion (i.e. key result) is that MCE in the game is a closed segment in 8-dimensional Euclidean space.

articleTitle: Research on collection of process data based on RFID technology for job-shop
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Intelligent Manufacturing Systems requires advanced and efficient information technologies and tools in order to achieve value creation in global markets. Radio frequency identification (RFID) is a novel information technology that helps companies to monitor and control the manufacturing process in time through the collection of manufacturing data in the job-shop. In this paper, we present a real-time data collection policy for dynamic job-shop based on RFID technology. Specifically, the framework presented allows for information-feedback based dynamic manufacturing process control where information collected about the system is used to help to make the real-time decisions and realize the closed-loop control of production process, thus make job-shop process controlling more feasible and effective. Experimental studies indicate that the main superiority of the suggested approach is the easily way for data acquisition, sharing and feedback of complex dynamic information in manufacturing process, even in situations when there are frequent disruptions in the job-shop, including the disruptions caused by the introduction of tight due date jobs or machine breakdown. This solution offers an affordable, stable, and high performance solution to transform the shop floor production control into a more intelligent system with faster information collection and feedback cycles.

articleTitle: Revenue management with incomplete information dynamic competition
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: This paper discusses revenue maximization problems for multi-retailers competition, each retailer has a stock of items and sells them with dynamic pricing based on her/his own stock and other retailers' stock during a finite time horizon. At any time, each retailer does not know the accurate stock of other retailer, but knows their distribution. A differential game model for the competitive revenue management problem is constructed, and some properties of the retailer's equilibrium revenue and pricing strategy are obtained. Moreover, a non-competition model is constructed to obtain the up-bound of the equilibrium revenue of competition problem.

articleTitle: Partners' selection and evaluation mechanism research in agile supply chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Agile supply chain management is a complex systems engineering, the operation process of which is uncertain and dynamic. It requires the analysis concerning the process of partnership establishment and problems may come up during the cooperation with the starting point of the essence of partnership, and also the formulation of realistic and feasible selection mechanism and evaluation system of partners.

articleTitle: The risk control of pledge liquidation in logistics finance based on VaR methodology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The ability of pledge liquidation is essential to logistics finance risk control. In the process of evaluating the ability of pledge liquidation, the price stabilization of pledge is what should be mostly considered. VaR (Value at Risk) methodology is an effective measuring method to determine risks in the field of financial risk management. Quantitative analysis of risk degree caused by price fluctuation was made with that method. It can estimate the maximum possible loss in the future, determine an appropriate line of credit and thus could be used as a reference for risk prediction and prevention when banks provide logistics finance service.

articleTitle: Study on the strategy for pharmaceutical enterprises to improve the Third-Party Logistics development levels
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The developments of Chinese pharmaceutical enterprises in the process of the Third-Party Logistics industry, specifically the existence of some key issues were analyzed, and the Third-Party Logistics was proposed to improve the levels of Chinese pharmaceutical enterprises development measures, based on analyzing the implementation of SWOT strategy in pharmaceutical enterprises.

articleTitle: Study of supply chain monitoring system based on IDEF method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Aiming at the business competition in the global market, how to real-timely monitor the dynamic trends of supply chain in the market has been a difficulty of supply chain management. By putting into several levels of monitoring process of the supply chain, we developed a method for the information system of supply chain monitoring on the basis of the IDEF model. With this method, one would expect to detect unexpected variations at an early stage and to give early-warnings for potential risks. The enterprises would have enough time to respond to unwanted situations, to take preventive decisions and to meet efficiently the market demands.

articleTitle: Simulation and bottleneck analysis of container port handling resources based on bounding theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Studying on container terminal, a bottleneck simulation model of container terminal handling is built by using eM-Plant simulation platform, this queuing network mathematical model of container port handling resources including shore container crane, gantry crane and container trucks. The bottleneck of container port handling resources is calculated through the analysis of system output index and the theory of constraints. Calculation and analysis indicates that by using the queuing models and simulation, bottlenecks of container port handling resources can be analyzed.

articleTitle: The application of embedded system in the resistance welding machine
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Based on the principle of the asymmetric control of the resistance welding machine, this paper adopted embedded system as the controlling core and carried out the simulation experiment to verify this principle. On the basis of the applying circuit of transformer resistance experiments, the transformer primary voltage experiment has been priority carried out. The results indicate that the primary equivalent voltage of asymmetric control is higher than that of segment chopper control.

articleTitle: A forecast netting and consumption model for advanced planning and scheduling
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: This paper features an advanced planning system (APS) in which the forecasts and customer demands are balanced to arrive at the netted forecast for the production system to produce purchase orders and production orders. The forecast process to collaborate the demand and the forecast is rarely considered in the planning and scheduling models. In this paper, a new decision support process for netting forecast is presented, which includes two processes to prepare the netted forecast for the weekly and daily production planning, respectively. The weekly forecast netting process does the netting for the weekly demand, and the daily forecast consumption process handles the daily demand. The proposed approaches are being applied in a practical application of APS system, which is implemented in Alcatel Shanghai Bell.

articleTitle: The research of control strategy on AOD furnace tilting system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: In view of the low speed, the heavy load, reversing, the frequently brake, the intense impact characteristics of AOD furnace tilting system, The double closed-loop with feedforward is used. Position regulator and speed regulator use PID algorithm. And the speed loop is designed, based on vector control. This control system was simulated by MATLAB Simulink software. The simulation result showed: Adjustment time is 8s, the position steady-state error is 0, so it has achieved the demanded target of 0.12 radian static error fully.

articleTitle: Study on performance assess of bonded logistics based on supply chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The bonded Logistics comes into being as a kind of logistics management mode associated with increasing global operations of transnational corporations and international distribution needs. This paper studied bonded logistics from the perspective of the supply chain to measure the role the bonded logistics played to the supply chain performance with the microscopic point of view. This paper introduced the system dynamics method and established the bonded logistics system dynamics model by using the supply chain idea on the basis of the introduction of the cross-border vendor management inventory model system. The overall supply chain inventory, sales volume and supplier costs were examined under different states by changing the customs clearance time in the model. Finally, the simulation results are analyzed to get the conclusions that the bonded logistics can reduce costs and improve supply chain performance effectively in the cross-supply chain.

articleTitle: Data exhibition and mining for multimodal transport based on data warehouse
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Studied the spiral development process of data warehouse based on the multimodal transport system, took typical multimodal transport station as an example, constructed data warehouse system which integrated transport modes, conveyances and process information to reflect the whole data warehouse. Carried out on-line analysis and data mining to extract important clients and to solve the shortest route problem.

articleTitle: CBR based expert system for house repair after earthquake
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: To improve practical efficiency and theory feasibility of house repair or reinforce measures so as to reduce life and property loss as could as possible after large scale earthquake, the two stage CBR implement mode is proposed to realize expert system for house repair or reinforce after earthquake. The first stage CBR system is employed to make out house repair strategies, and the second stage CBR systems is employed to make out house repair detail steps and instruction after earthquake. Thus, both the reasoning reaction velocity and the precision are ensured. In both stage CBR systems, four key technologies including case presentation, case retrieval, case adaptation and case maintenance are studied respectively. The system running result shows that, comparing with the conventional single state CBR system, both average case retrieved ratio and average case satisfactory degree by the two stage CBR system are obviously improved. The two stage CBR system is suitable for solving complex and multi disposing problems such as house repair after earthquake.

articleTitle: Tuning PID control parameters on hydraulic servo control system based on chaos quantum-behaved particle swarm optimization algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The PID control parameters are very important to performance of hydraulic servo control system and how to find rapidly the optimum values of PID control parameters is very difficult problem. To overcome the problem of low convergence speed and sensitivity to local convergence with the traditional quantum-behaved particle swarm optimization (QPSO) to handle optimum problem, a novel method of judging the local convergence by the variance of the population's fitness was proposed, and the chaos quantum-behaved particle swarm optimization algorithm (CQPSO) was proposed. The program CQPSO1.0 was developed. Based on Matlab/simulink software and taking the IATE standards of optimization design as objective function, the proposed method was applied for the optimization of the three parameters of PID controller of electric-hydraulic servo system of 6-DOF parallel platform. Simulation results show that the proposed parameter optimum method is an effective tuning strategy and has good performance.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-echelon inventory model of cold-chain logistics on random demand
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The general structure of the Multi-echelon inventory in cold-chain logistics is analyzed in this paper. It is divided into three levels: production cold storage, cold storage centers and sales cold storage, which is a confluence-branch structure. A Multi-echelon inventory model of cold-chain logistics on random demand is put forward. The objective of the model is to meet the marker demand as much as possible within the lowest cost of building and operating cold storages. In the case of random customer needs, each level of the cold-chain requires to decide the scale of cold storage according to the market demand cover rate, so as to avoid the cold storage vacancy that lead to a surplus of building costs and operating expenses.

articleTitle: Research on optimization problem of oil product secondary distribution based on the table-manipulation method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: A cost model of oil product secondary distribution system is proposed for the multi-variety oil product. Transportation assignment optimization of oil product secondary distribution with multiple oil depot distribution centers and multiple oil stations are studied. A transportation assignment scheme is obtained by the table-manipulation method. Total transportation cost can be optimized by the transportation assignment scheme. Based on this scheme, the total transportation cost of oil product secondary distribution can be calculated. Finally, a numerical example is given to verify the effectiveness of this scheme.

articleTitle: Research on comprehensive evaluation of urban public transport competitiveness in Hebei province based on TOPSIS
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The comprehensive analysis of urban public transport has an important role in promoting the development of urban public transport. Based on the characteristics of urban public transport, following the principles of scientific, integrity and operational, this paper built a competitive evaluation index system for urban public transport, then the comprehensive evaluation method based on the TOPSIS is brought out trying to analyze the urban public transport competitiveness after the index system is established. And then, a case study is executed among 20 cities in Hebei province as an example. The research results reveal that the method can efficiently evaluate to the urban public transport competitiveness. So it can give good advice to the policy maker.

articleTitle: Effect of governance on management in public project
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Project governance (PG) is a newborn theory and it plays a more and more important role in the improvement of public project management performance (PPMP). The purpose of this paper is to explore the effect of PG on project management (PM) which has approved positive effect on PPMP. Therefore, the relationship between PG and PM in public project is discussed, and then the mechanism of PG affecting PM in public project is analyzed theoretically. The findings show that PG and PM belong to the different research paradigms and PG can optimize the process of PM through its three basic functions, i.e. incenting, restricting and harmonizing. We hope that this study is helpful to the understanding of GMP framework presented in our previous research and then can bring public projects into success.

articleTitle: Process management of large-scale medical facilities supported by information technology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Combined with the real situation of medical treatment organizations in China, the workflow of CT examination in municipal hospital was taken as a research object. First, every factor that affects the time of CT examination was analyzed through collecting data. Then, by applying methods of workflow analysis and management theories of industry engineering, the workflow of CT examination is optimized and the operation program is standardized. Moreover, by taking advantage of information-based methods, the service level and utilization ratio of the equipment system in medical treatment organizations are improved.

articleTitle: Study on virtual team: Operation mechanism and complexity
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Integration of global economy has great impact on traditional organizational activities, and requires more flexible and dynamic structure to meet the challenge of competition. With the development of hi-tech, the operation of virtual team becomes an important instrument to fit rapid change and complexity of business environment. Through survey, the article analysis the key factors and suggests that the complex of operation base for virtual team is due to the goals of the team, relationship of agents etc.

articleTitle: Impact of price sensitivity and risk aversion on buy-back contract
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: This paper examines the impacts of demand price sensitivity and retailer's risk aversion on characteristics of the buy back contract. The market demand is stochastic and price dependent. We adopt additive demand model. The supplier is risk neutral while the retailer is risk averse. We formulate the retailer's decision model in the form of mean-variance. The decision models of the supply chain members constitute a bi-level programming problem. We use numerical method analyze this problem. The cases in which the price sensitivity and risk aversion present different characteristics are studied and the management insights are distilled.

articleTitle: A user-centered resources model for redesigning self-service check-in system based on distributed cognition
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Part of self-service check-in systems in China are designed without taking user-centered design methods and guidelines into account. According to our research conducted at two airports in China, many users are not satisfied, some users even frustrated and give up using self-service check-in system. This significantly increases staff's working load and leads to great waste of resources. Therefore, redesigning the current problematic self-service check-in system based on user-centered methods becomes crucial in order to improve the usability of self-service check-in system in China, and to enhance user experience. In this paper, distributed cognition theory is applied for studying how the information process between human and artifacts in a system. The paper provides a review of previous research based on different user-centered methods and adds a new concept into the extended resources model stemmed from distributed cognition for guiding the redesign process of the current self-service check-in system.

articleTitle: Research on the agent construction service reward from the perspective of project governance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: From the perspective of project governance, this paper analyzed the responsibility, right and interest for the construction enterprise, established a risk allocation reward mechanism and divided reward into fixed and risk rewards for agent construction service. As the agent construction service is a kind of complex project management service, its price also should be a complex one. This paper took the bidding, consultation and supervision rate as the benchmarking, and integrated them into agent construction service rate management benchmarking. Agent enterprises will take the inevitable risk while they undertook the agent construction work and they are supposed to get compensation. This paper raised a risk allocation price scenario and formed a reasonable agent construction service price mechanism according to different risk preference between government and agent enterprises.

articleTitle: The study of logistics partner selection under the 4PL model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The problem of logistics partner selection is a key problem in the operational process of fourth party logistics (4PL) model. We propose logistics partner selection index system and use the method of AHP to determine weight coefficient of each index, on the basis of analysis of the influence factors of logistics partner selection under the 4PL model. Whereas the 4PL enterprise usually selects more than one logistics enterprise of more than one kind as its partners, we propose an optimization model of the logistics partner selection under the 4PL model, based on comparing strength of each logistics enterprise and compartmentalizing the logistics demand by region. And an improved algorithm is presented based on genetic algorithm by using the methods of binary encoding, larger population size and smaller crossover probability. Finally, we carry out an example to illustrate the validity of the model and algorithm.

articleTitle: Optimization model for manufacturing/remanufacturing logistics network of disassembled products
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: An Optimization model for logistics network design in hybrid manufacturing system was presented, which suited for the disassembled products. Recycling products would be disassembled into parts and the key parts would be reused for remanufacturing. Various facilities' sites, numbers and the logistics quantities could be calculated in the model. The characteristics of model are as follows: suitable for the single-product, single-period, facility with limited capability, disassembled products and suppliers were included, combined the transportation of forward logistics and reverse logistics, and optimized the forward logistics and reverse logistics at the same time. Finally, a numerical example was presented to demonstrate the validity of the model by using lingo11.0.

articleTitle: A mixed robust optimization and multi-agent coordination method for elevator group control scheduling
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: An elevator group control scheduling (EGCS) method, which is combined with robust optimization (RO) and multi-agents, is proposed to deal with the uncertainty with the elevator traffic flow and the computation complexity. Considering the uncertainty of elevator traffic flow, the elevator schedule model based on RO is developed. An integrated method combined with multi-agent coordination (MAC) and RO schedule is designed to compensate for the disadvantage of RO for the EGCS problem. Simulation results show that the proposed method can improve the performance and adaptability of the EGCS.

articleTitle: Studies on supply logistics distribution center location based on principal component analysis for coal enterprise
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The location of logistics distribution center holds an very important position in the coal enterprise supply logistics system planning, the decision-makers need to consider various factors comprehensively. The traditional location method considers little about the interaction between the indexes during the location process. This paper introduce the principal component analysis (PCA)method in the location of logistics, and use this method to eliminate the interaction of the evaluation indexes, reduce the workload of index selection, then select and evaluate on a number of candidate schemes combine with expert estimation and related evaluation index. Finally, the location of logistics distribution center for M coal enterprise proved the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Using cusp catastrophe theory to model pick-up point choice behavior for online bookstore shopper
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Ordering books on the Internet is obviously becoming a significant market. Retailing delivery (RD) service provides consumers with a self pick-up approach, so it is popular for those who cannot conveniently use home delivery service. E-service quality and logistics service quality are the key issues in e-commerce. A nonlinear model of loyalty is suggested by past studies. The main purpose of this study is to explore how of the logistics service quality and switching cost influence the pick-up point choice behavior by using a catastrophe model. Firstly, the latent variable is defined in the confirmatory factor analysis (CFA). Secondly, the catastrophe model was used to analyze the linkages between service quality and switching cost on pick-up point service loyalty. The results indicated that the switching cost plays the splitting factor in the catastrophe model, and a high switching cost makes the discontinuous choice behavior, implications of these results for practice and research are provided.

articleTitle: Restrictions and countermeasures discussion on the construction of agricultural logistics infrastructure platform in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Based on the methods of theoretical studies and practical analysis, this paper analyzed the restrictions to China's agricultural logistics infrastructure, which are unsuitable strategies, insufficient construction investment, unreasonable distribution and imperfect management system. Then it pointed out a series of strategies to quicken the construction of agricultural logistics infrastructure. First of all, it is to raise the consciousness of the importance of agricultural logistics infrastructure. The second is to strengthen the construction of agricultural transportation. The third is to increase the investment into the soft and hard facilities of agricultural logistics. The last is to accelerate agricultural logistics node infrastructure and to develop more investing sources of agricultural logistics infrastructure. Coming to a conclusion is that it is great significant to draw on advanced experience of agricultural logistics infrastructure both at home and abroad. The aim is to advance the sustainable development of China's agriculture logistics.

articleTitle: Research of transportation scientific and technological projects evaluation based on improved triangular whitenization weight function
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: In this paper, an evaluation index system for transportation scientific and technological projects evaluation is built, which composed of three categories and two levels indexes.
