The weights of indexes are determined by AHP method. Final scores of projects are calculated by grey evaluation method based on reformative triangular whitenization weight function. The evaluation index system and evaluation methods now are an important part of the transport scientific and technical project management platform of Guangdong Transport Department.

articleTitle: An optimization analysis for electronic products recycling and material recovery
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Recycling of waste electronic products and material recovery has attached increasing attention from governments and enterprises. However, the cost is expensive and the process is complex, so choosing an appropriate processing approach to recover the precious materials is the basis of reverse recovery system formation. In this paper, the composition of electronic products and materials were analyzed first. Then processing approach for product recycling was analyzed. On the basis, two 0-1 cost-benefit models were set up in aspects of different recycling processing modes, to achieve optimal revenue from material recovery. Finally, numerical example was used to calculate and compare the two models. The result shows that there is considerable variability between different recycling processing modes, and products should be disassembled properly so as to increase material recovery revenue, and to reduce the complexity of recycling system.

articleTitle: Research on the supply chain inventory strategies under the financial crisis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: In order to reduce the inventory risk brought by the current financial crisis, the inventory strategies matching supply chain were put forward for the supply chain enterprises, based on the introduction of the conventional supply chain inventory strategies and the analysis of the impact of the financial crisis on the inventory decision. The inventory figures were built to analyze the supply chain inventory strategies by data, combined with the changes of the potential demand of supply chain under the financial crisis. Haier company was taken as an example to analysis the inventory strategies. Results show that the inventory cost of the enterprises can be reduced greatly when the supply chain strategies are changed from QR to ECR under the financial crisis and the supply chain enterprises should strengthen the ECR strategy to reduce inventory cost effectively.

articleTitle: An optimized strategy based on demanders' satisfaction for rescue resource allocation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: To solve the problem of distributing special resources, such as rescue resources, healthcare resources and military resources etc, a simplex model is proposed based on the item's saturation of resources and total satisfaction of demanders. The advantages and drawbacks of the simplex model are analyzed, and an improved resource allocation model, called one by one model, is proposed for solving the problem of the special resource allocation, in which the demanders' satisfaction is taken as the objective function instead of the commonly used economic benefit. It proves that the one by one model is more reliable for the rescue resource allocation than the linear programming model.

articleTitle: Integer programming model and dynamic programming based heuristic algorithm for the heavy plate shuffling problem in the Iron and steel industry
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: This paper presents the heavy plate shuffling problem (HPSP), which is motivated by the logistics operations of the heavy plate outgoing in the finished product warehouse. The required plates are taken out according to the given retrieval sequence. If a required plate is located under other plates in a stack, shuffling occurs. HPSP determines the restorage spaces for plates to be shuffled while minimizing the total shuffling number and the total crane traveling distance. The problem is formulated as an integer-programming model by considering the practical stacking and shuffling constraints on the heave plate. Furthermore, a two-phase heuristic algorithm based on dynamic programming is proposed to solve it. In the first phase, an initial solution is generated by approximate dynamic programming. And then it will be improved through an iterated local search in the second phase. Compared with the current used approach, computational results show that the proposed new method reduces the total increased shuffling number by 10.18% and the total traveling distance by 3.27% on average, respectively.

articleTitle: A designing method based on Matthew effects for logistics network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: In order to resolve the problem of difficult designing the layout in dynamic logistics network, a logistics' designing method based on Matthew effects was put forward out in the paper. Firstly, the economic effect in the growth process of logistics network was analyzed, then, the attachment formula came with the growth of the network; based on it, the growth process of adding nodes and edges was discussed, and the clustering coefficient was arrived to balance the degree of the nodes. Case study showed that the logistics' designing method is reasonable.

articleTitle: China railway restructuring: Analysis on effective competition
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The restructuring of railways in the world started from 1980s. Every country broke monopoly, introduced competition as the aim of restructuring and put various kinds of restructuring models into practice. Though the restructuring of the world railways have been carried out for decades, China railway still maintains the railway bureau model in the charge of the Railway Ministry. Based on the background, the paper makes an analysis of China railway restructuring and building an effective competition. The paper believes that China railway is not qualified to introduce internal competition at this stage. It would be better to encourage external competition in a certain period before the time is proper to build internal competition, which would be more accordant with the actual situation of China railway.

articleTitle: Research on the application of CM-agent model in public projects of post-disaster reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: CM-agent model is proposed based on the requirements that public projects of post-disaster reconstruction should be carried out quickly with high quality while the financial fund is reasonably distributed. At the project governance level of agent construction system and the project management level of CM model, CM-agent model solves the construction management problem in public projects of post-disaster reconstruction, achieve integration project governance with project management and analyzes the support mechanism that would ensure successful execution of CM-agent model. The research suggests that as a new construction management model, CM-agent model meets construction requirements for public projects of post-disaster reconstruction.

articleTitle: Research on slotting allowance decision in the two-echelon supply chain with retailer-led
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The size of slotting allowance has a direct relation to the success of the members' co-operation in a two-echelon supply chain. Suppose the slotting allowance being a return of manufacturer profits, the paper built up a distribution of profits and price decision-making model under two cases of the supply chain with one manufacturer to one retailer and two retailers, examined slotting allowance decision. In the two-echelon supply chain consisting of one manufacturer and one retailer, the paper gave up the size of slotting allowance. In the two-echelon supply chain consisting of one manufacturer and two retailers, the paper made a conclusion that manufacturer's wholesale price and size of slotting allowance have a direct proportion relationship.

articleTitle: Dynamic selection of supplier in chain catering industry
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Based on chain catering industry, the paper sets up a supplier selection index system, the relevance between indexes are reduced through factor analysis, then, supplier can be analyzed by the model of C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>R. Further more, to achieve the dynamic selection of supplier, life cycle of enterprise development is introduced, which make contribution to the integration of supply chain. Finally, the method of supplier dynamic selection is tested and verified by a numerical example.

articleTitle: Optimum design of four-bar linkage of beam-pumping unit based on sensitivity analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Sensitivity analysis on four-bar linkage of beam pumping unit was carried out in this study. The sensitivity of the six traditional design variables of the four-bar linkage on the maximum torque factor TF¿¿ ¿<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">max</sub> and the maximum acceleration a<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">max</sub> were analyzed, meanwhile, the effects of the design variables on the two object functions were determined. The variable with larger sensitivity value was conducted as the main design variable in this study, and a genetic algorithm (GA)is adopted to optimize the four-bar mechanism of beam pumping. The results show that the performance indexes of beam pumping unit were improved obviously as the result of modifying the sizes of sensitive parts.

articleTitle: The choice of node cities in regional logistics network of Heilongjiang Province
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Having a reasonable judgment on the nodes of regional logistics' network is both the need of the developing regional logistics industry and is also the demand on the sound development of economy, which has an important strategic significant in enhancing the regional economy. The paper suppose the evaluation of index system in logistics node city, using multi-level fuzzy evaluation method to have a comprehensive evaluation under the logistics capacity of the major cities in Heilongjiang Province, and according to the comparison index, comprehensively reflect in the status and role of regional logistics system, finally define an reasonable position of its functions. The proposal of this model will has a certain value in selected scientific of enhancing regional logistics' nodes.

articleTitle: Analysis of Business Process Reengineering based on value chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: With the development of wireless communication and internet technology, more and more companys take serious consideration on BPR (Business Process Reengineering). In elaborating domestic and foreign researches on BPR and value chain, the paper points out the research of BPR using value chain is orientation in the future. BPR is facing significant opportunity, but the successful probability of BPR is actually small. At last, an example is also included to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Performance evaluation of logistics enterprises based on Economic Value Added and Balanced Scorecard
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Motivated by increased use in practice and increased interest in the media and among academics, a performance evaluation system was built based on Economic Value Added (EVA) and Balanced Scorecard (BSC) for logistics enterprises. Correlation test and linear regression were run to give empirical support for the system. Leading the long-term vision, EVA is at the top of this system. Other measures distributed in four perspectives - Financial, Customer, Internal business process and Learning and growth - are aimed to a high EVA. EVA gets significantly positive Kendall's correlation with strategic objective whose proxy is corporate value. In linear regression whose dependent was EVA, operation cost, the first five customers' revenue ratio, audited internal control report and staff educational ratio were used to represent the four perspectives respectively. The first and the third measures have significant coefficients consistent with theoretic analysis.

articleTitle: Optimal boundaries for class-based Automated Storage/Retrieval systems considering the acceleration/deceleration of the storage and retrieval machine
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The optimal boundaries for class-based Automated Storage and Retrieval systems (AS/RSs) are derived while the acceleration/deceleration of the storage and retrieval(S/R) machine are considered. A solution procedure is developed which required only two mutually independent one-dimensional search procedures. The results show that the effect of dividing region I near to I/O point by partitioning the rack into two parts based its shape factor, has a better performs to reduce the expected travel time than the effect of dividing region II far from I/O point. Moreover, it is also shown that most of the potential improvement can be realized only by dividing the region I of warehouse into a small number of sub-regions.

articleTitle: Research on synergetic development mechanism between regional logistics system and regional economy
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The regional logistics industry is a very important mainstay industry of the regional economy, and it has an huge effect upon the regional economy development. According to the characteristics of region logistics system, the synergetic development significations of region logistics system are analyzed, and the synergetic development mechanism of regional logistics system is put forward based on the region economy convergency theory in order to effectively adjusting the regional logistics industry structure and accelerating the synergetic evolution of regional logistics system. Moreover, the synergy relation degree model between region logistics system and regional economy is built to find out the order parameter and development rules of region logistics system and guide the regional industry adjustment and economy development.

articleTitle: Analysis model of bottleneck sections in military logistics network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The alteration of logistics demand in wartime will cause the importance change of sections in military logistics network, some secondary sections may become critical ones which determine the smooth operation of the whole network and restrict the completion situation of transport task. So how to analyze the distribution of bottleneck sections in network is one key problem toward military logistics support, and based on this basis, logistics support measures may have definite purpose. In view of the above problem, this paper presents the analysis model of bottleneck sections according to correlation theory of military logistics network.

articleTitle: The optimization of reverse supply chain supernetwork
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: In this paper, we present a green reverse supply chain supernetwork model, which consists of I manufacturers, J distributors, M markets and N recyclers. Hereon this base, the optimality conditions for the manufacturers, distributors, the consumers and the recyclers are established respectively using the variational inequalities. Then we describe the optimization situation for the supply chain supernetwork model and get the stationary points for this situation. An example is illustrated to validate the utility of the supply chain supernetwork model in the last part.

articleTitle: An algorithm for improving Shapley Value method for time claim in concurrent delay
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: As a special form of construction claims, concurrent delay claim widely exists in construction claim events. At the same time, how to deal with time claim in concurrent delay correctly has became one of the difficult contents in construction claims. Based on Shapely Value method and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method, this paper presents an ameliorative algorithm for Shapely Value method. In this algorithm, time delay responsibility is allotted to each single responsible activity by Shapley Value, and then allotted between the owner and the contractor in each single responsible activity by means of fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method.

articleTitle: Research of supermarket store logistics and solutions
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The tally and cash register influence the operation efficiency of supermarket store logistics directly, in accordance with the route of proposing questions, designing programs and resolving the questions. Through applying the combination method of the subject and the objective, this paper resolved the low efficiency problem, 2/3 idle work in the tally logistics through designing the shelves, lay outing the channels and adjusting the working and so on. Applying the combination of the macro and micro-methods, it realized the separation of cash register and packing under the space layout. And applying the queuing theory controls the cash register system indices and selects queuing way reasonably. Finally, through the comparison of the domestic and foreign supermarket store logistics, this paper extracts the methods of foreign logistics which we should learn and development propose the prospects of domestic store logistics.

articleTitle: Controller design and simulation of the crane based on non-singular terminal sliding mode method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Aiming at the inaccurate problem of crane speed control under the interference condition, by employing non-singular terminal sliding mode control strategy the speed controller is designed based on the foundation of hoist system mathematics model of the crane. The simulation results in Matlab/Simulink environment show that the relative coupling control system has better dynamic performance, better stability behavior and stronger robustness.

articleTitle: Optimal logistics outsourcing: A geometric approach
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: We introduce a geometric approach to study logistics outsourcing issues in a principal-agent setting. A method is proposed to determine the optimal outsourcing contract, using the notion of general cost sharing function. Compared with traditional methods, this simplifies the discussion on optimal contract design significantly. This restriction of the contract space does not lead to any deterioration in performance as it includes the optimal contract in the feasible contract options. The simplicity of this approach makes it more adaptable to analyzing logistics outsourcing contract options. We use a newsvendor problem to demonstrate the applicability of this approach. Some extension of this approach is proposed to complete a further insight of this approach.

articleTitle: Power-law distribution for moral hazards in supply chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The objectivity is to obtain the evolution law of moral hazards in supply chain, and to control it effectively. A Multi-Local-World directed networks model according to persons' interacting rules, is constructed to specify the evolution law of topological of the moral hazards in supply chain. Using the method of complex networks, the topological structure's evolution law is gotten. The result shown that, the Multi-Local-World directed networks model of supply chain's moral hazards satisfies power-law distribution, is a scale-free networks, the component is decided by ß<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sub>, the character of the supply chain.

articleTitle: Analysis on the outsourcing of Chinese exhibition logistics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The rapid development of Chinese exhibition industry requires correspondingly logistics service. Outsourcing is an effective solution to the many problems existing in the process of exhibition logistics development. Based on analysis of the characteristics of exhibition logistics, the paper analyzed the necessity and the obstacles of exhibition logistics outsourcing, constructed an effective exhibition logistics outsourcing model on the core of the service provider of logistics outsourcing, and proposed to enforce the management of exhibition logistics outsourcing, which will play an instruction role on the development of exhibition logistics.

articleTitle: Coordinated development degree of the relationship between supply and demand in city distribution system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The purpose of studying coordinated development degree of supply and demand is to measure the operational compatibility of city distribution system. A model of coordinated development degree of supply and demand is developed with coordinate factors and development factors. Two aspects of supply and demand are considered in the process of designing the model and index system. Empirical sample data is collected from supply and demand of city distribution in Beijing and Shanghai to verify the validity of the model. Key index defining coordinated development degree of supply and demand is concluded and the improvement measures are proposed correspondingly.

articleTitle: Port supply chain supernetwork optimization based on variational inequalities
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: This paper proposes a three-tier port supply chain supernetwork model, which is composed of m suppliers, n port agents and o clients. The model takes the competition within a tier and the cooperation between tiers into account, the optimality conditions for the suppliers, port agents and customs are formulated respectively using the variational inequalities. Then the optimization situation for the whole supply chain supernetwork model is illustrated. A simulated example introduced at the end of this paper turned out the validity of the model.

articleTitle: Measuring service quality in China's third-party logistics industry from the perspective of international customers
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: This paper is mainly aimed to measure service quality in China's third-party logistics industry based on the perception of international customers. The given topic can be considered important to the development of China's third-party logistics industry. A evaluation index system for measuring customer perceived quality in China's third-party logistics industry were designed based on factor analysis and service quantity provided by 3 third-party logistic companies was measured applying fuzzy evaluation methodology.

articleTitle: Coordinating a supply chain with material flow and capital flow integrated
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Achieving effective coordination has become a pertinent research issue in supply chain management. The problem of capital shortage seems to be bottleneck especially for small and medium enterprises. This paper proposes a two-level supply chain model with delay in payments according to cases of the retailer's different order cycle time respectively, and inventory impawn financing to coordinate the supply chain with material flow and capital flow integrated and to minimize the total cost. Analytical and experimental results are presented and discussed to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Petri net based modeling study on traditional enterprise transformed to SDN enterprise
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: To help enterprises in China obtain more competition advantage by relying on the effective management mode, the Supply and Demand Network with multifunction and opening characteristics for enterprises (abbr. SDN) as a new management mode is proposed. As a result, the research on traditional enterprises transformed into SDN enterprises is being carried on. To assist enterprises to launch this transformation smoothly, firstly, in view of supply and demand activities, the difference between traditional enterprises and SDN enterprises are analyzed emphatically. Then, facing the changing aspects, the Petri net modeling is applied to design some sub-models on this transforming, and based these sub-models the integrated and optimizing model for this study is given to provide the basis of launching, appraising, error controlling for this transforming.

articleTitle: Capability evaluation of air cargo export handling system using Stochastic Petri Net
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Air cargo export handling influences the cargo transportation speed. The Stochastic Petri Net (SPN) and homogeneous Markov chain (MC) were used in modeling the air cargo export handling system for performance analysis. The system capability was evaluated including steady probability, operation efficiency and system delay time. Taking a Chinese international air cargo terminal as research object, the capability of the system was analyzed. According to the calculation, system bottlenecks are forklifts usage, bulk cargo acceptance, security inspection, decompose and combination. Some advices were given to improve the handling system capability. If the bottlenecks are optimized, the system efficiency could increase 40%.

articleTitle: Research on the modern port logistics development in the city-group, China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: The rapid development of modern logistics brings big challenge to ports. Based on the construction of the hub -Changsha and the port group of Changsha, Zhuzhou and Xiangtan, by creating union innovation and advanced operation mechanism, the infrastructures of current ports will be integrated to transform inland-river ports in Hunan province to modern logistics ports, and to exploit their advantages of the hub terminal, cargo distribution and extensive information etc. in the logistics chain. The logistics competition potential and economic benefit of inland-river ports in Hunan province will be improved and the regional economy development will be served better.

articleTitle: A decision support approach for group decision making under risk and uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: Cost-benefit analysis has long been used in decision making about public health and security. Frequently, risk and uncertainty are involved, and benefit and cost are not evenly shared by all stakeholders in the activities where public welfare is concerned. The result of cost-benefit analysis may be controversial because it does not consider the conflict of interest among the stakeholders. In this paper, we propose a decision support approach that allows individual agents to make their own evaluations of benefit, cost and risk over available alternatives. Individual beliefs with respect to the alternatives will then be aggregated to form a group decision. This approach can also be used to integrate the cost benefit analysis into risk assessment. An application to this group decision making, considering the disposal of dead animals, is given.

articleTitle: Risk evaluation of military supply chains based on case and fuzzy reasoning
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Logistics Systems and Intelligent Management (ICLSIM)
abstract: This article studies from structure of military supply chains, summarizes its risk origin, puts foreword a method of integrating case-based reasoning with the fuzzy technology, adopts the ¿case-express first fuzzy-reasoning second¿ reasoning mechanism to evaluate possible risk consequences in military supply chains. It is aiming at providing theory basis for conducting and developing military supply chain system.
